nameZh: 山海绘卷 莉莉娅 湘妃
descriptionZh: 每天，太阳鸟都在两棵圣树之间飞行：西方的黎明之树和东方的黄昏之树。莉莉娅是“回春之灵”，也是太阳鸟的看管者。作为时间和季节的管理人，她在晚上将鸟儿带回家时用她的香炉散布平静的薄雾。
descriptionEn: Every day, the Sun Bird flies between two sacred trees: the western Tree of Dawn and the eastern Tree of Dusk. Lillia is a spirit of rejuvenation and the Sun Bird's caretaker. A steward of time and seasons, she uses her censer to spread a calming mist as she carries the bird home at night.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在传说中的山海绘卷中，神明们和神话生物们在各个神奇的土地上游荡，挥舞着元素的力量。有些人满足于接受给定的调色板，而另一些人则希望跳出界限，用一支新的画笔描绘他们的生活。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Within the fabled Shan Hai Scrolls, gods and mythical creatures roam magical lands, wielding the power of the elements. Some are content to live with the palette they've been given, while others wish to jump beyond the borders and paint their lives with a new brush.

universes.descriptionZh: 没有人能说出神秘的山海绘卷是何人或在何时创作的。只需要一眼就可以看出这幅画是通向魔法和奇迹世界的一扇窗户，但也许它更像是一扇门扉？
universes.descriptionEn: No one can say who created the mysterious Shan Hai Scrolls, or when. All it takes is one glimpse to see the painting is a window to a world of magic and wonder, but perhaps it is more of a doorway?

nameZh: 莲华温泉 阿狸 雁来
descriptionZh: 作为灵魂莲华温泉浴场的主人和经营者，阿狸将她最喜欢的山变成了一个隐藏的绿洲。她深刻理解休息带来的能量，尽情享受生活中最丰富的滋味——每一次都是一段美妙记忆。只有既敏锐又善良的人才能应付她的那些朝气蓬勃的客人们。
descriptionEn: Owner and proprietor of the Spirit Blossom Springs bathhouse, Ahri has turned her favorite mountain into a hidden oasis. Wielding a keen understanding of the power of rest, she indulges her appetite for life's richest flavors—one memory at a time. Only one with a sharp yet kindhearted wit could handle her guests' spirited dispositions.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在高山之上，有一家神奇的温泉馆，能为客人消解一切的世间烦恼。这家店名叫“莲华温泉”，是一片祥和、疗愈的绿洲。热情的工作人员和神奇的蒸汽会洗去战争的负担和那些“忘掉反而最好”的记忆。这里没有英雄或反派——只有得到充分休息并焕发活力的客人。
skinSets.descriptionEn: High in the mountains lies a bathhouse where guests go to melt away their worldly cares. This themed retreat, called "Spirit Blossom Springs," is an oasis free of drama. Its welcoming staff and magical steam wash away the burdens of battle and memories best forgotten. There are no heroes or villains here—only the restful and the rejuvenated.

universes.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
universes.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 惊悚派对 薇古丝 吓走你的沮丧！
descriptionZh: 薇古丝以前很讨厌小丑。穿上滑稽的衣服然后表演一些小把戏去逗人发笑？为什么会有人想做这个？后来她发现，大多数人都害怕小丑。现在她热爱这份工作，并且生平第一次找到了她自己真正享受的职业。
descriptionEn: Vex used to hate clowns. Dressing up in a goofy outfit and doing tricks to make people laugh? Why would anyone want to do that? Then she discovered that most people are scared of clowns. Now she loves them, and for the first time in her life, has a calling she actually enjoys.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 谁不喜欢惊悚派对呢？ 嘉宾名单已经完成，每个人都买了礼物，并且食物会很棒。我们甚至有一个小丑！这将是一场值得铭记的派对。只是别告诉阿木木。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Who doesn't like a surprise party? The guest list is done, everybody's bought their presents, and the food's going to be great. We even got a clown! This'll be one to remember. Just don't tell Amumu.

universes.descriptionZh: 磨砺之路不仅仅是工作。它是斗争，是喧嚣，有时令人振奋，有时令人沮丧。它是一个为期一周的过山车，有喜剧性的过弯和悲惨的急落，只会在周一重新开始。我们是努力工作还是几乎不工作？在磨砺之路上，一切都一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The grind isn't just work. It's the struggle, the hustle, sometimes invigorating, sometimes demoralizing. It's a weeklong rollercoaster with comedic bends and tragic drops, only to start all over again on Monday. Are we working hard or hardly working? It's all the same on the grind.

nameZh: 海魔至尊 亚托克斯 无情背袭
descriptionZh: 当海魔人第一次发起进攻时，人类毫无防备——直到幻灵战队成立，成为人类的最后一道防线。但他们不再安全，因为海魔人也随之进化。他们的顶端存在名为亚托克斯，而他对人类的理解只会进一步加深他的仇恨。他的肉体没有极限，他的剑刃毫不留情。他是幻灵末日的先兆。
descriptionEn: When the Primordians first attacked, humanity was unprepared—until Anima Squad formed to become its last defense. But they are safe no longer, for the Primordians evolved in turn. Their apex being is called Aatrox, whose understanding of humanity only furthers his hatred. His flesh has no limits, his sword no mercy. He is the harbinger of Anima's end.
heroNameZh: 暗裔剑魔 亚托克斯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 海魔人被从陆地上赶出来，蛰伏于深海中，等待了数个世纪之久……直到他们再也无法忍受地表居民们，以及地表居民们对这个星球的破坏。于是，海魔女王做出了判决：人类在太阳下的时代已经结束，海魔人的时代才刚刚开始。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Cast from dry land, the Primordians bided their time deep beneath the sea, biding their time for centuries… until they could no longer abide the surface-dwellers any longer, nor their abuses of the planet. Thus the Primordian Queen's judgment was made: humanity's era in the sun is over, and that of the Primordians has only just begun.

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

skinNameZh: 海魔至尊 亚托克斯

nameZh: 海魔至尊 亚托克斯 威慑嘶吼
descriptionZh: 当海魔人第一次发起进攻时，人类毫无防备——直到幻灵战队成立，成为人类的最后一道防线。但他们不再安全，因为海魔人也随之进化。他们的顶端存在名为亚托克斯，而他对人类的理解只会进一步加深他的仇恨。他的肉体没有极限，他的剑刃毫不留情。他是幻灵末日的先兆。

nameZh: 女帝 格温 纹章之刻印·强运
descriptionZh: 卡利戈，一个遥远的、古老的女帝之国，长期以来被认为已经消失在时间中。来自卡利戈的格温冲破了这个国家的保护云层，与伊莱西亚的其他国度重新建立了联系。她的前任——女帝伊苏尔德——相信格温的纯洁心灵和敏锐头脑会证实卡利戈的力量并与其他统治者们结盟——因为黑暗时代就在前方，只有一份坚定不移的盟约才能防止最坏的情况发生。
descriptionEn: Gwen of Caligo—a faraway, ancient queendom long thought lost to time—cut through the nation's protective clouds to reconnect with the rest of Elysia. Her predecessor, Queen Isolde, trusts Gwen's pure heart and sharp mind to affirm Caligo's strength and ally with fellow rulers—for dark times lie ahead, and only a steadfast pact may prevent the worst.

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……
universes.descriptionEn: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 龙马烈焰 艾希 前程似锦
descriptionZh: 艾希优雅、自律、沉着冷静——但春节期间除外。那时的她会变本加厉！这种热闹气氛能让她放松心情，并且今年她将带来一场盛大的终场演出，而这场演出注定会点亮夜空，照亮新的一年。
descriptionEn: Ashe is elegant, disciplined, and unshakably calm—except during the Lunar Revel, when she's all that and more! The lively atmosphere has a way of loosening her bowstring, and this year she's unleashing a grand finale destined to light up the sky and the new year ahead.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 春节到了——派对也到了！家人朋友聚在一起，共同享用美食与佳节时光。现在，点燃一根火柴，然后观看焰火吧！
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Lunar New Year has arrived—and so has the party! With food and festivities to spare, it's all about ringing it in with friends and family. Now strike up a match and watch the fireworks!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 玉剑传说 海龙王 亚恒 自强不息
descriptionZh: 手持天赐战戟，驾驭神圣水流，龙王亚恒统治着东方的海洋。然而预言却说，愤怒终将吞噬他的仁慈，带来致命的洪水。亚恒隐退至他的宫廷深处……直到一位学者大胆下潜，探寻波涛之下神明的真相。被唤醒的亚恒如今正与自己命中注定要释放的毁灭进行抗争。
descriptionEn: Wielding a divine glaive and sacred waters, the dragon king Zaahen ruled the eastern seas. But prophecy foretold that rage would drown his mercy, bringing deathly floods. Zaahen withdrew to the depths of his court… until a scholar dared to descend, seeking the truth of the god beneath the waves. Stirred, Zaahen now fights the ruin he was fated to unleash.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

skinNameZh: 玉剑传说 海龙王 亚恒

nameZh: 腥红之月 劫 琉璃
descriptionZh: 尽管腥红之月教派内部离心离德，劫仍然是崔斯特不可动摇的得力助手和私属权力代理人。他用秘密、暗影和鲜血进行交易，同时利用他对魔鬼的掌控来提升这个教派的影响力。而崔斯特不知道的是，劫还在搜寻他的那个已被净雪之月给抢走的失踪助手。
descriptionEn: As loyalty fractures within the Blood Moon cult, Zed remains Twisted Fate's unshakable right hand and personal power broker. He trades in secrets, shadows, and blood, all while using his mastery over his demon to increase the cult's influence. What Twisted Fate doesn't know is that Zed is also searching for his lost acolyte, stolen by the Snow Moon.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 一个远古教派，寻求着不可抗拒的力量，总在血月之夜现身实行亵渎、秘传的仪式——用恶灵融合他们的肉身，并变成一个拥有恒增黑暗的存在。
skinSets.descriptionEn: An ancient cult, seeking irresistible power, surfaces on nights of the Blood Moon to perform profane, esoteric rites—merging their flesh with demonic spirits, and becoming one with an ever greater darkness.

universes.descriptionZh: 一个声音从寂静中回响：“翻腾吧，野兽们，教友们。艾欧尼亚在劫难逃，它的诸多月亮像饥饿的恶魔的眼睛一样升起，等待着你们忠诚的红色——抑或它们是无法越过的可怕荒芜？ 无论是哪种方式，我们都是沉浸在仪式和献祭中的躯壳。在月亮的顶峰，我们从肉中切肉，献上微薄的礼物——我们自身的一切。”
universes.descriptionEn: A voice echoes from the silence: “Writhe, beasts, brethren. The moons of a doomed Ionia rise like eyes of starved demons, awaiting the red of your fealty—or are they monstrous blights that cannot pass? Either way, we are vessels plunged in ritual and sacrifice. At the moon's peak, we carve flesh from flesh, offering the meager gift of all that we are.”

nameZh: 慧理之贤 阿萝拉 财富
descriptionZh: 低位世界的人们将阿萝拉视作大图书馆中的古怪学者，她徘徊流连于其间，只为探究寓言中的图案所隐藏的此世运转之奥理。高位世界的人们则将阿萝拉视作“双界之巫女”，只有极少数高位世界的命运之子能够洞悉到蕴含着魔力的万物内中隐藏的传送门，她正是其中之一。她利用能力在两个世界镜像对称的轴线上来回穿梭，游历于诸城之间。无论上界，或是下界。
descriptionEn: Those below know Aurora as an eccentric academic at the Grand Library, wandering off to study the mysterious workings of the fabled Pattern. Those above know Aurora as the Witch Betwixt, one of the few Higher Arcana able to find portals hidden within the magic of all things, and travel the cities across their mirroring axis. As above, so below.

universes.descriptionZh: 在命运位面上方的高空中，命运之子们，那些自我塑造现实的鲜活图案们，奋力地在他们下方的混沌之上勾勒着他们的愿景。命运之子们从下界位面中招募有感知力的公民来增幅他们的隐藏图案——有越多人放大一位命运之子的图案，这个位面就越能反映出这位命运之子的宏伟设计。
universes.descriptionEn: High above Arcana, the Archetypes, living patterns that shape reality itself, struggle to trace their vision upon the chaos below them. The Archetypes recruit perceptive citizens of the world below to amplify their hidden patterns—and the more who magnify an Archetype's pattern, the more the world reflects their grand design.

nameZh: 天龙之子 伊泽瑞尔 飞天
descriptionZh: 无论哪里出了状况，整个王国的龙都知道会听到伊泽瑞尔的淘气笑声。他的玩笑虽然无害，但不要让这个开心果欺骗了你：他是一位精明的皇家斥候，与卡莎并肩作战，而后者已经在他层出不穷的恶作剧之中勇敢地经历了许多次冒险。要穿得像个人类去参加派对？听着就像是他所憧憬的美好时光。
descriptionEn: Wherever chaos is sown, dragons across the kingdom know to listen for Ezreal's mischievous laughter. His japes are harmless, but don't let that merry spirit fool you: he is a shrewd royal scout alongside Kai'Sa who has braved many adventures between bouts of pranking. Dressing up like a human to go party? Now that sounds like his idea of a good time.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

skinNameZh: 天龙之子 伊泽瑞尔

nameZh: 天龙之子 卡莎 惊鸿
descriptionZh: 卡莎是皇家斥候，也是龙太子的好友。她很坚毅，在云端度过的时间比她的任何同龄人都多。虽然这是她第一次与人类直接互动，但她观察到的知识和机敏一定会在她与人类一起庆祝新年时派上用场。
descriptionEn: Royal scout and friend to the prince, Kai'Sa is a tenacious dragon who has spent more time beneath the clouds than any of her peers. Though this is the first time she has interacted with humans directly, her observed knowledge and agile grace are sure to be assets while joining them in the New Year's celebration.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 神龙尊者 圣龙李青 无相
descriptionZh: 李青是一名苦修战士，对正义有着潮鸣电挚般的热忱。他攀登上了圣龙敖兴所在的山峰，希望得到他的赐福。李青以传说中的神龙尊者的身份从顶峰归来，将雷霆万钧般的惩罚带给了各处的恶棍们——而这都被他的龙主尽收眼底。
descriptionEn: A warrior ascetic consumed with an electric passion for justice, Lee Sin climbed the mountain of the storm dragon Ao Shin, hoping to receive his blessing. Having returned from the summit as a legendary Dragonmancer, Lee Sin now doles out thunderous punishment to villains everywhere—ever under the watchful eye of his draconic patron.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 尊荣的巨龙们居住在偏远的雄奇瑰丽之地，为了避免外面的凡界纷争，它们只会非常罕见地将礼物赐给极少数被它们选中的人。神龙尊者们就是幸运且强大到足以获得这种终极赐福的人。他们用它来行善还是行恶，都取决于他们自己，以及任何强大到足以制止他们的人。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Majestic dragons dwell in remote places of wild beauty, avoiding mortal affairs outside of rarely bestowing their gifts on only a select few. The Dragonmancers are those fortunate and powerful enough to have gained the ultimate blessing. Whether they then use that for good or for evil is up to them, and anyone strong enough to stop them.

universes.descriptionZh: 圣兽们守护着整个世界，能够把任何人变成强大的存在，但前提是那个灵魂值得他们的祝福。无论他们的力量是用于善还是恶，一旦赐予，就无法收回。
universes.descriptionEn: Divine beasts watch over the world entire, capable of turning anyone into powerful beings, but only if that soul is worthy of their blessings. Whether their power is used for good or evil, once the gift is given, it cannot be taken away.

skinNameZh: 神龙尊者 圣龙李青

nameZh: 天龙之子 黛安娜 赫赫龙威
descriptionZh: 龙之王国的图书馆是保存历代智慧之作的档案馆：也是由宫廷学者黛安娜保管的藏品。她是一位狂热的学者和战士，陪伴龙太子踏上旅程，记录龙与人类之间历史性的第一次相遇。
descriptionEn: The library of the Kingdom of Dragons is an illustrious archive of wisdom from ages past: a collection kept by Diana, scholar of the court. A fierce academic as well as a fighter, she accompanies the prince on his journey to document this historical first encounter between dragons and humans.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 战斗学院 贝蕾亚 狮鹫
descriptionZh: 大多数神之武器学院的严苛规章制度让贝蕾亚很难成为学业有成的学生——直到她转学到巴比伦学院。这里没有规则或护栏，只有方向。想学神之武器的历史？武术？陶艺？对学生的唯一要求是要有求知欲，而贝蕾亚在求知欲方面可是相当强烈。
descriptionEn: The confining rules of most God Weapon academies made it hard for Briar to be a successful student—until she transferred to Babylon Academy. Here there were no rules or guardrails, only directions. Want to study God Weapon history? Martial arts? Ceramics? All a student needed was an appetite for knowledge, and Briar's was considerable.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在这些院校中，只有强者才能生存。尽管它们的成立是为了纪念它们的神之武器，但每个学院的学生都在通往荣耀的道路上努力使它的力量成为自己的力量。无论它是在课堂，还是在战场，都在主导着竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: At these institutions, only the strong survive. Though they were founded to honor their God Weapon, the students at each academy strive to make its strength their own on their path to glory. Whether it's the classroom, or the battlefield, dominate the competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 散布在全球各地的神之武器将社会变成了一个由力量驱动的社会。这些有感知力的碑石召唤着那些配得上的人，并将其礼物赠予其主体，打算在这个饱受战争蹂躏的世界中扩张其征服之地。被选中是一种荣誉勋章，向任何可能反对他们的人灌输恐惧。
universes.descriptionEn: Scattered across the globe, the God Weapons morphed society into one driven by power. These sentient monuments call to those who are worthy and bestow their gifts upon their subjects, aiming to expand their conquest in this war-torn world. To be chosen is a badge of honor, instilling fear into any who may oppose them.

nameZh: 龙马烈焰 悠米 团团圆圆
descriptionZh: 如果没有像悠米这样的可爱吉祥物，春节庆典就不算完整！她兴致勃勃地与各种参会游客们互动，走到哪就将快乐带到哪。有人说，这只神奇猫咪的到来预示着新的一年会有好运。
descriptionEn: No Lunar Revel celebration is complete without an adorable mascot like Yuumi! Playfully attaching to various festival attendees, she spreads joy wherever she travels. Some say a visit from this magical cat is a sign of good luck for the new year.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 春节到了——派对也到了！家人朋友聚在一起，共同享用美食与佳节时光。现在，点燃一根火柴，然后观看焰火吧！
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Lunar New Year has arrived—and so has the party! With food and festivities to spare, it's all about ringing it in with friends and family. Now strike up a match and watch the fireworks!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 正义假面 永恩 贯彻吾之道路
descriptionZh: 当“梅佐拉克斯”入侵永恩和他弟弟亚索的星球时，兄弟俩发誓要予以回击。亚索率先出手，夺取了那个入侵巨头的高能伪装战斗服。但出手最凶狠的还是“梅佐拉克斯”。随着亚索的离去，永恩继承了弟弟的高能伪装并正在建造更多的高能伪装，以便同胞们可以加入这场战斗。
descriptionEn: When Mezzorax invaded their planet, Yone and his brother Yasuo swore to retaliate. Yasuo struck first, seizing the invading giant's Hyperguise suits. But it was Mezzorax who struck hardest. With Yasuo now gone, Yone has taken up his brother's Hyperguise and is building more, so that fellow citizens can join the fight.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在摧毁了自己的家园之后，疯狂巨人“梅佐拉克斯”在整个银河系中搜寻，直到找到一颗新的星球进行入侵：繁华的都市星球“奥科诺”。但现在一群意想不到的市民正在进行还击。在外星高能伪装战斗服的加持下，他们将为被“梅佐拉克斯”偷走的生命进行复仇，并彻底结束他的统治。
skinSets.descriptionEn: After destroying its own homeworld, the mad giant Mezzorax searched the galaxy until it found a new planet to invade: the bustling metropolis of Ocono. But now an unlikely group of citizens is fighting back. Empowered by alien Hyperguise suits, they will avenge the lives Mezzorax has stolen and end his reign for good.

universes.descriptionZh: 当危险出现并且急需帮助时，只有一个团体能够响应号召。他们时刻准备着，穿上高能伪装战斗服，凭借变身后的力量、敏捷和惊人的威力在行动中堂堂登场。他们将会战斗。他们将会坚持。他们是超级星球武装拯救者，他们来这里是为了保卫银河系！
universes.descriptionEn: When danger appears and help is desperately needed, there is only one group that can answer the call. Standing at the ready, they tap into their Hyperguise suits and leap into action with transformed strength, agility, and sensational powers. They will fight. They will endure. They are the Super Planet Force Savers, and they are here to defend the galaxy!

nameZh: 剪纸仙灵 娜美 日进斗金
descriptionZh: 娜美控制波涛的野心让她与神帝嘉文四世之间引发了一场毁灭性的战斗，给这个仙境带来了巨大的灾难。但当这个世界面临更大的威胁——至恶的人类天性——时，娜美必须放下她的骄傲，与她以前的敌人们合作，从而阻止他们的故事被改写。
descriptionEn: Nami's ambition to control the waves led to a destructive battle between her and god-emperor Jarvan IV, causing a great calamity to befall the world. But when the world faces an even greater threat—human nature at its most devious—Nami must swallow her pride and work with her former enemies to stop their story from being rewritten.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，大年兽加里奥的失败让春节的新年传统得以兴盛，并且这些传统通过重述那个史诗故事而得以延续。这个故事本身就是一个活生生的世界——但当这个故事世界被突然扰打断时，故事中的各个角色必须共同努力来解决这个乱局，并书写他们自己的神话。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, the defeat of the Great Beast Galio gave rise to Lunar New Year traditions that are carried on through the retelling of that epic tale. Within the story itself lies a living world all its own—but when the world of the story is suddenly interrupted, the characters must work together to fix the mess and see their own myth through.

universes.descriptionZh: 故事、神话、传说：每个人都有一个自己的世界，在这个世界里，在讲述和重述角色们的故事时，这些角色会一遍又一遍地经历着考验和磨难。
universes.descriptionEn: Stories, myths, legends: within each lies a world unto itself, where characters act out their trials and tribulations over and over as their tales are told and retold.

nameZh: 龙马烈焰 萨勒芬妮 喜气洋洋
descriptionZh: 春节庆典的主要看点是萨勒芬妮。她以迷人的魅力征服了观众们，鼓舞并凝聚了他们的心。她的迷人旋律，加上每次新年庆典中心的喧闹人群和精彩烟花，让年味变得更浓了。当这位明星登上舞台的那一刻，庆典才算真正地开始了！
descriptionEn: The main attraction of the Lunar Revel, Seraphine mesmerizes onlookers, uplifting and uniting their hearts. Her melodies serve as the perfect complement to the rambunctious crowds and booming fireworks at the center of every New Year festival. The celebration truly begins when this star takes the stage!
heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

skinSets.descriptionZh: 春节到了——派对也到了！家人朋友聚在一起，共同享用美食与佳节时光。现在，点燃一根火柴，然后观看焰火吧！
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Lunar New Year has arrived—and so has the party! With food and festivities to spare, it's all about ringing it in with friends and family. Now strike up a match and watch the fireworks!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

skinNameZh: 龙马烈焰 萨勒芬妮

nameZh: 踏雪寻梅 卡特琳娜 岁寒特妍
descriptionZh: 在花园的中心，卡特琳娜挥舞着她的双刃，将即使是从最痛苦的记忆中孕育的植物，塑造成充满希望和吉兆的繁茂植景亭。如果某个神秘生物悄悄溜过了她的剪枝师同伴——亚索——的防御，那么她的双刃也未尝不利。通过切除枯枝，她带来了春天的新生吉兆。
descriptionEn: In the heart of the garden, Katarina flourishes her twin blades, shaping plants born from even the most painful memories into bountiful arbors of hope and promise. Her blades are equally as capable in battle, should a shadowy creature sneak past the defenses of her fellow pruner, Yasuo. By cutting away blight, she ushers in spring's promise of renewal.
heroNameZh: 不祥之刃 卡特琳娜

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在精神领域的深处，有一个神话花园，其中的每一株植物都具象化了凡间的希望、梦想和苦难。园丁们以神圣的关怀照料它，修剪掉悲伤并培育新的花朵。如果一切顺利，霜火花就会盛开——预示着积雪即将融化——并且​​春天就会回归，为花园和凡界带来生机。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Deep within the spirit realm lies a garden of myth, where each plant embodies mortal hopes, dreams, and suffering. Gardeners tend to it with sacred care, pruning sorrow and nurturing new blossoms. If all goes well, the Frostpyre flowers bloom—signaling the coming melt of snow—and Spring returns, bringing life back to both the garden and the mortal world.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。

skinNameZh: 踏雪寻梅 卡特琳娜

nameZh: 踏雪寻梅 莉莉娅 岁寒特妍
descriptionZh: 莉莉娅被新春使者选中守护灵界的神圣花园，并且自豪地履行着自己的职责。她勤恳地在植物丛中穿行，劝说每一朵花蕾重新绽放，用每一颗发芽的种子治愈凡界。她知道，她的职责会在严酷寒冬平息下来后完成——并且这时新春使者会回来使这些大地重获新生！
descriptionEn: Chosen by the Herald of Spring to watch over the spirit realm's sacred garden, Lillia upholds her duty with pride. As she diligently trots among the botanicals, she coaxes each bud to bloom anew, healing the mortal realm with every sprouting seed. She knows her duty is done when the cruel winter subsides—and the Herald returns to renew the lands!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在精神领域的深处，有一个神话花园，其中的每一株植物都具象化了凡间的希望、梦想和苦难。园丁们以神圣的关怀照料它，修剪掉悲伤并培育新的花朵。如果一切顺利，霜火花就会盛开——预示着积雪即将融化——并且​​春天就会回归，为花园和凡界带来生机。

nameZh: 踏雪寻梅 亚索 琼英缀雪
descriptionZh: 独自一人，在霜火花园的最远边缘徘徊着的，正是亚索。他手持酷热与严寒之风，与由凡人们最黑暗记忆化成的骇人具象化身们战斗，同时又饱受他的前世记忆的折磨。他向往春天——因为当他的职责完成时，他就可以休息，并再次与他的友好竞争对手——卡特琳娜——切磋了。
descriptionEn: Alone, wandering at the farthest edges of the Frostpyre Garden, is Yasuo. Armed with winds of blistering heat and cold, he battles the monstrous manifestations of mortals' darkest memories, meanwhile haunted by memories of his former life. He yearns for spring—for when his duty is done, he may rest and spar once again with his friendly rival, Katarina.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在精神领域的深处，有一个神话花园，其中的每一株植物都具象化了凡间的希望、梦想和苦难。园丁们以神圣的关怀照料它，修剪掉悲伤并培育新的花朵。如果一切顺利，霜火花就会盛开——预示着积雪即将融化——并且​​春天就会回归，为花园和凡界带来生机。

nameZh: 机神 德莱厄斯 月蚀
descriptionZh: 德莱厄斯将军对维森提亚的几次尝试击败利维坦的行动感到愤怒，于是带着他的阿瓦隆投奔到了边远地区。在那里，他劈出一条血路，砍翻了遇到的每头野兽，从而聚集了大批心怀感激的追随者到他的旗下。如今他带领自己日益壮大的军队席卷大地，誓要救黎民百姓于水火——先是怪兽引来的祸水，再是昏君掀起的战火。
descriptionEn: Furious with Vercentia's attempts to defeat the Leviathans, the general Darius defected with his Avalon to the outlands. There he carved a bloody path through every beast he met, amassing a grateful following beneath his banner. He and his army now storm across the land to liberate its people—first from monsters, then the folly of impotent leadership.
heroNameZh: 诺克萨斯之手 德莱厄斯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 多个伟大的王国彼此纷争了几个世代，直到一个新敌人的到来。为了反击，他们得到了赐福，获得了来自天堂的赠礼。他们会克服旧怨，拯救未来吗？
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Great Kingdoms warred for generations until the arrival of a new enemy. To fight back, they are blessed with gifts from the heavens. Will they rise above their past to save their future?

universes.descriptionZh: 多个伟大的王国彼此纷争了几个世代，直到一个新敌人的到来。为了反击，他们得到了赐福，获得了来自天堂的赠礼。他们会克服旧怨，拯救未来吗？
universes.descriptionEn: The Great Kingdoms warred for generations until the arrival of a new enemy. To fight back, they are blessed with gifts from the heavens. Will they rise above their past to save their future?

nameZh: 青蛙雨衣 格温 豪雨
descriptionZh: 格温是牧雨者们开朗活泼的首席裁缝。在雨停之前，她作为魔法裁缝的才能没有得到充分发挥，但无休止的干旱却给了她新的生命。新的想法如洪流般涌现，比如透气的保水织物。现在她通过设计能让青蛙朋友们保持精神饱满、水分充足的湿衣来帮助它们。
descriptionEn: Gwen is the cheerful lead seamstress for the Rain Shepherds. Before the rains stopped, her talents as a magical tailor went underused, but the unending drought gave her new life. New ideas came flooding out, like breathable water-retentive fabrics. Now she helps her froggy friends by designing wetwear that keeps their spirits high and hydrated.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这个世界已干涸，没有水，没有歌。由于青蛙们失去了唱歌的能力，降雨变慢，水分稀少。因此青蛙们将歌教给了一个新团体：牧雨者。他们穿着特殊的雨具，致力于给土地补充水分并让大自然恢复到以前繁茂的样子。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The world is parched, without water and song. Since the frogs lost the power to sing, rains have slowed and moisture is sparse. So frogs have taught a new group to sing: the Rain Shepherds. Clad in special rain gear, they work to replenish the lands and return nature to its formerly lush self.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 婕拉 雁来
descriptionZh: 从前，有位女子拥有一颗已经破碎的心，她渴望忘记自己的悲伤。一个强大的灵体被她的困境所感动，满足了她的愿望。女子的泪水化为花朵，在她的身体里生根发芽，“忘忧花园”由此诞生。如今，疲惫的心灵们走进它的怀抱，希望这些花朵能够减轻它们的悲伤。
descriptionEn: Once, there was a woman with a broken heart who longed to forget her sorrow. A powerful spirit, moved by her plight, granted her wish. The woman's tears turned to blossoms, her body took root, and the Garden of Forgetting was born. Now, weary hearts wander into its embrace, hoping the blooms will ease their grief.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。

nameZh: 熊猫娃娃 拉克丝 水袖凝云
descriptionZh: 有什么理由不喜欢熊猫呢？它们萌萌哒、圆滚滚、毛绒绒！但是如果你要和它们一起出去玩，就不要犯和拉克丝一样的错误：她的第一根法杖是用竹子做的。真是个坏主意。
descriptionEn: What's not to love about pandas? They're cute, round, and fuzzy! But if you're going to hang out with them, don't make the same mistake that Lux did with her first staff and make it out of bamboo. Bad idea.

nameZh: 熊猫娃娃 拉克丝 墨韵流光
descriptionZh: 有什么理由不喜欢熊猫呢？它们萌萌哒、圆滚滚、毛绒绒！但是如果你要和它们一起出去玩，就不要犯和拉克丝一样的错误：她的第一根法杖是用竹子做的。真是个坏主意。
descriptionEn: What's not to love about pandas? They're cute, round, and fuzzy! But if you're going to hang out with them, don't make the same mistake that Lux did with her first staff and make it out of bamboo. Bad idea.

nameZh: 心之钢 永恩 天纵才华
descriptionZh: 永恩曾经是一位传奇级的DJ/制作人，但他对音乐行业的幻想逐渐破灭并神秘地退圈了，让粉丝和评论家们浮想联翩。与心之钢其他成员的会面使永恩摆脱了创作恐慌，现在的他对音乐的热情重新燃起，决心带领这支乐团走向顶峰。
descriptionEn: Once a legendary DJ/producer, Yone grew disillusioned with the music industry and mysteriously dropped off the grid, leaving fans and critics alike wanting more. Meeting the other members of HEARTSTEEL pulled him out of his creative funk, and with his passion for music now reignited, Yone is determined to take this band straight to the top.

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 偶像歌手 阿狸 幻紫罗兰
descriptionZh: 阿狸在她十几岁的时候就被她的唱片公司发现，在她最初的五首单曲进入百大热门榜时席卷了音乐界，并在2013年流行闪耀奖上获得了“最具天赋的K-pop新秀奖”。从那以后，她一直在俘获人心和横扫各种奖项。然而，在完美的外表下，阿狸感到被越来越多的要求给困住了……
descriptionEn: Discovered by her record label when she was still a teen, Ahri took the music world by storm when her first five singles hit the Top 100, winning Most Talented New K-pop Artist at the 2013 Pop Shine Awards. She's been stealing hearts and sweeping awards ever since. However, underneath that perfect exterior, Ahri is feeling trapped by increasing demands...

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当你在排行榜的顶端时，没有人能把你打下来。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When you're at the top of the charts, no one can bring you down.

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。

About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 觅心猫猫 悠米 月色真美
descriptionZh: 悠米总在寻找猫咪们的所爱之物：装满鱼肉的肚子，和可供蜷缩的温暖大腿。但伴随着迷人程度甚于魔典的浪漫情绪，悠米知道，唯一能让她的心发出愉悦呼噜声的，将是次数恰到好处的抚摸。
descriptionEn: Yuumi's always looking for what cats love: a belly full of fish and a warm lap to curl up on. But with the romantic mood captivating even Book, Yuumi knows the only thing to set her heart purring will be a very precise number of pets.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 大多数人都在安静的公园或友好的茶馆里寻找恋人。但那些关系不会长久。在战场上形成的各种纽带，就像直接穿过敌人心脏的子弹一样具有穿透力……才是能够持续下去的关系。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Most seek out sweethearts in quiet parks or friendly tea shops. But those relationships never last. The bonds formed on the battlefield, piercing like bullets straight through the hearts of enemies... those endure.

universes.descriptionZh: 所以……你愿意吗？
universes.descriptionEn: So... will you?

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 奈德丽 雁来
descriptionZh: “贤猫”的故事在艾欧尼亚各地都有不同的版本，但所有故事的开头都一样：“曾经，有一只猫活了很久很久……”在岁月的磨砺下，她的力量与日俱增，还获得了变成人形的能力。然而，她对世界的质疑也随之加深。她努力搜寻着答案，却未曾发现，她渴望获得的智慧，其实早已存在于她内心之中。
descriptionEn: The Tale of the Wise Cat is told in many ways across Ionia, but all begin the same: “There once was a cat who lived far beyond her years...” Though age brought power, allowing her to shift form between feline and mortal, her questions only deepened. She searched for answers, unaware that the wisdom she yearned for had always lived within.
heroNameZh: 狂野女猎手 奈德丽

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 卡尔玛 春晓
descriptionZh: 很久很久以前，初生之灵创造了一对姐妹——她们同根而生，却踏上了截然不同的命途。起初，初生之灵一直悉心守望着她们；直到有一天，她的目光转向了别处，姐妹中有一人便自此走上歧途，创造出了戴着怪异面具的扭曲生命。面对自己一时疏忽所酿成的悲剧，初生之灵立下誓言：自己将永世看守这片土地，绝不再将目光移开，从此困在了无尽的重生之中。
descriptionEn: Long ago, the First Spirit of the Lands shaped two sisters—born together, yet bound by different fates. For a time, she watched over them, but when her gaze turned elsewhere, one strayed, creating twisted life in monstrous masks. Faced with the cost of her neglect, the First Spirit vowed never to turn away again, binding herself to endless rebirth.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 彗 雁来
descriptionZh: 传说中有位四处云游的画圣，他喜欢徜徉在灵魂的交界之处，行走于光与暗之间。他手中掌握着明昼与夜幽的力量，大笔一挥便能勘破所画之物的内心。机缘巧合下，他来到一座神庙，便为这片圣地的守护者——狩灵之箭画了张像。然而，画像却逐渐扭曲，化为了纯粹的怒火——这个故事警醒世人，做人要忠于自己，否则终究会被画圣识破自己内心的秘密。
descriptionEn: It is said, the Artist roams—obsessed with the soul's liminal space, where light and dark collide. He wields kanmei and akana essence to reveal the heart of those he paints. Chancing upon a divine temple, he painted its guardian Archer. But the portrait twisted into pure rage—a lesson to be true to oneself, lest the Artist expose what lies beneath.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 阿卡丽 鸣蜩
descriptionZh: 有位年轻战士的师父曾告诫她——世间险恶，只有摒弃一切情感，才能在这乱世之中生存，接着便命令她剜出自己的心。然而，战士终于举起利刃时，却发现自己下不了手。她选择带着自己的本心，直面这个残酷的世界。于是，她就此逃逸，想要寻找新的道路——最终，她遇到了灼之影。这位师父虽然没有让她挖出自己的心，却也将其伤得支离破碎。
descriptionEn: A young warrior's master warned her of the world's cruelty and the dispassion it required, then told her to cut out her heart. But when she raised the blade, she could not do it. She would face the world, heart intact. She ran, seeking a new path, and found the Burning Shade—a master who did not demand her heart, but destroyed it all the same.

nameZh: 白雪仙灵 索拉卡
descriptionZh: 索拉卡是魄罗王庭里的一位友善的女公爵，她的领地里满是由洁净的魔力冰块组成的美丽动物。这些兽群绵延数里，由她的家臣们照料。
descriptionEn: A kindly duchess within the court of the Poro King, Soraka's lands are filled with beautiful animals made of pristine, enchanted ice. These menageries stretch for miles, tended by her retainers.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在神奇的冬季仙境中，魄罗王之的统治至高无上，向他王庭的所有人传播欢乐和喜悦。尽管其他人都想篡夺国王的王位，但他们都对冬境仙灵们有着共同的热爱。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Within the magical Winterlands, the Poro King reigns supreme, spreading joy and merriment to all of his court. Even as others work to usurp the king, all share a common love for winter's wonders.

universes.descriptionZh: 一年中还有比空气清新、雪花蓬松、巧克力热腾腾的冰雪节更好的时候吗？投掷雪球或吟唱颂歌；只要你怀着好心情，一切都会好起来的，然后你就没有什么好怕的了。
universes.descriptionEn: Is there a better time of year than Snowdown, when the air is crisp, the snow fluffy, and the chocolate hot? Toss a snowball or sing a carol; as long as you have good cheer, all will be well, and you'll have nothing to fear.

nameZh: 觅心萝莉 金克丝 月色真美
descriptionZh: 爱情即是战场，而金克丝有备而来！她武装着挚爱同伴“鱼骨头”，已经准备好要伤别人的心——和骨头了。但如果她足够喜欢你，她就打算玩得友善一些。也许吧。很有可能不是。
descriptionEn: Love is a battlefield, and Jinx comes prepared! Armed with her beloved companion Fishbones, she's ready to break hearts—and bones. But if she likes you enough, she's prepared to play nice. Maybe. Probably not.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 大多数人都在安静的公园或友好的茶馆里寻找恋人。但那些关系不会长久。在战场上形成的各种纽带，就像直接穿过敌人心脏的子弹一样具有穿透力……才是能够持续下去的关系。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Most seek out sweethearts in quiet parks or friendly tea shops. But those relationships never last. The bonds formed on the battlefield, piercing like bullets straight through the hearts of enemies... those endure.

universes.descriptionZh: 所以……你愿意吗？
universes.descriptionEn: So... will you?

nameZh: 青花瓷 厄运小姐 天青
descriptionZh: 几个世纪以来，人类一直在尝试复制龙息的力量。随着火药的出现，大炮被巧妙地加工成更小更精致的形态，直到莎拉·厄运的母亲最终将其完善。她的双龙手枪延续的不仅是她自己家族的传承，而且是神话生物们本身的传承。
descriptionEn: Through the centuries, humans have tried to replicate the power of dragon's breath. With gunpowder came the cannon, which was finessed into smaller and more refined variants until it was ultimately perfected by Sarah Fortune's mother. Her dual dragon-pistols carry on the legacy of not only her own family, but of the creatures of myth themselves.
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 青蛙雨衣 格温 丝雨
descriptionZh: 格温是牧雨者们开朗活泼的首席裁缝。在雨停之前，她作为魔法裁缝的才能没有得到充分发挥，但无休止的干旱却给了她新的生命。新的想法如洪流般涌现，比如透气的保水织物。现在她通过设计能让青蛙朋友们保持精神饱满、水分充足的湿衣来帮助它们。
descriptionEn: Gwen is the cheerful lead seamstress for the Rain Shepherds. Before the rains stopped, her talents as a magical tailor went underused, but the unending drought gave her new life. New ideas came flooding out, like breathable water-retentive fabrics. Now she helps her froggy friends by designing wetwear that keeps their spirits high and hydrated.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这个世界已干涸，没有水，没有歌。由于青蛙们失去了唱歌的能力，降雨变慢，水分稀少。因此青蛙们将歌教给了一个新团体：牧雨者。他们穿着特殊的雨具，致力于给土地补充水分并让大自然恢复到以前繁茂的样子。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The world is parched, without water and song. Since the frogs lost the power to sing, rains have slowed and moisture is sparse. So frogs have taught a new group to sing: the Rain Shepherds. Clad in special rain gear, they work to replenish the lands and return nature to its formerly lush self.

nameZh: 青蛙雨衣 格温 夜雨
descriptionZh: 格温是牧雨者们开朗活泼的首席裁缝。在雨停之前，她作为魔法裁缝的才能没有得到充分发挥，但无休止的干旱却给了她新的生命。新的想法如洪流般涌现，比如透气的保水织物。现在她通过设计能让青蛙朋友们保持精神饱满、水分充足的湿衣来帮助它们。
descriptionEn: Gwen is the cheerful lead seamstress for the Rain Shepherds. Before the rains stopped, her talents as a magical tailor went underused, but the unending drought gave her new life. New ideas came flooding out, like breathable water-retentive fabrics. Now she helps her froggy friends by designing wetwear that keeps their spirits high and hydrated.

nameZh: 海之歌 艾希 浪漫氛围
descriptionZh: 艾希是炙手可热的服装公司“弗雷”的首席执行官。在北方总部不见天日地埋头工作一年后，她已经感到筋疲力尽。海之歌音乐节听起来是一个完美的机会，让她可以舒展筋骨，混进人潮，彻底沉醉于美妙的音乐中。
descriptionEn: As the CEO of the hot clothing company Frel, Ashe is dead tired after spending a year heads-down in work with little sun at her Northern headquarters. The Ocean Song Festival sounds like the perfect place for her to warm up, disappear into a crowd, and lose herself to some fabulous music.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 没有什么比海之歌音乐节更能散发出“海滩氛围和酷炫曲调”的生活方式了。从萨勒芬妮的柔和歌曲到永恩的实验性DJ现场，每个人都有一种氛围，所以，尽情感受脚趾间的沙子、品尝充满咸味的空气、沉浸在夏天最好的音乐中吧。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Nothing exudes the "beach vibes and cool tunes" lifestyle more than the Ocean Song Festival. From Seraphine's mellow songs to Yone's experimental DJ set, there's a vibe for everyone, so feel the sand between your toes, taste the salty air, and lose yourself to the best music of the summer.

universes.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
universes.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 海之歌 艾希 幻彩夜空

nameZh: 海之歌 永恩 幻彩夜空
descriptionZh: 永恩很紧张。作为一名DJ，他冷静、专注、即兴，但海之歌是他作为DJ和作词人的第一场音乐会。在找到他的歌词秘密藏匿处后，他的朋友奈德丽在他拒唱时自愿唱出这些歌词。他可能还没准备好唱歌，但他们仍然会听到他的声音。
descriptionEn: Yone is nervous. As a DJ he's calm, focused, and improvisational, but Ocean Song is his first concert as a DJ and lyricist. After finding his secret stash of lyrics, his friend Nidalee volunteered to belt them out herself when he refused. He may not be ready to sing, but they'll still hear his voice.

nameZh: 海之歌 泽丽 幻彩夜空
descriptionZh: 泽丽是来自西南地区的一位崭露头角的驯水师，一头扎进了海之歌音乐节。这是她第一次独自掌控舞台，并且为了给自己留个好印象，她可能在表演计划上做得有点过头了。人人都爱过度刺激，对吧？
descriptionEn: An up and coming Water Tamer from the Southwest, Zeri is diving into the Ocean Song Festival headfirst. This is her first time handling a stage on her own, and she may have gone a little overboard with her showstopper plans in order to give herself a calling card. Everybody loves a little overstimulation, right?

skinSets.descriptionZh: 没有什么比海之歌音乐节更能散发出“海滩氛围和酷炫曲调”的生活方式了。从萨勒芬妮的柔和歌曲到永恩的实验性DJ现场，每个人都有一种氛围，所以，尽情感受脚趾间的沙子、品尝充满咸味的空气、沉浸在夏天最好的音乐中吧。

nameZh: 天龙之子 卡莎 龙飞凤翔
descriptionZh: 卡莎是皇家斥候，也是龙太子的好友。她很坚毅，在云端度过的时间比她的任何同龄人都多。虽然这是她第一次与人类直接互动，但她观察到的知识和机敏一定会在她与人类一起庆祝新年时派上用场。
descriptionEn: Royal scout and friend to the prince, Kai'Sa is a tenacious dragon who has spent more time beneath the clouds than any of her peers. Though this is the first time she has interacted with humans directly, her observed knowledge and agile grace are sure to be assets while joining them in the New Year's celebration.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 青花瓷 莫甘娜 釉色
descriptionZh: 没有人比莫甘娜更了解女巫丽桑卓的力量。将丽桑卓束缚在她的圣物上的那个魔法，是有代价的：说出这段咒语的生肖神卫也会被困住。莫甘娜牺牲了自己，而她的鸡生肖圣物的双翼将她包裹在瓷茧中长达数千年。再次醒来后，她要加倍奉还。
descriptionEn: There is no one who comprehends the power of the sorceress Lissandra more than Morgana. The magic that bound Lissandra to her relic came at a cost: the protector who uttered the words would be trapped as well. Morgana made this sacrifice, the wings of her Rooster Relic wrapping her in a porcelain cocoon for millennia. Awake once more, she seeks revenge.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 女帝 厄运小姐 纹章之刻印·强运
descriptionZh: 女帝卡特琳娜的法令传遍了整个艾丽西亚：“神圣加冕礼”是各国之间两军对阵的荣耀战斗。瑟瑞尼亚的厄运小姐接纳了这一改变，指挥着她的空中舰队以一种爆炸性的方式炫耀着财富和弹药。虽然盟友是与世隔绝的奥莱，但厄运小姐的加冕证明了空中部队的残酷无情。
descriptionEn: Queen Katarina's decree rang throughout Elysia: the Grand Coronation ordains honorable battle among nations, army versus army. Miss Fortune of Cyrenia welcomed this change, commanding her sky-fleet in an explosive display of wealth and munitions. While allied to the secluded Aurai, Miss Fortune's crowning proves the ruthlessness of the brigades above.
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……
universes.descriptionEn: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 剪纸仙灵 嘉文四世 喜气洋洋
descriptionZh: 嘉文四世——这一地区的皇帝——不惜一切代价保护他的国度免受外来者的侵害，而这导致他经常与其他神发生冲突。但当“大恶人”烬构成了前所未有的威胁时，嘉文四世发现他自己正在与那些意料之外的盟友合作，为人类的生存铺平道路。
descriptionEn: The region's Emperor, Jarvan IV, does whatever it takes to protect his realm from outsiders, leading him to frequent clashes with other gods. But when the malicious Jhin poses a threat greater than any before, he finds himself working with unlikely allies to pave the way for humanity's survival.
heroNameZh: 德玛西亚皇子 嘉文四世
heroNameEn: the Exemplar of Demacia Jarvan IV

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，大年兽加里奥的失败让春节的新年传统得以兴盛，并且这些传统通过重述那个史诗故事而得以延续。这个故事本身就是一个活生生的世界——但当这个故事世界被突然扰打断时，故事中的各个角色必须共同努力来解决这个乱局，并书写他们自己的神话。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, the defeat of the Great Beast Galio gave rise to Lunar New Year traditions that are carried on through the retelling of that epic tale. Within the story itself lies a living world all its own—but when the world of the story is suddenly interrupted, the characters must work together to fix the mess and see their own myth through.

universes.descriptionZh: 故事、神话、传说：每个人都有一个自己的世界，在这个世界里，在讲述和重述角色们的故事时，这些角色会一遍又一遍地经历着考验和磨难。
universes.descriptionEn: Stories, myths, legends: within each lies a world unto itself, where characters act out their trials and tribulations over and over as their tales are told and retold.

skinNameZh: 剪纸仙灵 嘉文四世

nameZh: 正义假面 赛娜 贯彻吾之道路
descriptionZh: 赛娜的记忆已成一片朦胧。出现了数次闪光——双手被锁在一起，一次爆炸——然后在一片残破废墟中醒来，发现自己身穿一件奇怪的外星人战斗服。只有一个画面萦绕在她的脑海里——一个疯狂巨头的脸。她听到空中传来的呼救声，然后开始了一段新旅程。赛娜将会找到她的记忆，并在一路上尽力救人。
descriptionEn: Senna's memories are a haze. There are flashes—hands locked together, an explosion—before waking up to vast destruction in a strange, alien suit. Only one image lingers in her mind—the face of a mad giant. She hears cries for help in the air, and sets out on a new journey. Senna will find her memories, and save whoever she can on the way.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在摧毁了自己的家园之后，疯狂巨人“梅佐拉克斯”在整个银河系中搜寻，直到找到一颗新的星球进行入侵：繁华的都市星球“奥科诺”。但现在一群意想不到的市民正在进行还击。在外星高能伪装战斗服的加持下，他们将为被“梅佐拉克斯”偷走的生命进行复仇，并彻底结束他的统治。
skinSets.descriptionEn: After destroying its own homeworld, the mad giant Mezzorax searched the galaxy until it found a new planet to invade: the bustling metropolis of Ocono. But now an unlikely group of citizens is fighting back. Empowered by alien Hyperguise suits, they will avenge the lives Mezzorax has stolen and end his reign for good.

universes.descriptionZh: 当危险出现并且急需帮助时，只有一个团体能够响应号召。他们时刻准备着，穿上高能伪装战斗服，凭借变身后的力量、敏捷和惊人的威力在行动中堂堂登场。他们将会战斗。他们将会坚持。他们是超级星球武装拯救者，他们来这里是为了保卫银河系！
universes.descriptionEn: When danger appears and help is desperately needed, there is only one group that can answer the call. Standing at the ready, they tap into their Hyperguise suits and leap into action with transformed strength, agility, and sensational powers. They will fight. They will endure. They are the Super Planet Force Savers, and they are here to defend the galaxy!

nameZh: 正义假面 卢锡安 贯彻吾之道路
descriptionZh: 外星人“梅佐拉克斯”入侵“奥科诺”期间，卢锡安亲眼目睹了他的妻子死去。他之所以能活下来，多亏了永恩。永恩看到卢锡安的心中燃烧着与他一样的愤怒和失落。卢锡安从他的救命恩人手中接受了一套高能伪装战斗服，并发誓要保护他的星球——只要他能为他的心之所爱报仇。
descriptionEn: Lucian saw his wife perish during the alien Mezzorax's invasion of Ocono. He only survived thanks to Yone, who recognized a rage and loss burning in Lucian's heart much like his own. Lucian accepted a Hyperguise suit from his savior, and vowed to protect his planet—once he avenges his beloved.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在摧毁了自己的家园之后，疯狂巨人“梅佐拉克斯”在整个银河系中搜寻，直到找到一颗新的星球进行入侵：繁华的都市星球“奥科诺”。但现在一群意想不到的市民正在进行还击。在外星高能伪装战斗服的加持下，他们将为被“梅佐拉克斯”偷走的生命进行复仇，并彻底结束他的统治。

nameZh: 魔女 卡西奥佩娅 贪婪
descriptionZh: 它们来到卡西奥佩娅身边，如同雾中之影——银白眼镜蛇之形，从无数远古逝者的坟墓中滑出。 她现在追猎着人类的各个掌权家族，她的雕塑花园里到处都是任性的灵魂——他们曾经过于远离城墙的安全，现在则被永恒地冻结在恐怖的困境中。
descriptionEn: They came to Cassiopeia as a shadow within the fog—the shape of the Silver Cobra, slithering up from the numberless graves of the ancient dead. She now stalks the ruling families of humankind, her sculpture garden full of wayward souls who strayed too far from the safety of castle walls, now eternally frozen in the throes of terror.
heroNameZh: 魔蛇之拥 卡西奥佩娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 女巫们蛰伏以待，一个充满了骇人美貌的姐妹会，她们的希望从不再神圣的双唇中低语而出。她们谈到了古神们的膨胀尸体，谈到了用人类早已遗忘的魔法进行的古老仪式，谈到了她们所谓的“秩序”的回归，但也有人称之为“苦难”。听！人类的末日即将来临。

They speak of the bloating corpses of Old Gods, of ancient rites carried out with magics long forgotten to mortal mind, of the return of what they call "order", but others call "suffering". Hark! Mankind's end fast approaches.

Centuries later, they stand, the only hope against the rising Coven's darkness.

nameZh: 魔女 伊芙琳 贪婪
descriptionZh: 南方的魔女们加入了她们的姐妹们，一起迎接伟大的复活，古旧之物再一次蠢蠢欲动，并且古老的积怨最终得到了全额回报。 大鹞鹰神的女儿伊芙琳欣然加入了她的姐妹们，一起迎接黑暗的到来——她的苏醒总是伴随着一条残酷和死亡的踪迹。
descriptionEn: The covens of the south join their sisters for the great resurrection, as old things stir once more, and old grudges are at last repaid in full. Evelynn, daughter of the Great Harrier, gladly joins her sisters for the darkness to come—a trail of brutality and death always in her wake.

nameZh: 魔女 辛德拉 贪婪
descriptionZh: 它们来到辛德拉身边，在腐肉飞翼雷鸣般的扑动中，召唤她从凡性的桎梏中自我解脱。跟随飞翼的污风来到一个仪式场所，她和另一个女巫一起将“长角王”从他的腐烂坟墓中唤醒。她现在力求对所有反对魔女集会或古神的人进行报复。
descriptionEn: They came to Syndra in a thundering flutter of carrion wings, beckoning her to free herself from the limitations of mortals. Following the wings' foul wind to a ritual site, she along with another witch awakened the Horned King from his putrid tomb. She now seeks retribution against all who stand against the Coven or the Old Gods.

nameZh: 魔女 伊莉丝 贪婪
descriptionZh: 它们很久前来到伊莉丝身边，从灌木丛中爬过，它们的许多眼睛与她的眼睛锁定，好似达成了协议。用一位古神的深不可测的力量，换取她的献祭和人性。伊莉丝以一位蜘蛛神的形象重生，在永恒之森的边缘徘徊，引诱那些愚蠢到相信她只是民间故事的人前往他们的尽头。
descriptionEn: They came to Elise long ago, crawling through the underbrush, their many eyes locked with hers as a deal was made. The unfathomable powers of an Old God for her devotion and humanity. Reborn in the image of an arachnoid deity, Elise lingers along the edges of the Elderwood, enticing to their doom all those foolish enough to believe her a mere folktale.

nameZh: 魔女 艾希 贪婪
descriptionZh: 它们来到艾希身边，带着深切的寒意——黑山羊身上的霜冻，将整个世界都掩埋在寒冰中。 她从山上下来并随身带来了一个令人痛苦的冬天……但这并不是跟随艾希进入黑夜的唯一事物。 那座山本身在隆隆作响。
descriptionEn: They came to Ashe in a bone-deep chill—the frost of the Jet-Black Ibex, entombing the world in ice. She descended the mountain and brought a harrowing winter with her… but that is not the only thing that followed Ashe into the night. The mountain itself rumbles.

nameZh: 莲华温泉 芸阿娜 星回
descriptionZh: 芸阿娜的使命感吞噬了她，让她的身心越来越紧张。她的好友阿狸知道，只有一件事可以缓解这种紧张情绪：莲华温泉的神奇蒸汽。尽管芸阿娜有些犹豫，但她最终还是接受了，以便拓展自己的思维并思考下一步该做什么。
descriptionEn: Yunara's sense of purpose consumes her, tensing her body and mind with an ever-tightening grip. Her friend Ahri knew only one thing could relieve such tension: the magical steam of Spirit Blossom Springs. Though Yunara was hesitant, she ultimately accepted, in order to expand her mind and meditate on what's next.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在高山之上，有一家神奇的温泉馆，能为客人消解一切的世间烦恼。这家店名叫“莲华温泉”，是一片祥和、疗愈的绿洲。热情的工作人员和神奇的蒸汽会洗去战争的负担和那些“忘掉反而最好”的记忆。这里没有英雄或反派——只有得到充分休息并焕发活力的客人。
skinSets.descriptionEn: High in the mountains lies a bathhouse where guests go to melt away their worldly cares. This themed retreat, called "Spirit Blossom Springs," is an oasis free of drama. Its welcoming staff and magical steam wash away the burdens of battle and memories best forgotten. There are no heroes or villains here—only the restful and the rejuvenated.

universes.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
universes.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 莲华温泉 芸阿娜 春晓
descriptionZh: 芸阿娜的使命感吞噬了她，让她的身心越来越紧张。她的好友阿狸知道，只有一件事可以缓解这种紧张情绪：莲华温泉的神奇蒸汽。尽管芸阿娜有些犹豫，但她最终还是接受了，以便拓展自己的思维并思考下一步该做什么。

nameZh: 战斗学院 霞 雄狮
descriptionZh: 巴比隆学院的神之武器选择了霞带领学校队伍参加今年的跨学院锦标赛——他们从未在这个赛事上赢过。身为战斗俱乐部的部长，她很高兴能利用自己的新影响力来指挥队友，并享受这段与洛一起的“假期”，尽管她永远不会承认自己喜欢当领导者。
descriptionEn: Babylon Academy's God-Weapon chose Xayah to lead the school's team in this year's cross-academy tournament, which they've never won. As captain of the Battle Club, she's happy to use her new leverage to boss around her teammates and savor the “vacation” with Rakan, though she'll never admit she enjoys being a leader.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在这些院校中，只有强者才能生存。尽管它们的成立是为了纪念它们的神之武器，但每个学院的学生都在通往荣耀的道路上努力使它的力量成为自己的力量。无论它是在课堂，还是在战场，都在主导着竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: At these institutions, only the strong survive. Though they were founded to honor their God Weapon, the students at each academy strive to make its strength their own on their path to glory. Whether it's the classroom, or the battlefield, dominate the competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 散布在全球各地的神之武器将社会变成了一个由力量驱动的社会。这些有感知力的碑石召唤着那些配得上的人，并将其礼物赠予其主体，打算在这个饱受战争蹂躏的世界中扩张其征服之地。被选中是一种荣誉勋章，向任何可能反对他们的人灌输恐惧。
universes.descriptionEn: Scattered across the globe, the God Weapons morphed society into one driven by power. These sentient monuments call to those who are worthy and bestow their gifts upon their subjects, aiming to expand their conquest in this war-torn world. To be chosen is a badge of honor, instilling fear into any who may oppose them.

nameZh: 心之钢 厄斐琉斯 天纵才华
descriptionZh: 厄斐琉斯是一位精通多种乐器的音乐天才，对自己技艺的热情近乎于痴迷，是心之钢的作曲家和创意骨干。尽管厄斐琉斯很少说话，但有这支由音乐怪咖们组成的狂野乐队和他的双胞胎妹妹（乐队的经理拉露恩）在他身边，他已经准备好让他的创作之声被响亮而清晰地听到。
descriptionEn: A multi-instrumental musical genius whose passion for his craft is nigh obsessive, Aphelios is the composer and creative backbone of HEARTSTEEL.  Though he rarely ever speaks, with this wild band of musical misfits and his twin sister (the band's manager Alune) by his side, Aphelios is ready to have his creative voice heard loud and clear.
heroNameZh: 残月之肃 厄斐琉斯
heroNameEn: the Weapon of the Faithful Aphelios

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 玉剑传说 琴仙子 青竹
descriptionZh: 作为炽血派刚刚得道的仙子，琴仙子的威能在于从混乱的嘈杂中寻获和谐。 对她来说，得道成仙只能通过找到与同胞的和谐相处来实现，因此她将她的学生视为仙音妙律中不可或缺的强音。 正是在这种共同的热情中，一切皆有可能。
descriptionEn: As a newly immortal member of the Radiant Passion School, Sona's power is in building harmony from dissonance. To her, immortality only comes through finding your shared harmony with your fellow people, and she sees her students as strong notes to be built into immortal chords. It is in this shared passion that makes anything possible.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 腥红之月 婕拉 鹤雪
descriptionZh: 当许多腥红之月女祭司遵从她们魔鬼的低语时，婕拉的那个魔鬼发出的却是欢愉的嚎叫——而婕拉也以同样的方式回应。婕拉和她的魔鬼出于对堕落的渴望而联合起来，寻找她的女祭司同伴，以便将她们团结为一个整体。只有这样，她们才能将她们的毁灭之举散播到艾欧尼亚边界以外的世界。
descriptionEn: While many Blood Moon priestesses follow the whispers of their demons, Zyra's demon howls with sadistic glee—and Zyra responds in kind. United in their thirst for corruption, Zyra and her demon seek out her fellow priestesses in order to unite them all as one. Only then can they spread their destruction to the world beyond Ionia's borders.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 一个远古教派，寻求着不可抗拒的力量，总在血月之夜现身实行亵渎、秘传的仪式——用恶灵融合他们的肉身，并变成一个拥有恒增黑暗的存在。
skinSets.descriptionEn: An ancient cult, seeking irresistible power, surfaces on nights of the Blood Moon to perform profane, esoteric rites—merging their flesh with demonic spirits, and becoming one with an ever greater darkness.

universes.descriptionZh: 一个声音从寂静中回响：“翻腾吧，野兽们，教友们。艾欧尼亚在劫难逃，它的诸多月亮像饥饿的恶魔的眼睛一样升起，等待着你们忠诚的红色——抑或它们是无法越过的可怕荒芜？ 无论是哪种方式，我们都是沉浸在仪式和献祭中的躯壳。在月亮的顶峰，我们从肉中切肉，献上微薄的礼物——我们自身的一切。”
universes.descriptionEn: A voice echoes from the silence: “Writhe, beasts, brethren. The moons of a doomed Ionia rise like eyes of starved demons, awaiting the red of your fealty—or are they monstrous blights that cannot pass? Either way, we are vessels plunged in ritual and sacrifice. At the moon's peak, we carve flesh from flesh, offering the meager gift of all that we are.”

nameZh: 慧理之贤 阿萝拉 均衡
descriptionZh: 低位世界的人们将阿萝拉视作大图书馆中的古怪学者，她徘徊流连于其间，只为探究寓言中的图案所隐藏的此世运转之奥理。高位世界的人们则将阿萝拉视作“双界之巫女”，只有极少数高位世界的命运之子能够洞悉到蕴含着魔力的万物内中隐藏的传送门，她正是其中之一。她利用能力在两个世界镜像对称的轴线上来回穿梭，游历于诸城之间。无论上界，或是下界。
descriptionEn: Those below know Aurora as an eccentric academic at the Grand Library, wandering off to study the mysterious workings of the fabled Pattern. Those above know Aurora as the Witch Betwixt, one of the few Higher Arcana able to find portals hidden within the magic of all things, and travel the cities across their mirroring axis. As above, so below.

universes.descriptionZh: 在命运位面上方的高空中，命运之子们，那些自我塑造现实的鲜活图案们，奋力地在他们下方的混沌之上勾勒着他们的愿景。命运之子们从下界位面中招募有感知力的公民来增幅他们的隐藏图案——有越多人放大一位命运之子的图案，这个位面就越能反映出这位命运之子的宏伟设计。
universes.descriptionEn: High above Arcana, the Archetypes, living patterns that shape reality itself, struggle to trace their vision upon the chaos below them. The Archetypes recruit perceptive citizens of the world below to amplify their hidden patterns—and the more who magnify an Archetype's pattern, the more the world reflects their grand design.

nameZh: 踏雪寻梅 杰斯 琼英缀雪
descriptionZh: 对于追求知识的凡人来说，杰斯是他们最高理想的一个具象化身。对于他的剪枝师同伴来说，他是一位坚定的导师，用他那根注入了霜火之力的法杖扫除了这个神话花园中的腐化之物。杰斯深知，成长——无论是植物的还是照料它们的双手的——都源于坚定不移的奉献精神，而他的工作也证明了这一点。
descriptionEn: To mortals who seek knowledge, Jayce is a manifestation of their highest aspirations. To his  fellow pruners, he is a steadfast mentor, sweeping away the mythical garden's corruption with his Frostpyre-imbued staff. Jayce knows that growth—whether it's plants or the hands that tend them—springs forth from unwavering dedication, and his work attests to it.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在精神领域的深处，有一个神话花园，其中的每一株植物都具象化了凡间的希望、梦想和苦难。园丁们以神圣的关怀照料它，修剪掉悲伤并培育新的花朵。如果一切顺利，霜火花就会盛开——预示着积雪即将融化——并且​​春天就会回归，为花园和凡界带来生机。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Deep within the spirit realm lies a garden of myth, where each plant embodies mortal hopes, dreams, and suffering. Gardeners tend to it with sacred care, pruning sorrow and nurturing new blossoms. If all goes well, the Frostpyre flowers bloom—signaling the coming melt of snow—and Spring returns, bringing life back to both the garden and the mortal world.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 龙马烈焰 萨勒芬妮 马到成功
descriptionZh: 春节庆典的主要看点是萨勒芬妮。她以迷人的魅力征服了观众们，鼓舞并凝聚了他们的心。她的迷人旋律，加上每次新年庆典中心的喧闹人群和精彩烟花，让年味变得更浓了。当这位明星登上舞台的那一刻，庆典才算真正地开始了！
descriptionEn: The main attraction of the Lunar Revel, Seraphine mesmerizes onlookers, uplifting and uniting their hearts. Her melodies serve as the perfect complement to the rambunctious crowds and booming fireworks at the center of every New Year festival. The celebration truly begins when this star takes the stage!
heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

skinSets.descriptionZh: 春节到了——派对也到了！家人朋友聚在一起，共同享用美食与佳节时光。现在，点燃一根火柴，然后观看焰火吧！
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Lunar New Year has arrived—and so has the party! With food and festivities to spare, it's all about ringing it in with friends and family. Now strike up a match and watch the fireworks!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。

skinNameZh: 龙马烈焰 萨勒芬妮

nameZh: 龙马烈焰 艾希 紫气东来
descriptionZh: 艾希优雅、自律、沉着冷静——但春节期间除外。那时的她会变本加厉！这种热闹气氛能让她放松心情，并且今年她将带来一场盛大的终场演出，而这场演出注定会点亮夜空，照亮新的一年。
descriptionEn: Ashe is elegant, disciplined, and unshakably calm—except during the Lunar Revel, when she's all that and more! The lively atmosphere has a way of loosening her bowstring, and this year she's unleashing a grand finale destined to light up the sky and the new year ahead.

nameZh: 踏雪寻梅 莉莉娅 竹映梅香
descriptionZh: 莉莉娅被新春使者选中守护灵界的神圣花园，并且自豪地履行着自己的职责。她勤恳地在植物丛中穿行，劝说每一朵花蕾重新绽放，用每一颗发芽的种子治愈凡界。她知道，她的职责会在严酷寒冬平息下来后完成——并且这时新春使者会回来使这些大地重获新生！
descriptionEn: Chosen by the Herald of Spring to watch over the spirit realm's sacred garden, Lillia upholds her duty with pride. As she diligently trots among the botanicals, she coaxes each bud to bloom anew, healing the mortal realm with every sprouting seed. She knows her duty is done when the cruel winter subsides—and the Herald returns to renew the lands!

nameZh: 踏雪寻梅 亚索 竹映梅香
descriptionZh: 独自一人，在霜火花园的最远边缘徘徊着的，正是亚索。他手持酷热与严寒之风，与由凡人们最黑暗记忆化成的骇人具象化身们战斗，同时又饱受他的前世记忆的折磨。他向往春天——因为当他的职责完成时，他就可以休息，并再次与他的友好竞争对手——卡特琳娜——切磋了。
descriptionEn: Alone, wandering at the farthest edges of the Frostpyre Garden, is Yasuo. Armed with winds of blistering heat and cold, he battles the monstrous manifestations of mortals' darkest memories, meanwhile haunted by memories of his former life. He yearns for spring—for when his duty is done, he may rest and spar once again with his friendly rival, Katarina.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在精神领域的深处，有一个神话花园，其中的每一株植物都具象化了凡间的希望、梦想和苦难。园丁们以神圣的关怀照料它，修剪掉悲伤并培育新的花朵。如果一切顺利，霜火花就会盛开——预示着积雪即将融化——并且​​春天就会回归，为花园和凡界带来生机。

nameZh: 踏雪寻梅 卡特琳娜 竹映梅香
descriptionZh: 在花园的中心，卡特琳娜挥舞着她的双刃，将即使是从最痛苦的记忆中孕育的植物，塑造成充满希望和吉兆的繁茂植景亭。如果某个神秘生物悄悄溜过了她的剪枝师同伴——亚索——的防御，那么她的双刃也未尝不利。通过切除枯枝，她带来了春天的新生吉兆。
descriptionEn: In the heart of the garden, Katarina flourishes her twin blades, shaping plants born from even the most painful memories into bountiful arbors of hope and promise. Her blades are equally as capable in battle, should a shadowy creature sneak past the defenses of her fellow pruner, Yasuo. By cutting away blight, she ushers in spring's promise of renewal.
heroNameZh: 不祥之刃 卡特琳娜

nameZh: 踏雪寻梅 卡蜜尔 绛萼著霜
descriptionZh: 卡蜜尔曾经是一个具象化身，由某个饱受战祸的凡界中的悲痛与苦难化成，但被霜火花园的耕耘者们净化，并变成了一名园丁。她的利刃——最初是由激烈冲突的记忆锻造而成——现在被用来修剪和维护整个植物群落的自然美丽，同时她也在帮忙迎接春天的到来。
descriptionEn: Camille was once a manifestation of the war-torn mortal realm's pain and suffering, but was cleansed by the cultivators of the Frostpyre Garden and transformed into a gardener herself. Her blades—first forged from memories of bloody conflicts and clashes—are now used to prune and maintain the flora's natural beauty as she helps prepare the way for spring.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 龙马烈焰 波比 马到成功
descriptionZh: 波比挥舞着她那巨大的节日鼓，确保最吵闹的节日参与者们都能遵守规矩。当她不在保镖岗位上执勤时，她就会以她自己的鼓点来跳舞，并鼓舞她的好友们加入进来。随着新一年的即将到来，还有很多事情要庆祝呢！
descriptionEn: Wielding her giant festival drum, Poppy keeps the rowdiest festivalgoers in line. When she's not on bodyguard duty, she's dancing to the beat of her own drum and inspiring her friends to join the fun. With a new year ahead, there's plenty to celebrate!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 春节到了——派对也到了！家人朋友聚在一起，共同享用美食与佳节时光。现在，点燃一根火柴，然后观看焰火吧！
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Lunar New Year has arrived—and so has the party! With food and festivities to spare, it's all about ringing it in with friends and family. Now strike up a match and watch the fireworks!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。

nameZh: 龙马烈焰 悠米 马到成功
descriptionZh: 如果没有像悠米这样的可爱吉祥物，春节庆典就不算完整！她兴致勃勃地与各种参会游客们互动，走到哪就将快乐带到哪。有人说，这只神奇猫咪的到来预示着新的一年会有好运。
descriptionEn: No Lunar Revel celebration is complete without an adorable mascot like Yuumi! Playfully attaching to various festival attendees, she spreads joy wherever she travels. Some say a visit from this magical cat is a sign of good luck for the new year.

nameZh: 龙马烈焰 凯特琳 马到成功
descriptionZh: 凯特琳用她标志性的精准，精心策划了今年庆祝活动的每一个细节，甚至包括邀请她最喜欢的明星歌手来为大家表演。现在，她已经准备好确保让活动没有故障地进行，但一旦狂欢开始，凯特琳就会彻底放手——这可是难得一见的景象，并且她很可能在之后会予以否认。
descriptionEn: Using her signature precision, Caitlyn planned every detail of this year's celebration, down to securing her favorite star singer for all to enjoy. Now she's ready to keep the events running without a hitch, but once the revelry gets going, Caitlyn lets loose—a rare sight, and one she'd probably deny later.

nameZh: 龙马烈焰 艾希 马到成功
descriptionZh: 艾希优雅、自律、沉着冷静——但春节期间除外。那时的她会变本加厉！这种热闹气氛能让她放松心情，并且今年她将带来一场盛大的终场演出，而这场演出注定会点亮夜空，照亮新的一年。
descriptionEn: Ashe is elegant, disciplined, and unshakably calm—except during the Lunar Revel, when she's all that and more! The lively atmosphere has a way of loosening her bowstring, and this year she's unleashing a grand finale destined to light up the sky and the new year ahead.

nameZh: 剪纸仙灵 烬 喜气洋洋
descriptionZh: 在月之舞者们扭曲剪纸仙境之后，烬是卡西奥佩娅的第一个造物。他体现了神话之蛇最阴险的那些品质：阴险、算计和恶意。烬对这位女神仁慈的行事方式感到不满，打算以自己的形象重建人类，并让他们感受苦难之美。
descriptionEn: Jhin is the first of Cassiopeia's creations after the Lunar Players distort the world of myth. He embodies the mythical snake's most insidious qualities: sinister, calculating, and malicious. Displeased with the goddess's benevolent methods, Jhin plans to recreate humanity in his image and introduce them to the beauty of suffering.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，大年兽加里奥的失败让春节的新年传统得以兴盛，并且这些传统通过重述那个史诗故事而得以延续。这个故事本身就是一个活生生的世界——但当这个故事世界被突然扰打断时，故事中的各个角色必须共同努力来解决这个乱局，并书写他们自己的神话。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, the defeat of the Great Beast Galio gave rise to Lunar New Year traditions that are carried on through the retelling of that epic tale. Within the story itself lies a living world all its own—but when the world of the story is suddenly interrupted, the characters must work together to fix the mess and see their own myth through.

universes.descriptionZh: 故事、神话、传说：每个人都有一个自己的世界，在这个世界里，在讲述和重述角色们的故事时，这些角色会一遍又一遍地经历着考验和磨难。
universes.descriptionEn: Stories, myths, legends: within each lies a world unto itself, where characters act out their trials and tribulations over and over as their tales are told and retold.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 婕拉 星回
descriptionZh: 从前，有位女子拥有一颗已经破碎的心，她渴望忘记自己的悲伤。一个强大的灵体被她的困境所感动，满足了她的愿望。女子的泪水化为花朵，在她的身体里生根发芽，“忘忧花园”由此诞生。如今，疲惫的心灵们走进它的怀抱，希望这些花朵能够减轻它们的悲伤。
descriptionEn: Once, there was a woman with a broken heart who longed to forget her sorrow. A powerful spirit, moved by her plight, granted her wish. The woman's tears turned to blossoms, her body took root, and the Garden of Forgetting was born. Now, weary hearts wander into its embrace, hoping the blooms will ease their grief.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 伊芙琳 绽夜
descriptionZh: 在饱受痛苦与恐惧折磨时，凡人们可以向“苦噬之灵”祈愿，以期缓解自身的重负。然而每份赠礼后面都暗藏着代价：其中就有一个故事，说一名女子的情感过于沉重，于是被恶魔盯上了。“苦噬之灵”提出，她可以尽情吞噬其欲望与记忆。当她饱足之时，女人陷入了永久的静谧——痛苦消失了，但随之而去的还有一切的悲喜。
descriptionEn: Mortals burdened by pain and fear may pray to the Sorrow Eater to alleviate their burdens. But every gift comes at a price. One tale recounts a woman whose weighty emotions had made her the prey of demonkin. The Sorrow Eater offered to dine freely on her desires and memories—and when she was sated, the woman was at peace, free of pain…and of feeling.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 艾希 风起
descriptionZh: 据“迷途女王”的神话讲述，她的好奇心促使她与“林母”交换了位置。这个选择的代价是高昂的，她回来后看到她忠诚的“玉手剑侍”与“林母”陷入了战斗。她扑到他们中间，死在了“玉手剑侍”的怀里，并且她的遗言是一个道歉。现在，她在荒野里游荡，指引着迷途者们。
descriptionEn: Myth tells of the Wandering Queen, whose curiosity led her to trade places with the Grovemother. The cost of this choice was high, and she returned to see her loyal Ready Hand and the Grovemother locked in combat. Throwing herself between them, she died in the Ready Hand's arms, her final words an apology. Now she roams the wilds, guiding the lost.

nameZh: 天龙之子 黛安娜 金龙纳福
descriptionZh: 龙之王国的图书馆是保存历代智慧之作的档案馆：也是由宫廷学者黛安娜保管的藏品。她是一位狂热的学者和战士，陪伴龙太子踏上旅程，记录龙与人类之间历史性的第一次相遇。
descriptionEn: The library of the Kingdom of Dragons is an illustrious archive of wisdom from ages past: a collection kept by Diana, scholar of the court. A fierce academic as well as a fighter, she accompanies the prince on his journey to document this historical first encounter between dragons and humans.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 盒子猫 萨科 粉衣青喵喵
descriptionZh: 咪嗷呜。嘶嘶嘶。喵呜。咕噜噜。
descriptionEn: MrrRRRrrowwww. Hhhiiisssss. Meow. Purrrrr.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 世界上已知的最古老的竞争：人类最好的朋友对抗互联网上最伟大的英雄。只有一个阵营会从猫狗之间的激烈战斗中获胜。希望他们的皮毛不要太脏：唯一比失败更糟糕的就是洗澡了。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The oldest rivalry the world has ever known: man's best friend pitted against the internet's greatest heroes. Only one faction will emerge victorious from the gnawing maw of battle between cats and dogs. Hopefully they don't get their fur too dirty: the only thing worse than losing is bathtime.

universes.descriptionZh: 世界上已知的最古老的竞争：人类最好的朋友对抗互联网上最伟大的英雄。只有一个阵营会从猫狗之间的激烈战斗中获胜。希望他们的皮毛不要太脏：唯一比失败更糟糕的就是洗澡了。

Only one faction will emerge victorious from the gnawing maw of battle between cats and dogs. Hopefully they don't get their fur too dirty: the only thing worse than losing is bathtime.

nameZh: 北极星守望者 佐伊 七彩光斑
descriptionZh: 不耐烦的“守望者”佐伊阔步从还在等待的“圣贤”身边走过，提出她的请求。每个人都仰仗着她的羊群和庄稼，并且她的收获将是极光的赐福所无法相比的。北极星考虑了三位统领的意愿，挥手将极光幻化为两个形状：一个长满牙齿和皮毛的强健体魄，以及一个不知疲倦、面带微笑的士兵。
descriptionEn: An impatient Warden Zoe strode past the waiting Sage to make her plea. Everyone relied on her flock and crops, and her harvest would be unequaled with the Aurora's blessings. Polaris considered the three leaders' wishes, and with a wave of her hand, conjured the Aurora into two shapes: a sinewy mass of teeth and fur, and a tireless, smiling soldier.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当空气变得清新，第一场雪飘落时，看向天空，北极星就会出现。不要害怕，如果你不计回报地行善，你可能会获得极光赐福作为奖励。但请记住：无论你怎么做，你都不能把你的好运视为理所当然，因为北极星每年都会来，没有人能逃脱惩罚。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When the air grows crisp and the first snow falls, look to the sky, for Polaris will appear. Do not be afraid, for if you've been virtuous without expectation, you might be rewarded with the Aurora's blessings. But remember: no matter how you act, you cannot take your fortunes for granted, because Polaris comes every year, and no one escapes punishment.

universes.descriptionZh: 你可曾听过极光的那些传说？它们可能寒冷和黑暗，但如果你足够勇敢，你就会发现超乎你梦想的温暖和威严。所以坐在火炉旁，来听听这些北极光的传说……
universes.descriptionEn: Have you heard the stories of the Aurora? Cold and dark they can be, but if you're brave enough you'll find warmth and majesty grander than any dream you've had. So sit yourself by the fire and come listen to these Tales of Borealis...

skinNameZh: 北极星守望者 佐伊

nameZh: 玉剑传说 无劫 珠光
descriptionZh: 当无劫得道成仙并开始将目光投向其他领域时，新的野心油然而生：开悟无处不在，所以他也必须无处不在。 在发现他的探索后，天目派驱逐了他。不过，无劫并不在意，因为他发现了一种新的魔道威能，可使他无所不在、无所不知。
descriptionEn: When Zed became immortal and began studying the other realms, a new desire took hold: knowledge was everywhere, so he needed to BE everywhere. Upon discovering his explorations, the Grounded Foresight School banished him. Zed doesn't care, though, for he's found a new demonic power, allowing him to be everywhere and all-knowing.
heroNameZh: 蛮族之王 泰达米尔

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 莲华温泉 阿狸 雪落
descriptionZh: 作为灵魂莲华温泉浴场的主人和经营者，阿狸将她最喜欢的山变成了一个隐藏的绿洲。她深刻理解休息带来的能量，尽情享受生活中最丰富的滋味——每一次都是一段美妙记忆。只有既敏锐又善良的人才能应付她的那些朝气蓬勃的客人们。
descriptionEn: Owner and proprietor of the Spirit Blossom Springs bathhouse, Ahri has turned her favorite mountain into a hidden oasis. Wielding a keen understanding of the power of rest, she indulges her appetite for life's richest flavors—one memory at a time. Only one with a sharp yet kindhearted wit could handle her guests' spirited dispositions.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在高山之上，有一家神奇的温泉馆，能为客人消解一切的世间烦恼。这家店名叫“莲华温泉”，是一片祥和、疗愈的绿洲。热情的工作人员和神奇的蒸汽会洗去战争的负担和那些“忘掉反而最好”的记忆。这里没有英雄或反派——只有得到充分休息并焕发活力的客人。
skinSets.descriptionEn: High in the mountains lies a bathhouse where guests go to melt away their worldly cares. This themed retreat, called "Spirit Blossom Springs," is an oasis free of drama. Its welcoming staff and magical steam wash away the burdens of battle and memories best forgotten. There are no heroes or villains here—only the restful and the rejuvenated.

universes.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
universes.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 艾希 雁来
descriptionZh: 据“迷途女王”的神话讲述，她的好奇心促使她与“林母”交换了位置。这个选择的代价是高昂的，她回来后看到她忠诚的“玉手剑侍”与“林母”陷入了战斗。她扑到他们中间，死在了“玉手剑侍”的怀里，并且她的遗言是一个道歉。现在，她在荒野里游荡，指引着迷途者们。
descriptionEn: Myth tells of the Wandering Queen, whose curiosity led her to trade places with the Grovemother. The cost of this choice was high, and she returned to see her loyal Ready Hand and the Grovemother locked in combat. Throwing herself between them, she died in the Ready Hand's arms, her final words an apology. Now she roams the wilds, guiding the lost.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 辛德拉 春晓
descriptionZh: 寻求自由的人们总会向迷途魂灵的救主——“自在之灵”献上祈祷。其中一个故事讲的是，一棵树的根须缠住了一个游荡的灵魂。那精魂徒劳无功地挣扎着。此时“自在之灵”突然现身，帮它撕裂了紧缚的根须。她注视着精魂重获自由——据说与她相遇者，都能获得这样的祝福。
descriptionEn: Those who seek freedom may offer prayers to the Fluttering Joy, a savior of lost souls. One story recounts a tree that wrapped its roots around a wandering wisp. The wisp struggled in vain, until the spirit tore away the roots that bound it tight. She watched as the wisp tasted freedom again—a blessing she is said to bestow upon all she meets.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
