nameZh: 莲华温泉 娑娜 春晓
descriptionZh: 娑娜为灵魂莲华温泉的“明昼体验”奠定了舒缓的基调。她迷人的旋律与桑拿的柔和蒸汽相结合，可以放松任何肌肉或心灵。她白天的音乐浴总能吸引大批观众，但只有在她独家的晚间表演中才能真正看到她的音乐才能——前提是做好了觉悟。
descriptionEn: Sona sets the soothing tone for the Kanmei Experience at Spirit Blossom Springs. Her enchanting melodies combined with the sauna's gentle steam can relax any muscle or mind. Her daytime soundbaths never fail to draw a crowd, but it is her exclusive evening shows where her musical prowess can truly be seen—if one is ready, that is.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在高山之上，有一家神奇的温泉馆，能为客人消解一切的世间烦恼。这家店名叫“莲华温泉”，是一片祥和、疗愈的绿洲。热情的工作人员和神奇的蒸汽会洗去战争的负担和那些“忘掉反而最好”的记忆。这里没有英雄或反派——只有得到充分休息并焕发活力的客人。

universes.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 北极星守望者 佐伊 聪颖光弧
descriptionZh: 不耐烦的“守望者”佐伊阔步从还在等待的“圣贤”身边走过，提出她的请求。每个人都仰仗着她的羊群和庄稼，并且她的收获将是极光的赐福所无法相比的。北极星考虑了三位统领的意愿，挥手将极光幻化为两个形状：一个长满牙齿和皮毛的强健体魄，以及一个不知疲倦、面带微笑的士兵。
descriptionEn: An impatient Warden Zoe strode past the waiting Sage to make her plea. Everyone relied on her flock and crops, and her harvest would be unequaled with the Aurora's blessings. Polaris considered the three leaders' wishes, and with a wave of her hand, conjured the Aurora into two shapes: a sinewy mass of teeth and fur, and a tireless, smiling soldier.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当空气变得清新，第一场雪飘落时，看向天空，北极星就会出现。不要害怕，如果你不计回报地行善，你可能会获得极光赐福作为奖励。但请记住：无论你怎么做，你都不能把你的好运视为理所当然，因为北极星每年都会来，没有人能逃脱惩罚。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When the air grows crisp and the first snow falls, look to the sky, for Polaris will appear. Do not be afraid, for if you've been virtuous without expectation, you might be rewarded with the Aurora's blessings. But remember: no matter how you act, you cannot take your fortunes for granted, because Polaris comes every year, and no one escapes punishment.

universes.descriptionZh: 你可曾听过极光的那些传说？它们可能寒冷和黑暗，但如果你足够勇敢，你就会发现超乎你梦想的温暖和威严。所以坐在火炉旁，来听听这些北极光的传说……
universes.descriptionEn: Have you heard the stories of the Aurora? Cold and dark they can be, but if you're brave enough you'll find warmth and majesty grander than any dream you've had. So sit yourself by the fire and come listen to these Tales of Borealis...

skinNameZh: 北极星守望者 佐伊

nameZh: 点心宝贝 萨勒芬妮 黑枣冰糖葫芦
descriptionZh: 萨勒芬妮是一位双栖艺人，既会唱歌又会做饭，让餐馆的客人们感到既暖心又暖胃。她说，为美食而到来，为旋律而驻足！她的梦想是成为餐馆的明星，让厨师和顾客都为之着迷。
descriptionEn: Seraphine's a double threat who sings and cooks, leaving the cafe's guests swooning and sated in equal measure. Come for the treats, she says, stay for the tunes! Her dream is to become the cafe's star attraction, enchanting chefs and customers alike.
heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

skinSets.descriptionZh: 任何一位出色的糕点大师都知道，没有美味佳肴的聚会就不是完整的聚会。虽然他们的参观可能是新的，但做点心的艺术却不是——并且这些神奇的厨师愿意通过揉、剁、煎、蒸等方式打造出色香味俱全的美食。只需咬一口这些美味的面团，即使是脾气最暴躁的顾客也会迫切想要当场入座然后大饱口福。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Any pastry mage worth their salt knows no get-together is complete without savory treats. Though their cafe may be new, the art of making dumplings isn't—and these magical chefs are willing to knead, chop, fry, and steam their way to culinary greatness. Just one bite of these doughy delights will make even the grumpiest patron eager to pull up a chair and celebrate.

skinNameZh: 点心宝贝 萨勒芬妮

nameZh: 幽梦玫瑰 伊莉丝 纯洁花蕾
descriptionZh: 尽管从未收到过正式邀请，但伊莉丝每年都会出席。有传言说，她因在一个晚上的时间里因为编造谎言、结成和解散各种誓约而被列入黑名单。与会者还指出，她的追求者们似乎在之后从未再次拜访过这个庆典。
descriptionEn: Elise is in attendance at every annual gala, despite never once receiving a formal invitation. Rumor has it she's been blacklisted for spinning webs of lies, forming and disbanding allegiances in the span of a single evening. Attendees have also noted her suitors never seem to make a return visit to the festival.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 水晶玫瑰节庆欢迎所有相信其和平明天梦想的人，尽管许多人已经对这个事业不再抱有幻想。那些组成幽梦玫瑰的人希望看到它结束。但没有人能对节日的魅力免疫；或许他们也会被傍晚的美景卷入其中并改变心意。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Crystal Rose Festival welcomes all who believe in its dream of a peaceful tomorrow, though many have grown disenchanted with the whole affair. Those who make up the Withered Rose wish to see it come to an end. But no one is immune to the festival's charm; perhaps they too will be swept away by the evening's beauty and have a change of heart.

universes.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，充满了经常破裂的魔法同盟和数百年积怨。而每年一度的水晶玫瑰节庆，则为强者们提供了一个中立的场所，来原谅彼此的怠慢并重新协商停战协议。大家会做做样子似的把武器留在门口，并通过采摘和佩戴只有在节庆期间生长的魔法玫瑰来示意有潜在的全新契约。
universes.descriptionEn: In a world of frequently-broken magical alliances and centuries-old grudges, the annual Crystal Rose Festival offers a neutral ground for the powerful to forgive slights and renegotiate truces. Weapons are ostensibly left at the door, and potential new pacts are signaled by picking and wearing the magical roses that grow only during the festival.

nameZh: 心之钢 瑟提 金声玉振
descriptionZh: 别让这些轮廓分明的腹肌欺骗了你：凭借精明的风格和多年来支持母亲的辛勤工作磨炼出来的一颗金子般的心，瑟提已经颇具说唱歌手自信的范儿了。他的上一次音乐生涯因殴打狗仔队而结束，但他不会受制于人。人们对瑟提的称呼有很多，但当他在心之钢的舞台上时，你可以称他为“BOSS”。
descriptionEn: Don't let the chiseled abs fool you: With savvy style and a heart of gold tempered by years of hard work supporting his mom, Sett has earned his confident rapper's swagger. His last music career ended when he punched a paparazzo, but he won't be kept down. People call Sett a lot of things, but when he's on stage with HEARTSTEEL, you can call him “boss.”

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 战斗学院 洛 雄狮
descriptionZh: 洛之前满足于在巴比隆学院按部就班地度过校园生活。然后他在去年的舞会上看到了霞——于是就像被闪电击中了一样。现在，他有了一段火热的新恋情，他设法说服自己成为博识俱乐部的部长，这样他就可以参加比赛，看到他心爱之人最美的样子。如果他们赢了呢？那就更棒了。
descriptionEn: Rakan was content to coast his way through Babylon Academy. Then he saw Xayah at last year's prom—and it was like being struck by lightning. Now in a fiery new relationship, he's managed to talk his way into becoming captain of the Luminary Club, just so he can be at the tournament and see his love at her best. If they win? Even better.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在这些院校中，只有强者才能生存。尽管它们的成立是为了纪念它们的神之武器，但每个学院的学生都在通往荣耀的道路上努力使它的力量成为自己的力量。无论它是在课堂，还是在战场，都在主导着竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: At these institutions, only the strong survive. Though they were founded to honor their God Weapon, the students at each academy strive to make its strength their own on their path to glory. Whether it's the classroom, or the battlefield, dominate the competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 散布在全球各地的神之武器将社会变成了一个由力量驱动的社会。这些有感知力的碑石召唤着那些配得上的人，并将其礼物赠予其主体，打算在这个饱受战争蹂躏的世界中扩张其征服之地。被选中是一种荣誉勋章，向任何可能反对他们的人灌输恐惧。
universes.descriptionEn: Scattered across the globe, the God Weapons morphed society into one driven by power. These sentient monuments call to those who are worthy and bestow their gifts upon their subjects, aiming to expand their conquest in this war-torn world. To be chosen is a badge of honor, instilling fear into any who may oppose them.

nameZh: 天煞 劫 黑洞
descriptionZh: 劫曾是一位有前途的圣堂武者，然后他变成了奥能巢群意志的宿主并被灌注了它的异星精华。他现在具备将躯体变形为活体武器的能力，将自身视作完美的生命形式，应该得到所有奥能并且命中注定要清理由弱者组成的银河。
descriptionEn: Zed was a promising Templar before he became host to the hivemind of ora and imbued with its alien essence. Able to morph his body into living weapons, he now sees himself as the perfect life form, deserving of all ora and destined to cleanse the galaxy of the weak.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 从高度城市化的核心星球到银河系最外围的边缘，冒险故事在等待！伟大的德玛锡安帝国全然不顾古老的圣骑士团和犯罪辛迪加等势力的反对，追寻着神奇的奥能。这种金色的物质是所有文明的命脉，并能给掌握它的人带来无比的力量……
skinSets.descriptionEn: From the urbanized coreworlds to the outermost edge of the galaxy, adventure awaits! The great Demaxian Empire ignores the objections of the Templar Order and the criminal Syndicate alike in their pursuit of ora—a mysterious golden essence that serves as the lifeblood of all civilization, and promises untold power to those who can wield it for themselves…

universes.descriptionZh: 从高度城市化的核心星球到银河系最外围的边缘，冒险故事在等待！伟大的德玛锡安帝国全然不顾古老的圣骑士团和犯罪辛迪加等势力的反对，追寻着神奇的奥能。这种金色的物质是所有文明的命脉，并能给掌握它的人带来无比的力量……

The great Demaxian Empire ignores the objections of the Templar Order and the criminal Syndicate alike in their pursuit of ora—a mysterious golden essence that serves as the lifeblood of all civilization, and promises untold power to those who can wield it for themselves…

nameZh: 莲华温泉 芸阿娜 朝花
descriptionZh: 芸阿娜的使命感吞噬了她，让她的身心越来越紧张。她的好友阿狸知道，只有一件事可以缓解这种紧张情绪：莲华温泉的神奇蒸汽。尽管芸阿娜有些犹豫，但她最终还是接受了，以便拓展自己的思维并思考下一步该做什么。
descriptionEn: Yunara's sense of purpose consumes her, tensing her body and mind with an ever-tightening grip. Her friend Ahri knew only one thing could relieve such tension: the magical steam of Spirit Blossom Springs. Though Yunara was hesitant, she ultimately accepted, in order to expand her mind and meditate on what's next.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在高山之上，有一家神奇的温泉馆，能为客人消解一切的世间烦恼。这家店名叫“莲华温泉”，是一片祥和、疗愈的绿洲。热情的工作人员和神奇的蒸汽会洗去战争的负担和那些“忘掉反而最好”的记忆。这里没有英雄或反派——只有得到充分休息并焕发活力的客人。

Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 剪纸仙灵 婕拉 金玉满堂
descriptionZh: 婕拉是一位纸之灵，萦绕于《大年兽加里奥》的布景中，并看着故事一次又一次地展开。当月之舞者们陷入这个纸上的神话世界时，婕拉永不满足的好奇心驱使她去捕捉这些新来者，不顾一切地想在一个故事始终保持不变的世界中抓住变化和新鲜感。
descriptionEn: Zyra is a spirit of the paper, haunting the scenery of “The Great Beast Galio” and watching the story unfold again and again. When the Lunar Players fall into the paper myth-world, Zyra's insatiable curiosity drives her to capture these newcomers, desperate to hold onto change and novelty in a world where the story always remains the same.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，大年兽加里奥的失败让春节的新年传统得以兴盛，并且这些传统通过重述那个史诗故事而得以延续。这个故事本身就是一个活生生的世界——但当这个故事世界被突然扰打断时，故事中的各个角色必须共同努力来解决这个乱局，并书写他们自己的神话。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, the defeat of the Great Beast Galio gave rise to Lunar New Year traditions that are carried on through the retelling of that epic tale. Within the story itself lies a living world all its own—but when the world of the story is suddenly interrupted, the characters must work together to fix the mess and see their own myth through.

universes.descriptionZh: 故事、神话、传说：每个人都有一个自己的世界，在这个世界里，在讲述和重述角色们的故事时，这些角色会一遍又一遍地经历着考验和磨难。
universes.descriptionEn: Stories, myths, legends: within each lies a world unto itself, where characters act out their trials and tribulations over and over as their tales are told and retold.

nameZh: 天龙之子 迦娜 龙飞凤翔
descriptionZh: 迦娜是王国中最擅长魔法的龙（也许除了国王本人），能够腾云驾雾，呼风唤雨。龙太子曾经问过迦娜是否可以收他为徒，而迦娜高兴地接受了；但她期待着给他展示龙族力量更加奇思妙想的用法。毕竟，他们要去参加庆典了。
descriptionEn: Janna is the most skilled dragon in the kingdom at sorcery (save for the king himself, perhaps), whipping up winds and steering the clouds. The prince asked if she might take him on as a pupil, and Janna happily accepted; but she is looking forward to showing him more whimsical uses of their power. After all, they have a festival to attend.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 青花瓷 莫甘娜 天青
descriptionZh: 没有人比莫甘娜更了解女巫丽桑卓的力量。将丽桑卓束缚在她的圣物上的那个魔法，是有代价的：说出这段咒语的生肖神卫也会被困住。莫甘娜牺牲了自己，而她的鸡生肖圣物的双翼将她包裹在瓷茧中长达数千年。再次醒来后，她要加倍奉还。
descriptionEn: There is no one who comprehends the power of the sorceress Lissandra more than Morgana. The magic that bound Lissandra to her relic came at a cost: the protector who uttered the words would be trapped as well. Morgana made this sacrifice, the wings of her Rooster Relic wrapping her in a porcelain cocoon for millennia. Awake once more, she seeks revenge.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 社会名流 乐芙兰 郁金香魅影
descriptionZh: 乐芙兰目前正在躲避一场国际性的追捕行动，因为之前她把一架满载着乘客的喷气机弄消失了，然后意识到她根本不知道他们去哪了以及怎样把他们带回来。
descriptionEn: LeBlanc is currently evading an international manhunt after making a jet liner filled with passengers disappear, then realizing she had no idea where they went or how to bring them back.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这就是一门生计！
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's a living!

universes.descriptionZh: 磨砺之路不仅仅是工作。它是斗争，是喧嚣，有时令人振奋，有时令人沮丧。它是一个为期一周的过山车，有喜剧性的过弯和悲惨的急落，只会在周一重新开始。我们是努力工作还是几乎不工作？在磨砺之路上，一切都一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The grind isn't just work. It's the struggle, the hustle, sometimes invigorating, sometimes demoralizing. It's a weeklong rollercoaster with comedic bends and tragic drops, only to start all over again on Monday. Are we working hard or hardly working? It's all the same on the grind.

nameZh: 狼神英灵 卡特琳娜 梦幻追猎
nameEn: Chosen of the Wolf Katarina (Rose Quartz)
descriptionZh: 亲爱的狼，我们的国度迎来了一名刺客。虽然她蛰伏于阴影之中，却能让敌人的心中爬满恐惧。所以你才相中了她，不是吗？她身手矫捷、杀气凛凛、信念坚定。有她的加入，这场“永恒追猎”势必会很精彩。
descriptionEn: An assassin was welcomed into our realm, dear Wolf. Though she moves in shadow, she strikes fear in the hearts of her foes. That caught your attention, didn't it? Her speed. Her violence. Her conviction. A welcome addition to the Eternal Chase.
heroNameZh: 不祥之刃 卡特琳娜

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当年轻的战争领袖安蓓萨在战斗中阵亡时，她被赐予了狛尔拉琛的幻像，一个由狼神赐给有价值的追随者们的神圣来世。所有被迎进这个庇护地的人都必须加入“永恒追猎”，在战斗中找到赐福，并在永无止境的狩猎中愉快地挑战他们的战士英灵同伴们。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When the young warleader Ambessa falls in battle, she is granted a vision of Volrachnun, a hallowed afterlife for worthy followers of the Wolf. All who are welcomed into this haven must join the Eternal Chase, finding bliss in battle and joyfully challenging their fellow chosen warriors in a never-ending hunt.

skinNameZh: 狼神英灵 卡特琳娜

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 格温 狡之魂焰
descriptionZh: 她去过世界的尽头……以及彼岸……去拯救她的朋友！根据我现在看到的排名表，她必须和这个朋友一决高下才能赢得这次武道大会！噢！我发誓，这不是故意安排的，伙计们。这可是实况电视节目！一个心怀友谊的少女拿着能够起死回生的剪子：有请格温！
descriptionEn: She went to the ends of the world... and beyond... to save her friend! And according to the bracket that I'm looking at with my very eyes, she's going to have to fight him to win this tournament! OOF! I swear, this isn't scripted folks. It's LIVE TV! A girl with friendship in her heart and magical scissors that raise the dead in her hands: Gwen!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

universes.descriptionZh: 来自世界各地，那些斗魂已经觉醒的人们被邀请参加……斗魂武道大会！它是凌驾于所有娱乐之上的王者，是一个无与伦比的电视奇观！战士们在擂台上一对一单挑，直至只剩一人拿到大奖：灵魂最深处的愿望！而我会在这里，播报这一切！
universes.descriptionEn: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 熊猫娃娃 拉克丝 蜀绣佳人
descriptionZh: 有什么理由不喜欢熊猫呢？它们萌萌哒、圆滚滚、毛绒绒！但是如果你要和它们一起出去玩，就不要犯和拉克丝一样的错误：她的第一根法杖是用竹子做的。真是个坏主意。
descriptionEn: What's not to love about pandas? They're cute, round, and fuzzy! But if you're going to hang out with them, don't make the same mistake that Lux did with her first staff and make it out of bamboo. Bad idea.

nameZh: 熊猫娃娃 拉克丝 火锅姑娘
descriptionZh: 有什么理由不喜欢熊猫呢？它们萌萌哒、圆滚滚、毛绒绒！但是如果你要和它们一起出去玩，就不要犯和拉克丝一样的错误：她的第一根法杖是用竹子做的。真是个坏主意。

descriptionZh: 有什么理由不喜欢熊猫呢？它们萌萌哒、圆滚滚、毛绒绒！但是如果你要和它们一起出去玩，就不要犯和拉克丝一样的错误：她的第一根法杖是用竹子做的。真是个坏主意。

nameZh: 剪纸仙灵 娜美 喜气洋洋
descriptionZh: 娜美控制波涛的野心让她与神帝嘉文四世之间引发了一场毁灭性的战斗，给这个仙境带来了巨大的灾难。但当这个世界面临更大的威胁——至恶的人类天性——时，娜美必须放下她的骄傲，与她以前的敌人们合作，从而阻止他们的故事被改写。
descriptionEn: Nami's ambition to control the waves led to a destructive battle between her and god-emperor Jarvan IV, causing a great calamity to befall the world. But when the world faces an even greater threat—human nature at its most devious—Nami must swallow her pride and work with her former enemies to stop their story from being rewritten.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，大年兽加里奥的失败让春节的新年传统得以兴盛，并且这些传统通过重述那个史诗故事而得以延续。这个故事本身就是一个活生生的世界——但当这个故事世界被突然扰打断时，故事中的各个角色必须共同努力来解决这个乱局，并书写他们自己的神话。

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 波比 冰花蛋球
descriptionZh: 波比偶然发现了一柄神奇的锤子，据说它的每次挥舞都会留下最可口的招待美食。在此之后，波比发现了她真正的使命：喂饱咖啡馆里饥肠辘辘的顾客们！然而，任何人只要敢惹她的朋友……就可能会发现，她的招待并不总是那么甜蜜。
descriptionEn: After stumbling upon a magical hammer said to leave behind the tastiest treats from every swing, Poppy discovered her true calling: feeding the cafe's hungry customers! Anybody who messes with her friends, though… might find out that those treats aren't always so sweet.

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 莲华温泉 芸阿娜 雁来
descriptionZh: 芸阿娜的使命感吞噬了她，让她的身心越来越紧张。她的好友阿狸知道，只有一件事可以缓解这种紧张情绪：莲华温泉的神奇蒸汽。尽管芸阿娜有些犹豫，但她最终还是接受了，以便拓展自己的思维并思考下一步该做什么。
descriptionEn: Yunara's sense of purpose consumes her, tensing her body and mind with an ever-tightening grip. Her friend Ahri knew only one thing could relieve such tension: the magical steam of Spirit Blossom Springs. Though Yunara was hesitant, she ultimately accepted, in order to expand her mind and meditate on what's next.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在高山之上，有一家神奇的温泉馆，能为客人消解一切的世间烦恼。这家店名叫“莲华温泉”，是一片祥和、疗愈的绿洲。热情的工作人员和神奇的蒸汽会洗去战争的负担和那些“忘掉反而最好”的记忆。这里没有英雄或反派——只有得到充分休息并焕发活力的客人。
skinSets.descriptionEn: High in the mountains lies a bathhouse where guests go to melt away their worldly cares. This themed retreat, called "Spirit Blossom Springs," is an oasis free of drama. Its welcoming staff and magical steam wash away the burdens of battle and memories best forgotten. There are no heroes or villains here—only the restful and the rejuvenated.

universes.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
universes.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 莲华温泉 瑟提 鸣蜩
descriptionZh: 瑟提因为在拳击场上受伤而被迫退出比赛之后，他的母亲将他送到灵魂莲华温泉进行疗养。这份“赠礼”包括折磨人的深层组织按摩、冷水浴、火上行走、以及更多。康复之路十分艰难，但瑟提愿意尽一切努力让老妈开心——并重回战斗状态。
descriptionEn: After an injury in the fighting rings forced Sett onto the sidelines, his mother sent him to Spirit Blossom Springs to recuperate. This “gift” included torturous deep tissue massages, cold water baths, fire walking, and more. It's a hard road to recovery, but Sett will do anything to make his mom happy—and get back into fighting shape.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在高山之上，有一家神奇的温泉馆，能为客人消解一切的世间烦恼。这家店名叫“莲华温泉”，是一片祥和、疗愈的绿洲。热情的工作人员和神奇的蒸汽会洗去战争的负担和那些“忘掉反而最好”的记忆。这里没有英雄或反派——只有得到充分休息并焕发活力的客人。

nameZh: 莲华温泉 娑娜 流火
descriptionZh: 娑娜为灵魂莲华温泉的“明昼体验”奠定了舒缓的基调。她迷人的旋律与桑拿的柔和蒸汽相结合，可以放松任何肌肉或心灵。她白天的音乐浴总能吸引大批观众，但只有在她独家的晚间表演中才能真正看到她的音乐才能——前提是做好了觉悟。
descriptionEn: Sona sets the soothing tone for the Kanmei Experience at Spirit Blossom Springs. Her enchanting melodies combined with the sauna's gentle steam can relax any muscle or mind. Her daytime soundbaths never fail to draw a crowd, but it is her exclusive evening shows where her musical prowess can truly be seen—if one is ready, that is.

Its welcoming staff and magical steam wash away the burdens of battle and memories best forgotten. There are no heroes or villains here—only the restful and the rejuvenated.

universes.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
universes.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 莲华温泉 娑娜 月升
descriptionZh: 娑娜为灵魂莲华温泉的“明昼体验”奠定了舒缓的基调。她迷人的旋律与桑拿的柔和蒸汽相结合，可以放松任何肌肉或心灵。她白天的音乐浴总能吸引大批观众，但只有在她独家的晚间表演中才能真正看到她的音乐才能——前提是做好了觉悟。
descriptionEn: Sona sets the soothing tone for the Kanmei Experience at Spirit Blossom Springs. Her enchanting melodies combined with the sauna's gentle steam can relax any muscle or mind. Her daytime soundbaths never fail to draw a crowd, but it is her exclusive evening shows where her musical prowess can truly be seen—if one is ready, that is.

nameZh: 莲华温泉 阿狸 星回
descriptionZh: 作为灵魂莲华温泉浴场的主人和经营者，阿狸将她最喜欢的山变成了一个隐藏的绿洲。她深刻理解休息带来的能量，尽情享受生活中最丰富的滋味——每一次都是一段美妙记忆。只有既敏锐又善良的人才能应付她的那些朝气蓬勃的客人们。
descriptionEn: Owner and proprietor of the Spirit Blossom Springs bathhouse, Ahri has turned her favorite mountain into a hidden oasis. Wielding a keen understanding of the power of rest, she indulges her appetite for life's richest flavors—one memory at a time. Only one with a sharp yet kindhearted wit could handle her guests' spirited dispositions.

nameZh: 西部魔影 古拉加斯 忠诚
descriptionZh: “这家伙不归你，伊芙，” 酒保说道，将一只大手放在那个魂不守舍的人身上，把他拉开了。古拉加斯被称为“绅士巨人”。“老碎桶者”。既非天使也非恶魔，而是别的东西。“这可不容易，朋友。见鬼，你甚至可能不会全身而退。但仔细听，你可能会重获新生。”
descriptionEn: “This one ain't for you, Eve,” says the bartender, laying one huge hand on the haunted man and pulling him away. Gragas has been called the Gentleman Giant. Ol' Caskbreaker. No angel nor devil, but something else. “Won't be easy, friend. Hell, you may not even stay in one piece. But listen close, and you just might make it back to the living.”

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

skinNameZh: 西部魔影 古拉加斯

nameZh: 青花瓷 艾瑞莉娅 牡丹
descriptionZh: 艾瑞莉娅早在成为生肖神卫之前就致力于保护古代圣物了。大学的第一年，她就在著名的考古研究所实习。这是她短暂一生的亮点……直到她被羊生肖圣物赋予了神话力量，并被卷入了一场长达数百年的战争。与之相比，学业就略显苍白了。
descriptionEn: Irelia was dedicated to the preservation of ancient relics long before she became a protector. Her first year at university, she interned at the renowned Archeology Institute. It was the highlight of her short life... until she was granted mythical powers by the Ram Relic and thrust into a centuries-old war. Schoolwork sort of pales in comparison.
heroNameZh: 刀锋舞者 艾瑞莉娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 阿卡丽 春晓
descriptionZh: 有位年轻战士的师父曾告诫她——世间险恶，只有摒弃一切情感，才能在这乱世之中生存，接着便命令她剜出自己的心。然而，战士终于举起利刃时，却发现自己下不了手。她选择带着自己的本心，直面这个残酷的世界。于是，她就此逃逸，想要寻找新的道路——最终，她遇到了灼之影。这位师父虽然没有让她挖出自己的心，却也将其伤得支离破碎。
descriptionEn: A young warrior's master warned her of the world's cruelty and the dispassion it required, then told her to cut out her heart. But when she raised the blade, she could not do it. She would face the world, heart intact. She ran, seeking a new path, and found the Burning Shade—a master who did not demand her heart, but destroyed it all the same.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 璐璐 抹茶巧克力
descriptionZh: 当璐璐和她得力的副主厨皮克斯制作甜点时，甜食爱好者们总是会感到满足！他们的糕点魔法料理只需要一丝香气，就足以让最任性的顾客们沉醉。有人说他们的美食非常令人着迷，甚至具有改变现实的效果……
descriptionEn: Sweet tooths are always satisfied when Lulu and her helpful sous-chef Pix are crafting the desserts! Just one whiff of their pastry magic concoctions is enough to enchant even the most unruly customers. Some say their treats are so captivating that they even have reality altering effects…

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 点心宝贝 辛德拉 葡萄点心
descriptionZh: 辛德拉是一位天赋异禀、潜力无限的烹饪大师。她的野心总是让她创造出奢华的美食——当她的厨师同事们的作品达不到她的标准时，她就会和他们发生争执。不过，当每道菜的味道都如此美妙时，还会有顾客抱怨吗？
descriptionEn: A gifted culinary mage with limitless potential, Syndra's ambition always gives rise to decadent treats—and stirs feuds with her fellow chefs when their creations fall short of her standards. Still, what customer can complain when everything tastes so sensational?

skinSets.descriptionZh: 任何一位出色的糕点大师都知道，没有美味佳肴的聚会就不是完整的聚会。虽然他们的参观可能是新的，但做点心的艺术却不是——并且这些神奇的厨师愿意通过揉、剁、煎、蒸等方式打造出色香味俱全的美食。只需咬一口这些美味的面团，即使是脾气最暴躁的顾客也会迫切想要当场入座然后大饱口福。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Any pastry mage worth their salt knows no get-together is complete without savory treats. Though their cafe may be new, the art of making dumplings isn't—and these magical chefs are willing to knead, chop, fry, and steam their way to culinary greatness. Just one bite of these doughy delights will make even the grumpiest patron eager to pull up a chair and celebrate.

nameZh: iG 洛 极境
descriptionZh: 以此致敬Baolan在2018全球总决赛中使用洛的夺胜表现。
descriptionEn: Honoring Baolan's winning performance as Rakan during the 2018 World Championship.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 恭喜2018年全球总决赛冠军：Invictus Gaming！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2018: Invictus Gaming!

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

nameZh: iG 卡莎 极境
descriptionZh: 以此致敬JackeyLove在2018全球总决赛中使用卡莎的夺胜表现。
descriptionEn: Honoring JackeyLove's winning performance as Kai'Sa during the 2018 World Championship.

nameZh: 斑点鳄加斯
descriptionZh: 与你最喜欢的毛绒小伙伴“鳄加斯”依偎在一起！揉捏他柔软的腹部，看着他吓走恶梦来保证你的一夜安眠。内含可伸缩的小爪子，可带来双倍的乐趣！不适合5岁以下的儿童。需要一些手动拼装。
descriptionEn: Snuggle up with Cho'Gath, your favorite plush pal! Squeeze his soft belly and watch him scare away bad dreams for a guaranteed good night's sleep. Extendable claw arms included for double the fun! Not suitable for children under 5 years of age. Some assembly required.
heroNameEn: the Terror of the Void Cho'Gath

skinSets.descriptionZh: 纳尔的玩具箱闪耀着无价之宝的光辉，但没人在家时，他的玩具会过一种属于它们自己的生活……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gnar's toy chest is brimming with priceless treasures, but when no one's home, his toys take on a life of their own...

universes.descriptionZh: 纳尔的玩具箱闪耀着无价之宝的光辉，但没人在家时，他的玩具会过一种属于它们自己的生活……
universes.descriptionEn: Gnar's toy chest is brimming with priceless treasures, but when no one's home, his toys take on a life of their own...

nameZh: 铁血女忍 阿卡丽 斩魂粉樱
descriptionZh: 阿卡丽的武器闪耀着外星能量。她只狩猎那些值得进行一场生与死的危险游戏的猎物。她可在任意时间从任意地点发起攻击，没有什么能够逃过被她挂在藏品墙上的命运。
descriptionEn: Her weapons flaring with alien energy, Akali hunts only the worthy in a dangerous game of life and death. Striking from anywhere at any moment, no living thing can escape her trophy wall.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 对于某些物种来说，狩猎不仅仅是一种体育运动——它掌控着他们的思维和躯体，将他们塑造成一个由完美的杀戮机器组成的种族。
skinSets.descriptionEn: For some species, the hunt is more than mere sport—it possesses their minds and bodies, molding them into a race of perfect killing machines.

universes.descriptionZh: 对于某些物种来说，狩猎不仅仅是一种体育运动——它掌控着他们的思维和躯体，将他们塑造成一个由完美的杀戮机器组成的种族。
universes.descriptionEn: For some species, the hunt is more than mere sport—it possesses their minds and bodies, molding them into a race of perfect killing machines.

nameZh: 幻灵战斗兔 阿萝拉 优雅气度
descriptionZh: 作为幻灵战队唯一的科研专家，阿萝拉利用她对海魔人的了解（以及生物工程博士学位）来翻译和改编海魔科技。虽然她的工作为幻灵战队的设备带来了令人难以置信的进步，但她真正追求的是帮助世界像她一样了解海魔人。
descriptionEn: As Anima Squad's sole research specialist, Aurora uses her understanding of the Primordians (and PhD in bioengineering) to translate and adapt Primordian technology. While her work has led to incredible advancements in Anima Squad's equipment, her true passion is helping the world understand Primordians as she does.

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

skinNameZh: 幻灵战斗兔 阿萝拉

nameZh: 幻灵白鸽 萨勒芬妮 优雅气度
descriptionZh: 萨勒芬妮是幻灵战队的通讯官，“椅子上的女孩”——直到她成为第一位幻灵白鸽，利用她天生敏感的听力来操作一套新的幻灵科技战甲，该战甲可以将声波进行武器化以震撼战场！当萨勒芬妮拦截到一个奇怪的求救信号时，她接到了第一个任务：找到来源，并带领团队前往营救。
descriptionEn: Seraphine was Anima Squad's comms officer, the "girl in the chair"—until she became the first Battle Dove, using her naturally sensitive hearing to operate a new AnimaTech suit that weaponizes sound waves to rock the battlefield! When she intercepts a strange distress call, Seraphine gets her first mission: find the source, and lead a team to the rescue.
heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

skinNameZh: 幻灵白鸽 萨勒芬妮

nameZh: 花仙贵族 伊泽瑞尔 玫瑰水晶眼
descriptionZh: 虽然伊泽瑞尔是夏之庭的一名领主，但他更愿意研究古代魔法史，而不是忍受所有的尔虞我诈。然而，当他的研究揭示出关于花仙女王继承顺序的一些反常事情时，伊泽瑞尔发现有人可能出于自己的目的将卡尔玛置于王座之上......
descriptionEn: Though he is a lord of the Summer Court, Ezreal would much rather be investigating ancient magical history than putting up with all the political drama. When his research reveals something curious about the Faerie queen's line of succession, however, Ezreal discovers that someone may have placed Karma upon the throne for their own purposes…

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有花仙贵族都是自然意志的仆人，用他们的魔法实行自然的秩序和四季的更替。然而，在那个更高的目标之下，在满是丝绸、薄纱和黄金的各个奢华王庭之中，政治阴谋的游戏不断上演。 毕竟，权能——不管是魔法的、自然的还是政治的——总会激发竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: All fae nobility are servants to nature's will, carrying out the natural order and the turning of seasons with their magic. Beneath that higher purpose, however, a constant game of political intrigue plays out in luxurious courts of silk, gossamer, and gold. Power, after all—magical, natural, or political—always inspires competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 各式各样的花仙与林精都把各个花仙王国称为家园：所有由纯粹自然魔法和空灵之美组成的生物都喜欢月光狂欢、悦耳歌声、以及诡计多端的交易。
universes.descriptionEn: Pixies, nixies, hobs, redcaps, and more call the Faerie Queendoms home: all creatures of pure natural magic and ethereal beauty that delight in moonlight revels, mellifluous song, and tricksy dealings.

skinNameZh: 花仙贵族 伊泽瑞尔

nameZh: 殿堂传奇 薇恩 登神
descriptionZh: 有些人质疑我们的传承，薇恩。我们将向他们证明，怀疑可以磨砺一个人的决心。作为我的生机守护者，我号召你将恐惧植入那些未够格者的心中。教一教那些敢于挑战你的人，什么是无情猎手。
descriptionEn: There are some who question our legacy, Vayne. We will show them that doubt can sharpen one's resolve. As my Keeper of Vigor, I call upon you to strike fear into the hearts of the undeserving. Teach those who would dare challenge you what it means to embody the Relentless Hunter.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 从前，众神将他们的力量封存在四块屹世晶片中：混沌、和谐、隐忍、活力。晶片的神力会向来访的勇士发出凶险的试炼，同时应允他们铭志不朽。时至今日，各路豪杰纷纷前来挑战，只为留下一段人神共赏的传奇。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, gods of myth sealed their strength within the four Shards of the Risen: Chaos, Harmony, Patience, and Vigor. Each presented a life-threatening trial to warriors who sought its power, promising to immortalize them in history. To this day, fighters across the land rise to the challenge in hopes of leaving a legacy that even a god will respect.

universes.descriptionZh: 为了避免被永远从历史中抹去，许多人冒着生命危险成为“殿堂传奇”——一位受到这个世界的创世神们认可的勇士。那些成功的人被赋予了深不可测的力量，并被委托代表那些选择他们的神。
universes.descriptionEn: To avoid being erased from history forever, many risk their lives to become a Risen Legend—a warrior recognized by the gods who birthed this world. Those who succeed are bestowed with unfathomable power and entrusted to represent the gods that chose them.

nameZh: 源计划：雷 卢锡安 至强
descriptionZh: 卢锡安曾在体系内担任哨兵，所以见证过源计划的真正面目。他的粒子核心光束手枪现在为基因动力和人类的反叛而战，用残酷的高效摧毁科技的压迫者。
descriptionEn: Once a sentinel within the Command Line, Lucian has seen PROJECT for what they truly are. His dual ion-core Lightcaster pistols now serve G/NETIC and the human rebellion, bringing down their technological oppressors with brutal efficiency.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 源计划集团相信解开人类潜能的秘密是超越我们凡躯的关键。我们将通过技术达到飞升。聚在一起。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The PROJECT Corporation believes unlocking the secrets of humanity's potential is the key to progress beyond our mortal bodies. It is through technology that we will ascend. Together.

universes.descriptionZh: 在某个由数个全球集团所控制的未来，巨型建筑物和拥挤的街道之中，一场暗影战争在充满抗争精神且被技术增幅过的人类和全新强化过的智能生物之间打响了。胜者将改变历史的进程……而败者将被强迫演变。
universes.descriptionEn: Among the mega-structures and packed streets of a future controlled by global corporations, a shadow war rages between rebellious, augmented humans and newly empowered artificial beings. The winners will shape the course of history... and the losers will be forced to evolve.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 艾瑞莉娅 春晓
descriptionZh: “玉手剑侍”曾是“迷途女王”的一位忠心耿耿的亲卫。然而，当她保护女王的责任被希望看到女王幸福的愿望取代时，灾难就随之而来。王国覆灭了，并且女王就死在她的怀里。现在，作为一个夜幽之灵，“玉手剑侍”游荡在无尽的黑夜中，背负着悔恨。
descriptionEn: The Ready Hand was a devoted bodyguard to the Wandering Queen. Yet when her duty to protect was eclipsed by a desire to see her queen happy, calamity followed. The kingdom fell, and the queen died in her arms. Now, as an akana spirit, the Ready Hand roams the endless night, burdened by regret.
heroNameZh: 刀锋舞者 艾瑞莉娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

skinNameZh: 灵魂莲华 艾瑞莉娅

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 彗 朝花
descriptionZh: 传说中有位四处云游的画圣，他喜欢徜徉在灵魂的交界之处，行走于光与暗之间。他手中掌握着明昼与夜幽的力量，大笔一挥便能勘破所画之物的内心。机缘巧合下，他来到一座神庙，便为这片圣地的守护者——狩灵之箭画了张像。然而，画像却逐渐扭曲，化为了纯粹的怒火——这个故事警醒世人，做人要忠于自己，否则终究会被画圣识破自己内心的秘密。
descriptionEn: It is said, the Artist roams—obsessed with the soul's liminal space, where light and dark collide. He wields kanmei and akana essence to reveal the heart of those he paints. Chancing upon a divine temple, he painted its guardian Archer. But the portrait twisted into pure rage—a lesson to be true to oneself, lest the Artist expose what lies beneath.

nameZh: 花仙子 拉克丝 玫瑰水晶眼
descriptionZh: 拉克丝是在大法师米利欧座下学习的一位年轻女术士，准备证明她不只是一位无所事事的夏之廷女士。她负责将阳光透过晨露分解成彩虹，每天在太阳升起之前都有很多工作要做——但她有的是决心！
descriptionEn: A young sorceress studying under Archmage Milio, Lux is ready to prove that she's not just an idle Lady of the Summer Court. Responsible for splitting sunbeams into rainbows through the morning dew, she has a lot of work to conquer each day before the sun rises—but she is nothing if not determined!

nameZh: 花仙使者 卡特琳娜 桃六点
descriptionZh: 尽管卡特琳娜是来自真相与暗影之哀怒花仙王庭的一名官方外交使节，但你根本无法从心胸狭窄的庭臣们对她投来的斜眼和不赞成的皱眉中了解到这一点。不管怎样：匕首在手，谜团未解，卡特琳娜自有打算。
descriptionEn: Though Katarina is an official diplomatic envoy hailing from the Unseelie Court of Truth and Shadow, you wouldn't know it from all the side-eyed glances and disapproving frowns she receives from closed-minded courtiers. No matter: with daggers in hand and a mystery afoot, Katarina has her own agenda.
heroNameZh: 不祥之刃 卡特琳娜

nameZh: 花仙子 萨勒芬妮 玫瑰水晶眼
descriptionZh: 作为夏之廷的开朗塞壬女妖，萨勒芬妮女士娴熟的化妆天赋曾经帮助卡尔玛和卡莉丝塔得体地面对贵族。她是宫廷礼仪的大师，并且非常乐意教她的新朋友们一切可以真正称之为绝妙的事情！
descriptionEn: A sunny siren of the Summer Court, it was Lady Seraphine's skillful makeover talents that helped get Karma and Kalista ready to face the nobility with style. She is a master of courtly manners and was more than happy to teach her new friends everything that really counts about being fabulous!
heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有花仙贵族都是自然意志的仆人，用他们的魔法实行自然的秩序和四季的更替。然而，在那个更高的目标之下，在满是丝绸、薄纱和黄金的各个奢华王庭之中，政治阴谋的游戏不断上演。 毕竟，权能——不管是魔法的、自然的还是政治的——总会激发竞争。

nameZh: 花仙子 莉莉娅 蓝闪
descriptionZh: 作为冬之廷女士和花仙心树的守护者，莉莉娅将各个花仙王国的历史记录在古树的年轮中，将各个事件定格成茂密的、不断成长的档案。当莉莉娅发现有人试图篡改她的工作时，她必须鼓起勇气——麻烦就要来了！
descriptionEn: Lady of the Winter Court and Keeper of the Seelie Heart-tree, Lillia records the history of the Faerie Queendoms in the ancient tree's rings, freezing events into forested, ever-growing archives. When Lillia discovers that someone has tried to tamper with her work, however, she must rally her courage—there is trouble afoot!

nameZh: 玉剑传说 无劫 丁香
descriptionZh: 当无劫得道成仙并开始将目光投向其他领域时，新的野心油然而生：开悟无处不在，所以他也必须无处不在。 在发现他的探索后，天目派驱逐了他。不过，无劫并不在意，因为他发现了一种新的魔道威能，可使他无所不在、无所不知。
descriptionEn: When Zed became immortal and began studying the other realms, a new desire took hold: knowledge was everywhere, so he needed to BE everywhere. Upon discovering his explorations, the Grounded Foresight School banished him. Zed doesn't care, though, for he's found a new demonic power, allowing him to be everywhere and all-knowing.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……

nameZh: 玉剑传说 舞龙卫 珠光
descriptionZh: 一百年来，舞龙卫本是旸刚派洞天的看守，但在救了一位落水僧人的子弟后，师父恩准她开始修炼。 她很享受化为人形所带来的种种纠葛。与星仙子不同，舞龙卫毫不怀疑自己的身份：至尊修仙学派的保护者。
descriptionEn: For 100 years, the dragon Shyvana watched over the Sprouting Courage School's gardens, but after saving one of the monk's sons from drowning, she was allowed to train. Transforming into a human, she enjoyed the challenge this new form would bring. Unlike Soraka, Shyvana has no doubt about who she is: a protector of the strongest school of immortality.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……

nameZh: 玉剑传说 星仙子 胭脂
descriptionZh: 幼年时的星仙子本是旸刚派的童女，也理应成为旸刚派的弟子，但她嫌恶既定的命数。在武神贾克斯的古老故事中曾经说过，他相信真正的力量来自于逍遥自在，因此星仙子违逆了父母的意愿，前往混意派接受修行。她将踏上独属其一人的大道。
descriptionEn: A child of Sprouting Courage School monks, Soraka was expected to follow them, but she hated having the choice already made for her. Remembering the old tales of God Staff Jax, who believed true power came from assuming nothing, Soraka shunned her parents' wishes to train at the Flowing Intuition School. She'll earn immortality her own way.

universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 玉剑传说 琴仙子 珐琅
descriptionZh: 作为炽血派刚刚得道的仙子，琴仙子的威能在于从混乱的嘈杂中寻获和谐。 对她来说，得道成仙只能通过找到与同胞的和谐相处来实现，因此她将她的学生视为仙音妙律中不可或缺的强音。 正是在这种共同的热情中，一切皆有可能。
descriptionEn: As a newly immortal member of the Radiant Passion School, Sona's power is in building harmony from dissonance. To her, immortality only comes through finding your shared harmony with your fellow people, and she sees her students as strong notes to be built into immortal chords. It is in this shared passion that makes anything possible.

nameZh: 玉剑传说 翼剑仙 丁香
descriptionZh: 天目派传习的是见微知著的能力，但是随着翼剑仙接近得道，怀疑也悄然而至。 父母的意外离世促使她想要尽可能地掌控自己的生活，可由于师父无劫将她逐出师门，她的信念开始动摇。 她现在只希望，修得长生能让她最终抛开一切疑虑。
descriptionEn: The Grounded Foresight School teaches power in knowing one's surroundings, but as Kayle nears immortality, doubt has crept in. Her parents' random deaths fostered a desire to exert as much control as possible in her life, but with her teacher Zed's banishment, the ground is now shaky. Immortality, she hopes, will finally give her solid footing.

nameZh: 女帝 厄运小姐 纹章之刻印·果决
descriptionZh: 女帝卡特琳娜的法令传遍了整个艾丽西亚：“神圣加冕礼”是各国之间两军对阵的荣耀战斗。瑟瑞尼亚的厄运小姐接纳了这一改变，指挥着她的空中舰队以一种爆炸性的方式炫耀着财富和弹药。虽然盟友是与世隔绝的奥莱，但厄运小姐的加冕证明了空中部队的残酷无情。
descriptionEn: Queen Katarina's decree rang throughout Elysia: the Grand Coronation ordains honorable battle among nations, army versus army. Miss Fortune of Cyrenia welcomed this change, commanding her sky-fleet in an explosive display of wealth and munitions. While allied to the secluded Aurai, Miss Fortune's crowning proves the ruthlessness of the brigades above.
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……
universes.descriptionEn: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 阿卡丽 朝花
descriptionZh: 有位年轻战士的师父曾告诫她——世间险恶，只有摒弃一切情感，才能在这乱世之中生存，接着便命令她剜出自己的心。然而，战士终于举起利刃时，却发现自己下不了手。她选择带着自己的本心，直面这个残酷的世界。于是，她就此逃逸，想要寻找新的道路——最终，她遇到了灼之影。这位师父虽然没有让她挖出自己的心，却也将其伤得支离破碎。
descriptionEn: A young warrior's master warned her of the world's cruelty and the dispassion it required, then told her to cut out her heart. But when she raised the blade, she could not do it. She would face the world, heart intact. She ran, seeking a new path, and found the Burning Shade—a master who did not demand her heart, but destroyed it all the same.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 凯尔 春晓
descriptionZh: 初生之灵创造了一对姐妹——姐姐生自树木坚实的枝干，妹妹则是转瞬即逝的花朵——并为她们起名为“林之守卫”。姐姐勇毅坚定，公正严明。妹妹虽有强大的力量，内心却饱受折磨——她创造出诸多恶魔子嗣，逼得初生之灵不得不将其困在林地之中。妹妹遭到封印后，林之守卫就一直守护着这片土地，一刻也不曾懈怠。
descriptionEn: The First Spirit shaped two sisters—one from the sturdy bough of a tree, the other from its ephemeral bloom—and named them the Branchwardens. The first was steadfast and just. The second, powerful but troubled, crafted demonic children, forcing the maker to bind them to a grove. With her sister sealed away, the Branchwarden stands, forever watchful.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。

nameZh: 殿堂传奇 薇恩 至强
descriptionZh: 有些人质疑我们的传承，薇恩。我们将向他们证明，怀疑可以磨砺一个人的决心。作为我的生机守护者，我号召你将恐惧植入那些未够格者的心中。教一教那些敢于挑战你的人，什么是无情猎手。
descriptionEn: There are some who question our legacy, Vayne. We will show them that doubt can sharpen one's resolve. As my Keeper of Vigor, I call upon you to strike fear into the hearts of the undeserving. Teach those who would dare challenge you what it means to embody the Relentless Hunter.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 从前，众神将他们的力量封存在四块屹世晶片中：混沌、和谐、隐忍、活力。晶片的神力会向来访的勇士发出凶险的试炼，同时应允他们铭志不朽。时至今日，各路豪杰纷纷前来挑战，只为留下一段人神共赏的传奇。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, gods of myth sealed their strength within the four Shards of the Risen: Chaos, Harmony, Patience, and Vigor. Each presented a life-threatening trial to warriors who sought its power, promising to immortalize them in history. To this day, fighters across the land rise to the challenge in hopes of leaving a legacy that even a god will respect.

universes.descriptionZh: 为了避免被永远从历史中抹去，许多人冒着生命危险成为“殿堂传奇”——一位受到这个世界的创世神们认可的勇士。那些成功的人被赋予了深不可测的力量，并被委托代表那些选择他们的神。
universes.descriptionEn: To avoid being erased from history forever, many risk their lives to become a Risen Legend—a warrior recognized by the gods who birthed this world. Those who succeed are bestowed with unfathomable power and entrusted to represent the gods that chose them.

nameZh: 神龙尊者 夜之龙 薇恩 摘星
descriptionZh: 薇恩发誓要追捕因布兰德的大肆破坏而出现的各种燃烧、腐烂的武装势力。她未曾动摇过，即使在一个遥远的海岸被逼入绝境时，她也一直战斗到了垂死边缘。命运使然，她的险胜恰逢一次新夜轮换，并且午夜之龙神降临，为她的灵体灌注了受到赐福的黑暗，锋利得如同龙鳞。
descriptionEn: Vayne vowed to hunt the blazing, rotting forces that arose from Brand's destruction. She never faltered, even when cornered on a remote coast, where she fought to the brink of death. By fate, her narrow victory coincided with the turn of a new night, and the Midnight Dragon came down to imbue her spirit with blessed darkness, sharp as draconic scales.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 尊荣的巨龙们居住在偏远的雄奇瑰丽之地，为了避免外面的凡界纷争，它们只会非常罕见地将礼物赐给极少数被它们选中的人。神龙尊者们就是幸运且强大到足以获得这种终极赐福的人。他们用它来行善还是行恶，都取决于他们自己，以及任何强大到足以制止他们的人。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Majestic dragons dwell in remote places of wild beauty, avoiding mortal affairs outside of rarely bestowing their gifts on only a select few. The Dragonmancers are those fortunate and powerful enough to have gained the ultimate blessing. Whether they then use that for good or for evil is up to them, and anyone strong enough to stop them.

universes.descriptionZh: 圣兽们守护着整个世界，能够把任何人变成强大的存在，但前提是那个灵魂值得他们的祝福。无论他们的力量是用于善还是恶，一旦赐予，就无法收回。
universes.descriptionEn: Divine beasts watch over the world entire, capable of turning anyone into powerful beings, but only if that soul is worthy of their blessings. Whether their power is used for good or evil, once the gift is given, it cannot be taken away.

skinNameZh: 神龙尊者 夜之龙 薇恩

nameZh: 春晖神女 艾希 轻云蔽月
descriptionZh: 艾希——大海皇帝的女儿——在远离家乡的废弃岛屿上寻求慰藉，因为她的人民遭受了厄运。在那里，她与一条奇怪的蛟龙和一个阴险的准国王结盟，希望他们的潜在力量可以帮她夺回她的帝国。这是一次经过一番苦战才得来的胜利，但真正的战争远未结束，那就是：外交。
descriptionEn: Her people slaughtered, Ashe—daughter of the Emperor of the Great Sea—sought solace on an abandoned island far from home. There, she made alliances with a strange serpent and a sinister would-be king, in the hope that their untapped might could help seize her empire back. It was a hard-fought victory, but the true battle is far from over: diplomacy.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 神龙尊者 苍龙艾希 至强
descriptionZh: 艾希将她的部族带到了一个神秘的森林，以保护他们免遭布兰德的摧毁。在那里，她偶遇了苍龙，而苍龙感知到了她无穷的力量以及对族人们的奉献，因此用它的奥术魔法赐福了她。现在，艾希在编织法术保护族人的同时，也在等待着复仇之时的到来。
descriptionEn: Ashe led her tribe into a mysterious forest to protect them from Brand's destruction. There, she happened upon the Fae Dragon, who sensed her immense power and devotion to her people and blessed her with its arcane magic. Now, Ashe weaves spells to keep them safe while biding her time for her revenge.

nameZh: 伏虎之力 泰隆 瑞兽灵光
descriptionZh: 泰隆是一位令许多人畏惧和尊敬的冷酷刺客。他环游世界，只有一个目标：消灭所有的神恩战爪，直到只剩下他一个。当他听说有个倔强的佣兵受命在他完成任务之前打倒神恩战爪的首领时，他窃喜地意识到一场新的狩猎即将开始。
descriptionEn: A ruthless assassin feared and respected by many, Talon roams the world with one goal: eliminate each and every other Favorclaw until only he remains. When he catches wind that a stubborn mercenary was contracted to take down the leader of the Favorclaw before he can complete his mission, he gleefully realizes that a new hunt is about to begin.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 那些在出生时皮肤上就有发光斑纹的幸运儿们在他们的人民中被尊称为“神恩战爪”。这些特殊的虎裔们命中注定要代表他们的社群并其蛮力赢得其它社群的尊重。他们每个人都希望以自己种族的名义征服世界，成为让所有人都畏惧的首领。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Those lucky enough to be born with glowing markings on their skin are revered among their people as “Favorclaw.” These special Tigrasbornes are destined to represent their community and demand the respect of others with their strength. They each hope to conquer the world in the name of their kind and become the leader feared by all.

universes.descriptionZh: 拥抱本能。释放战意。要求有尊重。
universes.descriptionEn: Embrace instinct. Unleash aggression. Demand respect.

nameZh: 青花瓷 格雷福斯 金辉玉洁
descriptionZh: 在火药被发明后不久，生肖神卫就开始寻找龙生肖圣物的新守护者了。众神虽然古老而睿智，却很难找到值得托付的人，因此他们选择了马尔科姆·格雷福斯。最终，他在火力方面的专长指出了正确的方向(远离所有易碎花瓶)。
descriptionEn: Not long after gunpowder was invented, the Zodiac searched for a new protector of the Dragon Relic. Though ancient and wise, the gods struggled to find someone worthy, so they settled for Malcolm Graves. Eventually his expertise in firepower was pointed in the right direction (away from all the breakable vases).
heroNameZh: 法外狂徒 格雷福斯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 婕拉 春晓
descriptionZh: 从前，有位女子拥有一颗已经破碎的心，她渴望忘记自己的悲伤。一个强大的灵体被她的困境所感动，满足了她的愿望。女子的泪水化为花朵，在她的身体里生根发芽，“忘忧花园”由此诞生。如今，疲惫的心灵们走进它的怀抱，希望这些花朵能够减轻它们的悲伤。
descriptionEn: Once, there was a woman with a broken heart who longed to forget her sorrow. A powerful spirit, moved by her plight, granted her wish. The woman's tears turned to blossoms, her body took root, and the Garden of Forgetting was born. Now, weary hearts wander into its embrace, hoping the blooms will ease their grief.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。

From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 战斗学院 霞 天马
descriptionZh: 巴比隆学院的神之武器选择了霞带领学校队伍参加今年的跨学院锦标赛——他们从未在这个赛事上赢过。身为战斗俱乐部的部长，她很高兴能利用自己的新影响力来指挥队友，并享受这段与洛一起的“假期”，尽管她永远不会承认自己喜欢当领导者。
descriptionEn: Babylon Academy's God-Weapon chose Xayah to lead the school's team in this year's cross-academy tournament, which they've never won. As captain of the Battle Club, she's happy to use her new leverage to boss around her teammates and savor the “vacation” with Rakan, though she'll never admit she enjoys being a leader.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在这些院校中，只有强者才能生存。尽管它们的成立是为了纪念它们的神之武器，但每个学院的学生都在通往荣耀的道路上努力使它的力量成为自己的力量。无论它是在课堂，还是在战场，都在主导着竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: At these institutions, only the strong survive. Though they were founded to honor their God Weapon, the students at each academy strive to make its strength their own on their path to glory. Whether it's the classroom, or the battlefield, dominate the competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 散布在全球各地的神之武器将社会变成了一个由力量驱动的社会。这些有感知力的碑石召唤着那些配得上的人，并将其礼物赠予其主体，打算在这个饱受战争蹂躏的世界中扩张其征服之地。被选中是一种荣誉勋章，向任何可能反对他们的人灌输恐惧。
universes.descriptionEn: Scattered across the globe, the God Weapons morphed society into one driven by power. These sentient monuments call to those who are worthy and bestow their gifts upon their subjects, aiming to expand their conquest in this war-torn world. To be chosen is a badge of honor, instilling fear into any who may oppose them.

nameZh: 天龙之子 黛安娜 龙腾四海
descriptionZh: 龙之王国的图书馆是保存历代智慧之作的档案馆：也是由宫廷学者黛安娜保管的藏品。她是一位狂热的学者和战士，陪伴龙太子踏上旅程，记录龙与人类之间历史性的第一次相遇。
descriptionEn: The library of the Kingdom of Dragons is an illustrious archive of wisdom from ages past: a collection kept by Diana, scholar of the court. A fierce academic as well as a fighter, she accompanies the prince on his journey to document this historical first encounter between dragons and humans.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 天龙之子 李青 龙腾四海
descriptionZh: 龙太子、龙之王国的继位者万岁！李青是一位高贵而公正的龙太子，对他的人民有着深厚的感情。当他听到云层下方烟花爆竹的爆裂声时，他知道是时候更多地了解他的人类子民——以及他们如何用一声巨响迎接新年了！
descriptionEn: All hail the Prince of Dragons, heir to the throne of the heavenly Kingdom of Dragons! A noble and just prince, Lee Sin is deeply devoted to his people. When he hears the telltale crackle of fireworks just below the clouds, he knows it's time to learn more about his human subjects—and how they greet the New Year with a bang!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 天龙之子 易 蛟龙得水
descriptionZh: 龙太子的武术老师必须拥有绝顶的实力，并且没有哪个龙的技艺比易大师更加出色了。真正的大师必须既是战士又是诗人，既是冠军又是艺术家——并且本着学习的精神，必须时刻准备好应对任何事情。
descriptionEn: A prince requires a master of the highest caliber to teach him martial arts, and there is no dragon of greater skill than Master Yi. A true master must be both warrior and poet, champion and artist—and in the spirit of learning, must always be ready for anything.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。

universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 天龙之子 卡莎 蛟龙得水
descriptionZh: 卡莎是皇家斥候，也是龙太子的好友。她很坚毅，在云端度过的时间比她的任何同龄人都多。虽然这是她第一次与人类直接互动，但她观察到的知识和机敏一定会在她与人类一起庆祝新年时派上用场。
descriptionEn: Royal scout and friend to the prince, Kai'Sa is a tenacious dragon who has spent more time beneath the clouds than any of her peers. Though this is the first time she has interacted with humans directly, her observed knowledge and agile grace are sure to be assets while joining them in the New Year's celebration.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。

nameZh: 天龙之子 伊泽瑞尔 蛟龙得水
descriptionZh: 无论哪里出了状况，整个王国的龙都知道会听到伊泽瑞尔的淘气笑声。他的玩笑虽然无害，但不要让这个开心果欺骗了你：他是一位精明的皇家斥候，与卡莎并肩作战，而后者已经在他层出不穷的恶作剧之中勇敢地经历了许多次冒险。要穿得像个人类去参加派对？听着就像是他所憧憬的美好时光。
descriptionEn: Wherever chaos is sown, dragons across the kingdom know to listen for Ezreal's mischievous laughter. His japes are harmless, but don't let that merry spirit fool you: he is a shrewd royal scout alongside Kai'Sa who has braved many adventures between bouts of pranking. Dressing up like a human to go party? Now that sounds like his idea of a good time.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。

skinNameZh: 天龙之子 伊泽瑞尔

nameZh: 西部魔影 天使 韦鲁斯 忠诚
descriptionZh: 对于一个死去的天使来说，除了让自己悲痛万分之外，没什么可做的。韦鲁斯情愿让莫德凯撒亲自带他穿过炼狱之门……直到一群乌合之众打断了他的哀悼。韦鲁斯现在再次拿起他的弓，以先驱者的身份不断骑行。现在是他为天堂之变报仇的时候了。
descriptionEn: Ain't nothin' for a dead angel to do but resign himself to grief. Varus was content to allow Mordekaiser to take him past the infernal gates themselves… Until a ragtag gang of thieves interrupted his mourning. Varus now picks up his bow once more, riding as a Harbinger. It's high time he got revenge for the massacre of Heaven.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

skinNameZh: 西部魔影 天使 韦鲁斯

nameZh: 电玩女神 娑娜 K.O.
descriptionZh: 从现实世界被传送到游戏内与敌人的邪恶大军交战，对于娑娜来说并不是什么难事。她是第一位使用键盘击败噩梦难度单人挑战的玩家，虽然根据设计者的本意，使用键盘通关应该是不可能的。
descriptionEn: Being forcefully transported from the real world to fight an army of evil video game bosses is no sweat for Sona. She was the first person to beat Keyboard Solo 4's ultra solo mode on nightmare difficulty—a feat that, by the developers' own admission, should not have been possible.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 电玩迪亚：服务器中最具竞争力的电玩竞者们和受正义驱动的NPC们的家园。在这里，英雄们总是为胜利而比赛。这意味着要覆盖掉战场BOSS们的受损代码，即使情况对他们不利。胜利来之不易，但在一场令人难以置信的比赛之后看到BOSS们脸上的惊讶时，就会觉得这一切都值了。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Arcadia: home to the server's most competitive arcade gamers and justice-driven NPCs. Here, the heroes always play to win. And that means overriding the Battle Bosses' corrupted code, even with the odds stacked against them. Victory won't come easy, but seeing the surprise on the bosses' faces after an incredible outplay will totally make it worth it.

universes.descriptionZh: 在屏幕上闪烁的“投币开玩”，对任何称职的玩家来说都是一种不可抗拒的提议。但是，当他们从简陋的街机游戏厅抽离，投入到英雄和战场BOSS的世界时，这些平平无奇的玩家将不得不凭借他们所具备的全部反应力和连招来进行战斗。因为电玩世界的玩家们……是用命在玩。
universes.descriptionEn: Insert Coin to Play" flashes on the screen, an irrestistable offer for any gamer worth their salt. But whisked away from their humble arcade into a world of Heroes and Battle Bosses, these ordinary players will have to fight with all the reflexes and combos they can muster. Because gamers in Arcadia... are playing with their lives.

nameZh: 意乱情迷 蔚 未相见心已至
descriptionZh:
我可以把你比作一朵玫瑰吗？你的尖刺像荆棘一样抵在我的身边。
你像藤蔓一样，缠绕在我的梦中，交织着我的心灵。
像在花园之外茁壮成长的紫罗兰一样狂野；
有你在，生活变得更美好了。
你愿意与我共舞吗？
凯特琳
descriptionEn:
Shall I compare you to a rose? Your spikes like thorns against my side.
Like a vine, you've coiled through my dreams, trellising my mind.
Wild like the violets that thrive beyond the garden's bounds;
Life's simply better now that you're around.
Will you go to the dance with me?
XOXO,
Caitlyn

skinSets.descriptionZh: 洋溢着学院风且风度翩翩的心动派与宁愿逃课去滑板场闲逛的心伤组没有太多共同之处。但他们在一件事上达成了一致：他们已经受够了这个为了人们萌生感情而硬造出来的愚蠢节日。那么，为什么他们似乎无法摆脱这种小鹿乱撞的感觉呢？
skinSets.descriptionEn: The preppy and perfectly poised Heartthrob clique don't have much in common with the Heartache crew, who would much rather be ditching class to hang out at the skatepark. But they agree on one thing: they've had it with this silly made up holiday dedicated to people catching feelings. So why can't they seem to shake the butterflies from their stomachs?

universes.descriptionZh: 在刻板的小团体、尴尬的小组项目和俗气的假日之间，校园生活枯燥且乏味。但坠入爱河并不在教学大纲里，并且它会让事情变得更复杂。
universes.descriptionEn: Between the rigid cliques, awkward group projects, and cheesy holidays, school was rough but routine. But getting lovestruck wasn't in the syllabus, and it's gonna make things way more complicated.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 韦鲁斯 春晓
descriptionZh: 作为一座和平寺庙的守护者，“狩灵之箭”接待了一位流浪的“艺术家”，并允许他与他挚爱的僧侣们一起避难。但当“艺术家”为他画像时，这幅魔法肖像却从画布上跳了出来，毁坏了寺庙。“狩灵之箭”的悲伤转化成了愤怒。现在，他在狩猎着这个邪恶的“艺术家”，希望为那些他无法拯救的人们带来安宁。
descriptionEn: As guardian of a peaceful temple, the Archer welcomed a wandering Artist, allowing him to shelter with his beloved monks. But when the Artist painted him, the sorcerous portrait leapt from the canvas and ravaged the temple. The Archer's grief hardened to fury. Now, he hunts the wicked Artist, hoping to bring peace to those he could not save.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 泳池派对 凯特琳 蓝柑玛格丽特
descriptionZh: 对于凯特琳来说，完美的夏日就是躺在奢华的泳池边、吃刨冰、喝热带特饮。当然，还有让行人吃上几发水弹。她可真的很喜欢射击。
descriptionEn: For Caitlyn, nothing says a perfect summer's day like lounging at a luxurious poolside, eating shaved ice and drinking tropical libations. And shooting people. She really loves shooting people.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

universes.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
universes.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: "闪耀灯球"拉克丝 我又补车了
descriptionZh: 拉克丝是来自正常世界的一名普通少女，捡到了一根附魔了律动能量的法杖，并凭借它来保护她的星球免受刺耳颤音的侵袭……拉克丝无意中发现，她可以引导浓缩迪斯科音乐的强力音爆。现在的拉克丝与她的佣兵保镖莎弥拉一起航行于太空，如同一座善良的活泼堡垒，对抗着一支异星无敌舰队与它们可怕的音乐品味。
descriptionEn: A normal girl from the Normal World, Lux picked up a groove-enhancing staff to defend her planet from the Harsh Vibes… inadvertently discovering she could channel mighty blasts of concentrated disco music. Sailing into space with her mercenary bodyguard, Samira, Lux now stands as the bubbly bastion of good against an evil alien armada and their terrible taste in music.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在一个有一百万迪斯科炼狱那么远的律动星系中，一种被称为“律动”的神秘能量将音乐和繁荣带给了数以万亿记的星系居民们。但是，当外星霸主丽桑卓和她的刺耳颤音大军开始奴役各个星球并压制迪斯科音乐时，多个英雄奋起抗争，并让派对得以继续律动。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a groovy galaxy a million disco infernos away, a mysterious energy known only as The Groove brings music and prosperity to trillions of galactic citizens. But when the alien overlord Lissandra and her army of Harsh Vibes begin to enslave planets and suppress disco music, a new age of heroes rises to stop her, and keep the party grooving.

universes.descriptionZh: 在一个有一百万迪斯科炼狱那么远的律动星系中，一种被称为“律动”的神秘能量将音乐和繁荣带给了数以万亿记的星系居民们。但是，当外星霸主丽桑卓和她的刺耳颤音大军开始奴役各个星球并压制迪斯科音乐时，多个英雄奋起抗争，并让派对得以继续律动。
universes.descriptionEn: In a groovy galaxy a million disco infernos away, a mysterious energy known only as The Groove brings music and prosperity to trillions of galactic citizens. But when the alien overlord Lissandra and her army of Harsh Vibes begin to enslave planets and suppress disco music, a new age of heroes rises to stop her, and keep the party grooving.

skinNameZh: 太空律动 “闪耀灯球” 拉克丝

nameZh: K/DA ALL OUT 阿卡丽 惊艳之姿
descriptionZh: 刚刚与“真实伤害”一起大获成功后，阿卡丽与她的锋芒毕露和标新立异一起热力全开地登上了舞台。她凭借手中的麦克风引燃全场并将乐队推到风口浪尖，因为这就是至坏之人(BADDEST)会做的事。
descriptionEn: Fresh off her success with True Damage, Akali hits the stage full-throttle with her bold edge and fresh new direction. She spits fire with a mic in hand and pushes the band to the bleeding edge, because that's what the baddest do.

skinSets.descriptionZh: “在现实与幻想之间有一个地方，一切都有可能发生。你可以成为任何人，做任何事。这就是你的梦。在这个夹缝中的世界里，K/DA感到自信又强大。我们可以梦想成真，你们也可以。”——卡莎
skinSets.descriptionEn: “There is a place between fantasy and reality where anything can happen. You have the power to be anyone, and do anything. It is your dream. In our in-between world, K/DA feels confident and strong. We can do anything, and so can you.” -Kai'Sa

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: K/DA ALL OUT 阿狸 惊艳之姿
descriptionZh: 当阿狸与K/DA一起踏上舞台表演时，她知道与她同台的都是至佳中的至佳——拥有不同个性的不同女士们，都处在各自领域的顶尖位置。作为她们的队长和好友，阿狸正准备引导这些小天后们达到更高的高度，并让她们的观众感到美不胜收。
descriptionEn: When Ahri steps onto the stage to perform with K/DA, she knows she's surrounded by the best of the best—different women with different personalities, all at the top of their craft. As their leader and as their friend, Ahri is poised to guide these divas to even greater heights and leave their audiences breathless for more.

nameZh: K/DA ALL OUT 伊芙琳 惊艳之姿
descriptionZh: 只需一瞥，伊芙琳就能确保所有的目光都集中在她身上——只要她想让他们这样。K/DA的成功确保了这个撩人小天后的名字将在每个人的嘴唇上出现，但伊芙琳的意图是，用她的致命时尚感使她的名字常驻在每个人的嘴唇上。
descriptionEn: With a single devastating glance, Evelynn can ensure that all eyes are on her—when she wants them to be. K/DA's success has ensured that this provocative diva's name will be on everyone's lips, but Evelynn is intent that her killer fashion sense will keep it there.

nameZh: 光明哨兵 薇恩 帝国抗击者
descriptionZh: 薇恩一直在努力成为一个更好的怪物猎人。她加入光明哨兵主要是为了改善她自己的武库，并从他们与黑雾的战斗中学点东西。当然了，她也在保护符文之地免受邪恶的伤害。如果这么做需要她忍受她与格雷福斯这样的傻瓜之间的友谊，她也会照办。这份伟业值得如此付出。
descriptionEn: Ever striving to become a better monster hunter, Vayne joins the Sentinels primarily to advance her own arsenal and learn from their battle with the Black Mist. It doesn't hurt that she is also defending Runeterra from evil, of course. If she must endure the friendship of a fool like Graves to do so, she will. The cause is worth it.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 尽管人数不多，但光之哨兵们却有着一段传奇的历史。多年来，他们一直在借助古老的圣石武器对抗蚀魂夜，这些武器会将他们的灵魂引导到强大的光明中。但现在最重要的是前方的战斗，因为破败之王正在侵蚀符文之地，这一切都是为了再一次与他的王后共舞。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Though their numbers are few, the Sentinels of Light share a storied history. For years they've fought back the Harrowing, aided by ancient relic-stone weaponry that channels their very souls into a powerful light. But all that matters now is the battle ahead, as the Ruined King lays waste to Runeterra, all to dance with his queen once more.

universes.descriptionZh: 黑雾聚集，蚀魂夜到来，并且破败之王已经再次崛起。佛耶戈的腐败席卷了符文之地，将好友变为仇敌并使诸国屈服。仅有的有能力阻挡他的一群人，就是光明哨兵：一个由赛娜和卢锡安领导的古老教团。他们必须从全境的每个角落将英雄们召集起来，以对黑雾进行反击并一劳永逸地终结破败之王的恐怖统治。
universes.descriptionEn: The Black Mist gathers, the Harrowing comes, and the Ruined King has risen once more. Viego's corruption blankets Runeterra, turning friends into foes and bringing entire nations to their knees. The only ones with the power to stop him are the Sentinels of Light: an ancient order led by Senna and Lucian. They must call upon champions from every corner of the realm to fight back the Black Mist and end the Ruined King's reign of terror once and for all.

nameZh: 光明哨兵 艾瑞莉娅 帝国抗击者
descriptionZh: 在艾欧尼亚大神庙陷落后，艾瑞莉娅无法在她的家园被黑雾所蹂躏时袖手旁观。由光明哨兵委任，她作为他们的同袍之一来对抗破败之咒：她是一个天生领袖，知道破败军团卡尔玛所带来的威胁，并且将不惜一切代价拯救这位艾欧尼亚之魂。
descriptionEn: After the fall of the Ionian Grand Temple, Irelia could not stand idly by while her home was ravaged by the Black Mist. Deputized by the Sentinels, she fights the Ruination as one of their comrades: a natural-born leader who understands the threat that Ruined Karma poses, she will stop at nothing to save the Spirit of Ionia.
heroNameZh: 刀锋舞者 艾瑞莉娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 尽管人数不多，但光之哨兵们却有着一段传奇的历史。多年来，他们一直在借助古老的圣石武器对抗蚀魂夜，这些武器会将他们的灵魂引导到强大的光明中。但现在最重要的是前方的战斗，因为破败之王正在侵蚀符文之地，这一切都是为了再一次与他的王后共舞。

nameZh: 光明哨兵 锐雯 帝国抗击者
descriptionZh: 锐雯加入了哨兵队，希望为她在诺克萨斯入侵艾欧尼亚中所扮演的角色赎罪。在奋力逃出一座正在急速崩解的诺克萨斯主城后，她意识到自己可能没剩多少时间了。不过，她相信她的生命只是弥补过错的小小代价。
descriptionEn: Riven joins the Sentinels hoping to atone for her role in the Noxian invasion of Ionia. After fighting her way out of a rapidly destabilizing City of Noxus, she understands that her time may be fleeting. However, she believes her life is a small price to pay to make amends.

nameZh: 光明哨兵 黛安娜 帝国抗击者
descriptionZh: 巨神峰的破败和战争星灵的折损，使拉阔尔族群哀鸿遍野。但能与一位星灵相抗衡的，只有另一位星灵——因此黛安娜拿起了她的剑，成为了光明哨兵的一员，因为她知道佛耶戈将摧毁月光触碰到的一切事物。
descriptionEn: The Ruination of Targon and the loss of the Aspect of War devastated the Rakkor tribes. But the only way to fight an Aspect's power is with another Aspect—and so Diana takes up her blade as a member of the Sentinels, knowing that Viego would destroy everything the moonlight touches.
