nameZh: 灵魂莲华 艾希 朝花
descriptionZh: 据“迷途女王”的神话讲述，她的好奇心促使她与“林母”交换了位置。这个选择的代价是高昂的，她回来后看到她忠诚的“玉手剑侍”与“林母”陷入了战斗。她扑到他们中间，死在了“玉手剑侍”的怀里，并且她的遗言是一个道歉。现在，她在荒野里游荡，指引着迷途者们。
descriptionEn: Myth tells of the Wandering Queen, whose curiosity led her to trade places with the Grovemother. The cost of this choice was high, and she returned to see her loyal Ready Hand and the Grovemother locked in combat. Throwing herself between them, she died in the Ready Hand's arms, her final words an apology. Now she roams the wilds, guiding the lost.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 幽梦玫瑰 辛德拉 浪漫花蕾
descriptionZh: 辛德拉已经被这个节庆给故意避开了很多年，因为她支持蒙羞的劫。她再也不能忍受这种轻蔑了，决定渗透到这场盛事中，用她那甘甜的毒液去毒害水晶玫瑰的心脏。
descriptionEn: Syndra has been shunned from the festival for years over her support of the disgraced Zed. Unable to bear this slight any longer, she is determined to infiltrate the event and poison the very heart of the Crystal Rose itself with her sweetly dripping ichor.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 水晶玫瑰节庆欢迎所有相信其和平明天梦想的人，尽管许多人已经对这个事业不再抱有幻想。那些组成幽梦玫瑰的人希望看到它结束。但没有人能对节日的魅力免疫；或许他们也会被傍晚的美景卷入其中并改变心意。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Crystal Rose Festival welcomes all who believe in its dream of a peaceful tomorrow, though many have grown disenchanted with the whole affair. Those who make up the Withered Rose wish to see it come to an end. But no one is immune to the festival's charm; perhaps they too will be swept away by the evening's beauty and have a change of heart.

universes.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，充满了经常破裂的魔法同盟和数百年积怨。而每年一度的水晶玫瑰节庆，则为强者们提供了一个中立的场所，来原谅彼此的怠慢并重新协商停战协议。大家会做做样子似的把武器留在门口，并通过采摘和佩戴只有在节庆期间生长的魔法玫瑰来示意有潜在的全新契约。
universes.descriptionEn: In a world of frequently-broken magical alliances and centuries-old grudges, the annual Crystal Rose Festival offers a neutral ground for the powerful to forgive slights and renegotiate truces. Weapons are ostensibly left at the door, and potential new pacts are signaled by picking and wearing the magical roses that grow only during the festival.

nameZh: 暗星女王 黛安娜 天神星之陨
descriptionZh: 黛安娜曾经是星界女王“御星魔矢”艾希的宠儿，但被打上异端的标签并遭到放逐，皆因她对暗星能量表现出过多的兴趣而令星廷感到不快。被遗弃在荒凉虚无的太空中漂流的她别无选择，只能投身于让她着迷已久的那团混沌。
descriptionEn: Diana was once a favorite of Cosmic Queen Ashe, but was labeled a heretic and banished for trying to understand the Dark Star's power with a little too much interest for the Court's comfort. Left adrift in the bleak nothingness of space, she had no choice but to embrace the chaos that had fascinated her for so long.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 热寂将众多星系吞没在暗星的大口中，而它的腐化者们——由黑洞湮灭组成的巨大生物——扼杀着它们接触到的每一个星系之中的存在之光，并将其投入到虚无之中。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Entropy engulfs galaxies in the yawning maw of the Dark Star, whose corruptants, titanic creatures of black-hole oblivion, snuff out the light of existence in every system they touch and plunge them into nothingness.

universes.descriptionZh: 在宇宙广阔无垠的黑暗中滋生了无数恐怖的生物，以及来自暗星的庞然大物。它们是寂末之神的子嗣，它们终将卷土重来。
universes.descriptionEn: In the vast darkness of space are born terrible, beautiful things—Cosmic creatures of sublime love, and the unknowable monstrosities of the Dark Star. These are the children of silent gods, and they are finally coming home.

nameZh: 焰阳仙灵 妮蔻
descriptionZh: 妮蔻是一个古老且神秘的冬季精怪，以一种近似于孩童般的好奇看待着她周围的世界。她最近刚从魄罗之王的广袤领土上回来，并且变得沉迷于这个在她不在时崛起的文明。
descriptionEn: An ancient and mysterious winter sprite, Neeko regards the world around her with an almost childlike curiosity. Having recently returned from beyond the Poro King's vast domain, she has become enamored with the civilization that has risen in her absence.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在神奇的冬季仙境中，魄罗王之的统治至高无上，向他王庭的所有人传播欢乐和喜悦。尽管其他人都想篡夺国王的王位，但他们都对冬境仙灵们有着共同的热爱。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Within the magical Winterlands, the Poro King reigns supreme, spreading joy and merriment to all of his court. Even as others work to usurp the king, all share a common love for winter's wonders.

universes.descriptionZh: 一年中还有比空气清新、雪花蓬松、巧克力热腾腾的冰雪节更好的时候吗？投掷雪球或吟唱颂歌；只要你怀着好心情，一切都会好起来的，然后你就没有什么好怕的了。
universes.descriptionEn: Is there a better time of year than Snowdown, when the air is crisp, the snow fluffy, and the chocolate hot? Toss a snowball or sing a carol; as long as you have good cheer, all will be well, and you'll have nothing to fear.

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 瑟提 魅之魂焰
descriptionZh: 这位战士来这里是为了证明拳头可以成为一切的答案！也就是说，假定一切的问题是“一个人如何赢得历史上最多的本地锦标赛？”他这样做不仅仅是为了看起来不错——尽管这也是一个不错的奖励——而是为了跻身为斗魂传奇人物，让他的妈妈感到骄傲。有请瑟——提！
descriptionEn: This fighter is here to prove that fists CAN be the answer to everything! That is, assuming the question of everything is "how does one person win the most local tourneys in recorded history?" And he's not just doing it to look good—though that is a nice bonus—he's rising up the ranks to soul fightin' legend to make his momma proud. It's Sssssett!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

universes.descriptionZh: 来自世界各地，那些斗魂已经觉醒的人们被邀请参加……斗魂武道大会！它是凌驾于所有娱乐之上的王者，是一个无与伦比的电视奇观！战士们在擂台上一对一单挑，直至只剩一人拿到大奖：灵魂最深处的愿望！而我会在这里，播报这一切！
universes.descriptionEn: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 女帝 菲奥娜 纹章之刻印·敏锐
descriptionZh: 泰勒姆——一个残酷的女帝之国——的贵族们密谋反对菲奥娜的上台，夺走了她的眼睛并对她的死亡大肆宣传。然而，她从鲜花和火焰中现身，然后在“神圣加冕礼”上获胜。女帝菲奥娜现在负责监督国立钢铁花园的武器制造，并通过训练和锻炼一位脾气暴躁的公主来确保她的权力继承。
descriptionEn: Nobles in the cutthroat queendom of Telum conspired against Fiora's rise to power, taking her eye and proclaiming her dead. Yet from flowers and flame she arose, then prevailed, in the Grand Coronation. Queen Fiora now oversees arms manufacturing in her nation's steel gardens, and secures her succession by training and tempering a certain fiery princess.

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……
universes.descriptionEn: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 幻灵狮心 蕾欧娜 魅影闪击
descriptionZh: 蕾欧娜是幻灵战队值得信赖的前线防御者、大姐姐，以及其狂野成员们的官方领头者。必须有人确保爆破队的那些点火者们安全返回基地！不过，不要以为蕾欧娜无法独自承受痛苦。当战斗来临时，你会听到她的狮吼！
descriptionEn: Leona is Anima Squad's reliable front-line defense, big sister, and official wrangler of its wilder members. Someone has to make sure those fire starters from the demolitions team get safely back to base! Don't think Leona can't bring the pain on her own, though. When it comes to battle, you will hear her roar!

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

nameZh: 点心宝贝 萨勒芬妮 香蕉冰糖葫芦
descriptionZh: 萨勒芬妮是一位双栖艺人，既会唱歌又会做饭，让餐馆的客人们感到既暖心又暖胃。她说，为美食而到来，为旋律而驻足！她的梦想是成为餐馆的明星，让厨师和顾客都为之着迷。
descriptionEn: Seraphine's a double threat who sings and cooks, leaving the cafe's guests swooning and sated in equal measure. Come for the treats, she says, stay for the tunes! Her dream is to become the cafe's star attraction, enchanting chefs and customers alike.
heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

skinSets.descriptionZh: 任何一位出色的糕点大师都知道，没有美味佳肴的聚会就不是完整的聚会。虽然他们的参观可能是新的，但做点心的艺术却不是——并且这些神奇的厨师愿意通过揉、剁、煎、蒸等方式打造出色香味俱全的美食。只需咬一口这些美味的面团，即使是脾气最暴躁的顾客也会迫切想要当场入座然后大饱口福。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Any pastry mage worth their salt knows no get-together is complete without savory treats. Though their cafe may be new, the art of making dumplings isn't—and these magical chefs are willing to knead, chop, fry, and steam their way to culinary greatness. Just one bite of these doughy delights will make even the grumpiest patron eager to pull up a chair and celebrate.

skinNameZh: 点心宝贝 萨勒芬妮

nameZh: 点心宝贝 辛德拉 芥菜点心
descriptionZh: 辛德拉是一位天赋异禀、潜力无限的烹饪大师。她的野心总是让她创造出奢华的美食——当她的厨师同事们的作品达不到她的标准时，她就会和他们发生争执。不过，当每道菜的味道都如此美妙时，还会有顾客抱怨吗？
descriptionEn: A gifted culinary mage with limitless potential, Syndra's ambition always gives rise to decadent treats—and stirs feuds with her fellow chefs when their creations fall short of her standards. Still, what customer can complain when everything tastes so sensational?

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 安妮 酒醉樱桃
descriptionZh: 作为咖啡馆老板的女儿和一位多才多艺的糕点法师神童，安妮对甜食有着不容忽视的酷爱。虽然她偶尔因肚饿而发脾气时，会派她施了魔法的小熊软糖在咖啡馆里搜寻适合主人吃的任何食物，但饱餐后的安妮就像糖一样甜！
descriptionEn: Daughter of the cafe's owner and an accomplished pastry mage wunderkind, Annie has a sweet tooth to be reckoned with. Though her occasional hangry tantrums send her enchanted gummy bear scouring the cafe for any morsel of food fit for his master, with a full belly Annie is as sweet as sugar!

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 怦然心动 凯特琳 克制亦是放肆
descriptionZh: 我讨厌你走路的样子，就像你是购物中心的凯特琳小公主，而我只是阴沟老鼠。我讨厌你在周围没有其他人时看我的眼神，在镇上却死都不肯和我一起。也许我们的整件事只是一个巨大的错误。所以如果你想让我走，我就走。但是请求我的话，我就留。——蔚
descriptionEn: I hate the way you walk around, like you're Princess Caitlyn of the mall, and I'm just some gutter rat. I hate the way you look at me when there's no one else around, but wouldn't be caught dead with me in town. Maybe our whole thing was just a huge mistake. So if you want me to go, I'm gone. But ask, and I will stay. -Vi

skinSets.descriptionZh: 洋溢着学院风且风度翩翩的心动派与宁愿逃课去滑板场闲逛的心伤组没有太多共同之处。但他们在一件事上达成了一致：他们已经受够了这个为了人们萌生感情而硬造出来的愚蠢节日。那么，为什么他们似乎无法摆脱这种小鹿乱撞的感觉呢？
skinSets.descriptionEn: The preppy and perfectly poised Heartthrob clique don't have much in common with the Heartache crew, who would much rather be ditching class to hang out at the skatepark. But they agree on one thing: they've had it with this silly made up holiday dedicated to people catching feelings. So why can't they seem to shake the butterflies from their stomachs?

universes.descriptionZh: 在刻板的小团体、尴尬的小组项目和俗气的假日之间，校园生活枯燥且乏味。但坠入爱河并不在教学大纲里，并且它会让事情变得更复杂。
universes.descriptionEn: Between the rigid cliques, awkward group projects, and cheesy holidays, school was rough but routine. But getting lovestruck wasn't in the syllabus, and it's gonna make things way more complicated.

nameZh: 剪纸仙灵 烬 日进斗金
descriptionZh: 在月之舞者们扭曲剪纸仙境之后，烬是卡西奥佩娅的第一个造物。他体现了神话之蛇最阴险的那些品质：阴险、算计和恶意。烬对这位女神仁慈的行事方式感到不满，打算以自己的形象重建人类，并让他们感受苦难之美。
descriptionEn: Jhin is the first of Cassiopeia's creations after the Lunar Players distort the world of myth. He embodies the mythical snake's most insidious qualities: sinister, calculating, and malicious. Displeased with the goddess's benevolent methods, Jhin plans to recreate humanity in his image and introduce them to the beauty of suffering.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，大年兽加里奥的失败让春节的新年传统得以兴盛，并且这些传统通过重述那个史诗故事而得以延续。这个故事本身就是一个活生生的世界——但当这个故事世界被突然扰打断时，故事中的各个角色必须共同努力来解决这个乱局，并书写他们自己的神话。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, the defeat of the Great Beast Galio gave rise to Lunar New Year traditions that are carried on through the retelling of that epic tale. Within the story itself lies a living world all its own—but when the world of the story is suddenly interrupted, the characters must work together to fix the mess and see their own myth through.

universes.descriptionZh: 故事、神话、传说：每个人都有一个自己的世界，在这个世界里，在讲述和重述角色们的故事时，这些角色会一遍又一遍地经历着考验和磨难。
universes.descriptionEn: Stories, myths, legends: within each lies a world unto itself, where characters act out their trials and tribulations over and over as their tales are told and retold.

nameZh: 至臻 双城之战2 指挥官 凯特琳 华星
descriptionZh: 作为吉拉曼恩家族的后裔，凯特琳知道如何在进门的瞬间就赢得所有人的尊重——凭的不仅是她利落的外表，更是她那双犀利的眼睛。如今，她已经爬到了执法官领袖的位置，誓要为皮尔特沃夫的将来做出更有价值的贡献。
descriptionEn: As scion of the Kiramman family, Caitlyn knows how to command respect from the moment she enters a room—not only with her sharp appearance, but her even-sharper gaze as well. Having climbed the ranks to lead the city's enforcers, she makes an even stronger asset to the future of Piltover.

universes.descriptionZh: 在皮尔特沃夫和祖安这两个城市，随着发明家和窃贼、政客和地下领主对一个四分五裂的社会的所带来的种种束缚感到恼火，不安的情绪在不停搅动。随着诸多英雄的诞生和诸多纽带的破裂，发现和风险相互纠缠。这种力量会改变世界，还是会导致世界毁灭？
universes.descriptionEn: In the cities of Piltover and Zaun, unrest stirs as inventors and thieves, politicians and crime lords chafe against the constraints of a society torn asunder. Discovery and danger intertwine as heroes are born and bonds are broken. Will this power change the world, or lead it to ruin?

skinNameZh: 至臻 双城之战2 指挥官 凯特琳

nameZh: 焰尾妖狐 阿狸 青春之焰
descriptionZh: 阿狸是来自黯焰寺院的一个年轻且有天赋的控火士。在一个极端组织释放了灰烬领主的那些熊熊燃烧的恐魔们时，她放弃了她平静的生活。现在，她使用她的火焰魔法来与它们作战，即使所有希望似乎都已破灭。
descriptionEn: A young, talented pyromancer from the Shadowfire Temple, Ahri gave up her quiet life when a faction of extremists unleashed the burning horrors of the Ashen Lord. Now she uses her fire magic to fight against them, even though all hope seems lost.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 灼烧一整个世界需要难以想象的力量，这就是为什么灰烬领主号召他的地狱火军团借出他们的火焰。从最黑暗的深处，他们每个人都带来了自己可怕的力量，尽管并非所有人都以同样炽热的热情回应他们的号召。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Scorching an entire world takes unimaginable strength, which is why the Ashen Lord called upon his legions of Infernals to lend their flames. From the darkest depths, they each bring their own terrible powers to bear, though not all answer their call with the same burning enthusiasm.

universes.descriptionZh: 烈火、硫磺和死亡。这个世界已无法回到灰烬领主崛起之前的状态。这是一个梦想，已经迷失于火山遍布的土地之下的灼热熔岩河流中。现在，一个新的时代开始了，这个时代将永远燃烧。
universes.descriptionEn: Fire, sulfur, and death. There is no returning to what the world was before the Ashen Lord rose. It is a dream, lost to the searing lava rivers beneath volcano-strewn lands. Now a new age begins, one that will burn for eternity.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 锤石 春晓
descriptionZh: 艾欧尼亚人经常用低语发出警告，让彼此警惕撷仙的存在。他们认为，这个充满欲念的灵物会引诱逝者偏离救赎之路。人们纷纷告诫着，“当心他的贪婪”。被他诱捕的人将永世落入囚牢，成为他爱不释手的灵魂藏品。
descriptionEn: Ionians often speak of the Soul Collector in hushed warnings—for it is he, this obsessive spirit, whom they believe tempts the dead away from their path to salvation. “Beware his greed,” they say, for those he finds and entraps will be locked away for eternity, baubles in his prized collection of souls.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 卡西奥佩娅 春晓
descriptionZh: 曾经有位聪慧而又美丽的公主，与自己的姐妹积怨颇深。她认为自己才是王位的正统继承人，因此想要毒害自己的对手——但不知为何，她柔软的皮肤上忽然现出了蛇鳞。那一夜，这位魅力无穷的蛇女便消失在群山之中。但时至今日，虔诚的信徒仍在寻求着她的指引。
descriptionEn: There once was a princess as clever as she was beautiful, who harbored a bitter feud with her sister. Convinced she was the rightful heir to the throne, she tried to poison her rival—but instead, serpent scales bloomed across her soft skin. The Alluring Serpent disappeared that night into the mountains, but the faithful still seek her counsel to this day.
heroNameZh: 魔蛇之拥 卡西奥佩娅

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 瑟提 春晓
descriptionZh: 明昼是平和宁静的灵物，而夜幽则注定永世游荡。传说有个灵魂兼具明昼与夜幽的特性，他的内心也因此充满了矛盾。他曾终日享乐，后来遭到父亲的唾弃，因此决意复仇。如今这位“无家之子”正在亡灵中寻觅值得一战的练习对手，不断磨砺自己，准备迎接迄今为止最伟大的战斗。
descriptionEn: Kanmei are peaceful spirits, while akana wander in perpetuity. Yet legend tells of a spirit of both worlds—akana and kanmei—at odds with himself. The spirit enjoyed eternal bliss until, spurned by his father, he sought vengeance. Now the Banished Son searches among the slain for worthy warriors with whom to spar, preparing for his greatest fight yet.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 易 春晓
descriptionZh: 孤一大师平生仅有一位弟子，他视他为传人，倾囊相授，可最终弟子却背叛了他。孤一大师就此陨落——并非因刀戈，而是因心碎。命中注定一般，他陷入了悲苦的命运：徒劳且无尽地寻找那不知所踪的弟子，那个唯一能继承自己衣钵的存在。
descriptionEn: The Lonely Master took but one apprentice in his lifetime and poured all of his wisdom into him, believing he had found a successor. When his student betrayed him, however, the Lonely Master perished—not by the blade, but from a broken heart. Thus he was doomed to search forever in vain for his lost pupil—the sole heir to his legacy.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 永恩 流火
descriptionZh: 据“兄弟之争”的故事记载，初生之土曾经发生过一场因荣誉而起的战争。年长的哥哥是一位恪守传统、尽责为民的领主，最终却被迫与自己的血亲同室操戈。两兄弟在最后的交锋中双双丧命——过分追逐荣耀带来的致命教训。
descriptionEn: Pride once set the First Lands aflame, as recounted in the Tale of the Warring Brothers. The Elder was a lord who upheld tradition and duty in serving his people, until he was forced to confront his own kin. Both brothers fell in their final clash—a fatal lesson in hubris.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 索拉卡 春晓
descriptionZh: 很久以前，一颗星高悬在初生之土上方。她温柔地微笑着，将下界照亮。然而，石巨人嫉妒那颗星发出的光芒，将她从天穹扯落，心碎的星就这样坠向大地。传说，这颗失窃的星至今仍行走于世间，将光辉赐予凡人——这对某些人来说是希望的明灯，却足以灼伤另一些人的眼睛。
descriptionEn: Long ago, a star shone above the First Lands, smiling as she gently lit the world below. But a stone giant envied the star's light, and tore her from the heavens. Heartbroken, the star plummeted to the earth. It is said to this day that the Stolen Star walks among mortals, bestowing her radiance upon them—a beacon of hope to some, but blinding to others.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 伊芙琳 春晓
descriptionZh: 在饱受痛苦与恐惧折磨时，凡人们可以向“苦噬之灵”祈愿，以期缓解自身的重负。然而每份赠礼后面都暗藏着代价：其中就有一个故事，说一名女子的情感过于沉重，于是被恶魔盯上了。“苦噬之灵”提出，她可以尽情吞噬其欲望与记忆。当她饱足之时，女人陷入了永久的静谧——痛苦消失了，但随之而去的还有一切的悲喜。
descriptionEn: Mortals burdened by pain and fear may pray to the Sorrow Eater to alleviate their burdens. But every gift comes at a price. One tale recounts a woman whose weighty emotions had made her the prey of demonkin. The Sorrow Eater offered to dine freely on her desires and memories—and when she was sated, the woman was at peace, free of pain…and of feeling.

nameZh: 狼神英灵 卡特琳娜 魅影追猎
descriptionZh: 亲爱的狼，我们的国度迎来了一名刺客。虽然她蛰伏于阴影之中，却能让敌人的心中爬满恐惧。所以你才相中了她，不是吗？她身手矫捷、杀气凛凛、信念坚定。有她的加入，这场“永恒追猎”势必会很精彩。
descriptionEn: An assassin was welcomed into our realm, dear Wolf. Though she moves in shadow, she strikes fear in the hearts of her foes. That caught your attention, didn't it? Her speed. Her violence. Her conviction. A welcome addition to the Eternal Chase.
heroNameZh: 不祥之刃 卡特琳娜

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当年轻的战争领袖安蓓萨在战斗中阵亡时，她被赐予了狛尔拉琛的幻像，一个由狼神赐给有价值的追随者们的神圣来世。所有被迎进这个庇护地的人都必须加入“永恒追猎”，在战斗中找到赐福，并在永无止境的狩猎中愉快地挑战他们的战士英灵同伴们。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When the young warleader Ambessa falls in battle, she is granted a vision of Volrachnun, a hallowed afterlife for worthy followers of the Wolf. All who are welcomed into this haven must join the Eternal Chase, finding bliss in battle and joyfully challenging their fellow chosen warriors in a never-ending hunt.

skinNameZh: 狼神英灵 卡特琳娜

nameZh: 魔女 阿狸 污蔑
descriptionZh: 它们来到阿狸身边，在第一缕暮光中——暗光豺狼的笑声，一直追猎着这个世界，正如它转向自身不可避免的熵增。 作为凶恶的掠食者和强大的女巫，阿狸从被她引诱靠近的所有生物那里吸取生命，并将其输送向她在黑暗中的领主。
descriptionEn: They came to Ahri at the first stirrings of dusk—the laughter of the Half-Light Jackal, ever stalking the world as it turned towards its own inevitable entropy. A vicious predator and powerful witch, Ahri sucks the life from all she lures close, siphoning it towards her lord within the gloom.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 女巫们蛰伏以待，一个充满了骇人美貌的姐妹会，她们的希望从不再神圣的双唇中低语而出。她们谈到了古神们的膨胀尸体，谈到了用人类早已遗忘的魔法进行的古老仪式，谈到了她们所谓的“秩序”的回归，但也有人称之为“苦难”。听！人类的末日即将来临。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The witches lay in wait, a sisterhood of frightening pulchritude, their hopes whispered forth from desacralized lips. They speak of the bloating corpses of Old Gods, of ancient rites carried out with magics long forgotten to mortal mind, of the return of what they call "order", but others call "suffering". Hark! Mankind's end fast approaches.

universes.descriptionZh: 起初，古神们统治着世界。人类对他们的爱是如此之大，以至于某个古神敢于让他们永远成为她肉体的一部分。她吞噬了太阳本身，并从那空无的天堂降临，激励她的骑士们消灭所有剩下的人。几个世纪后，他们屹立不倒，成为对抗崛起的魔女团之暗的唯一希望。
universes.descriptionEn: In the beginning, the Old Gods reigned. So great was humankind's love for them that one dared to make them a part of her flesh forever. She devoured the sun itself and, descending from that empty heaven, inspired her knights to decimate all those that remained. Centuries later, they stand, the only hope against the rising Coven's darkness.

nameZh: 魅惑女巫 莫甘娜 热情化身
descriptionZh: 不幸的是，“不给糖就捣蛋”越来越少地涉及到黑魔法和神秘迷信，越来越多地涉及到找到一套适合的COS装束。你见过这些尺寸吗？这东西是做给谁的呢？
descriptionEn: Ultimately, trick-or-treating is less about dark magic and occult superstition, and more about finding a witch costume that actually fits. Have you seen these sizes? Who is this stuff even made for…?!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 谁说女巫们不能嬉闹？不管是谁，那家伙现在可能是一只青蛙了。或是其他一些被诅咒的害虫，注定永远在街上徘徊，从远处观看庆典前夜的庆祝活动。相当严厉的惩罚，但你在期待什么？ 她们可能知道如何举办派对，但到了晚上，她们仍然是女巫！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Who said witches can't have fun? Whoever it was, they're probably a frog now. Or some other cursed vermin, doomed to forever wander the streets, watching the eve's celebrations from afar. Pretty harsh punishment, but what did you expect? They may know how to throw a party, but at the end of the night, they're still witches!

universes.descriptionZh: 父母们在他们的孩子们讲述着关于邪恶女巫之类的故事：她们每年都会有一个晚上潜伏在街道之中。 “待在床上，小家伙，因为黑暗是她们的朋友。” 这些故事只有一部分是真的；虽然这个迷人夜晚的食尸鬼喜欢吓人，但他们绝不会伤害孩子的一根头发。那些特别淘气的除外。
universes.descriptionEn: Parents tell their children stories of wicked witches and the like, those that lurk the streets one night each year. "Stay in your bed, little one, for darkness is their friend." These tales are only partly true; while the ghouls of this enchanted evening love a good scare, they'd never harm a hair on a child's head. Except for the very naughty ones.

nameZh: 魅影之刃 锐雯
descriptionZh: 再说一遍“疯兔子”。有种你就说给她听。
descriptionEn: Say “Hoppin' Mad” one more time. She dares you.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这就是一门生计！
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's a living!

universes.descriptionZh: 磨砺之路不仅仅是工作。它是斗争，是喧嚣，有时令人振奋，有时令人沮丧。它是一个为期一周的过山车，有喜剧性的过弯和悲惨的急落，只会在周一重新开始。我们是努力工作还是几乎不工作？在磨砺之路上，一切都一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The grind isn't just work. It's the struggle, the hustle, sometimes invigorating, sometimes demoralizing. It's a weeklong rollercoaster with comedic bends and tragic drops, only to start all over again on Monday. Are we working hard or hardly working? It's all the same on the grind.

nameZh: 嘟！嘟 ！奥恩 “钻石意志”号
descriptionZh: 奥恩吹响口哨，召唤出一头强大的钢铁巨兽，随着他的锻炉怒火而轰鸣。在他的锤子像铁轨上的活塞一样敲出节奏时，他闷烧的胡须下露出了被烟灰浸透的笑容。他一定感受到了创造的快感，感受到了一台完美机器出现于世间的喜悦！
descriptionEn: With a toot of his whistle, Ornn calls forth a mighty iron beast, roaring with his forge's fury. As his hammer pounds out a rhythm like pistons on the track, a soot-soaked grin unfurls beneath his smoldering beard. One imagines he must feel the thrill of creation, the joy of a perfect machine made manifest!
heroNameEn: The Fire below the Mountain Ornn

skinSets.descriptionZh: 纳尔的玩具箱闪耀着无价之宝的光辉，但没人在家时，他的玩具会过一种属于它们自己的生活……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gnar's toy chest is brimming with priceless treasures, but when no one's home, his toys take on a life of their own...

universes.descriptionZh: 纳尔的玩具箱闪耀着无价之宝的光辉，但没人在家时，他的玩具会过一种属于它们自己的生活……
universes.descriptionEn: Gnar's toy chest is brimming with priceless treasures, but when no one's home, his toys take on a life of their own...

nameZh: 榴莲龙龟 拉莫斯 霜雪之壳
descriptionZh: 拉莫斯穿着一身刺鼻的果皮在这片土地上漫游，虽然他看起来很可爱，但他给“沉默但致命”赋予了新的含义。有人说这个恶臭谜团的盔甲散发着污水和汗袜子的臭味，但意志坚强的战士知道他到底有多可爱——前提是你能克服这种气味。
descriptionEn: Rammus roams the land in a pungent peel, and though he may look adorable, he gives new meaning to the phrase “silent but deadly.” Some say the effluvial enigma's armor reeks of sewage and sweaty socks, but strong-willed warriors know how sweet he can really be—if you can get past the smell.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这些食物既美味又致命，不会不战而降。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Both mouthwatering and foe slaughtering, these foods aren't going down without a fight.

universes.descriptionZh: 谁说不能玩美食的？
universes.descriptionEn: Who says you can't play with your food?

nameZh: 女帝 格温 纹章之刻印·果决
descriptionZh: 卡利戈，一个遥远的、古老的女帝之国，长期以来被认为已经消失在时间中。来自卡利戈的格温冲破了这个国家的保护云层，与伊莱西亚的其他国度重新建立了联系。她的前任——女帝伊苏尔德——相信格温的纯洁心灵和敏锐头脑会证实卡利戈的力量并与其他统治者们结盟——因为黑暗时代就在前方，只有一份坚定不移的盟约才能防止最坏的情况发生。
descriptionEn: Gwen of Caligo—a faraway, ancient queendom long thought lost to time—cut through the nation's protective clouds to reconnect with the rest of Elysia. Her predecessor, Queen Isolde, trusts Gwen's pure heart and sharp mind to affirm Caligo's strength and ally with fellow rulers—for dark times lie ahead, and only a steadfast pact may prevent the worst.

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……
universes.descriptionEn: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 腥红之月 婕拉 鎏金
descriptionZh: 当许多腥红之月女祭司遵从她们魔鬼的低语时，婕拉的那个魔鬼发出的却是欢愉的嚎叫——而婕拉也以同样的方式回应。婕拉和她的魔鬼出于对堕落的渴望而联合起来，寻找她的女祭司同伴，以便将她们团结为一个整体。只有这样，她们才能将她们的毁灭之举散播到艾欧尼亚边界以外的世界。
descriptionEn: While many Blood Moon priestesses follow the whispers of their demons, Zyra's demon howls with sadistic glee—and Zyra responds in kind. United in their thirst for corruption, Zyra and her demon seek out her fellow priestesses in order to unite them all as one. Only then can they spread their destruction to the world beyond Ionia's borders.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 一个远古教派，寻求着不可抗拒的力量，总在血月之夜现身实行亵渎、秘传的仪式——用恶灵融合他们的肉身，并变成一个拥有恒增黑暗的存在。
skinSets.descriptionEn: An ancient cult, seeking irresistible power, surfaces on nights of the Blood Moon to perform profane, esoteric rites—merging their flesh with demonic spirits, and becoming one with an ever greater darkness.

universes.descriptionZh: 一个声音从寂静中回响：“翻腾吧，野兽们，教友们。艾欧尼亚在劫难逃，它的诸多月亮像饥饿的恶魔的眼睛一样升起，等待着你们忠诚的红色——抑或它们是无法越过的可怕荒芜？ 无论是哪种方式，我们都是沉浸在仪式和献祭中的躯壳。在月亮的顶峰，我们从肉中切肉，献上微薄的礼物——我们自身的一切。”
universes.descriptionEn: A voice echoes from the silence: “Writhe, beasts, brethren. The moons of a doomed Ionia rise like eyes of starved demons, awaiting the red of your fealty—or are they monstrous blights that cannot pass? Either way, we are vessels plunged in ritual and sacrifice. At the moon's peak, we carve flesh from flesh, offering the meager gift of all that we are.”

nameZh: 心之钢 厄斐琉斯 金声玉振
descriptionZh: 厄斐琉斯是一位精通多种乐器的音乐天才，对自己技艺的热情近乎于痴迷，是心之钢的作曲家和创意骨干。尽管厄斐琉斯很少说话，但有这支由音乐怪咖们组成的狂野乐队和他的双胞胎妹妹（乐队的经理拉露恩）在他身边，他已经准备好让他的创作之声被响亮而清晰地听到。
descriptionEn: A multi-instrumental musical genius whose passion for his craft is nigh obsessive, Aphelios is the composer and creative backbone of HEARTSTEEL.  Though he rarely ever speaks, with this wild band of musical misfits and his twin sister (the band's manager Alune) by his side, Aphelios is ready to have his creative voice heard loud and clear.
heroNameZh: 残月之肃 厄斐琉斯
heroNameEn: the Weapon of the Faithful Aphelios

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 幽梦玫瑰 辛德拉 纯洁花蕾
descriptionZh: 辛德拉已经被这个节庆给故意避开了很多年，因为她支持蒙羞的劫。她再也不能忍受这种轻蔑了，决定渗透到这场盛事中，用她那甘甜的毒液去毒害水晶玫瑰的心脏。
descriptionEn: Syndra has been shunned from the festival for years over her support of the disgraced Zed. Unable to bear this slight any longer, she is determined to infiltrate the event and poison the very heart of the Crystal Rose itself with her sweetly dripping ichor.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 水晶玫瑰节庆欢迎所有相信其和平明天梦想的人，尽管许多人已经对这个事业不再抱有幻想。那些组成幽梦玫瑰的人希望看到它结束。但没有人能对节日的魅力免疫；或许他们也会被傍晚的美景卷入其中并改变心意。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Crystal Rose Festival welcomes all who believe in its dream of a peaceful tomorrow, though many have grown disenchanted with the whole affair. Those who make up the Withered Rose wish to see it come to an end. But no one is immune to the festival's charm; perhaps they too will be swept away by the evening's beauty and have a change of heart.

universes.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，充满了经常破裂的魔法同盟和数百年积怨。而每年一度的水晶玫瑰节庆，则为强者们提供了一个中立的场所，来原谅彼此的怠慢并重新协商停战协议。大家会做做样子似的把武器留在门口，并通过采摘和佩戴只有在节庆期间生长的魔法玫瑰来示意有潜在的全新契约。
universes.descriptionEn: In a world of frequently-broken magical alliances and centuries-old grudges, the annual Crystal Rose Festival offers a neutral ground for the powerful to forgive slights and renegotiate truces. Weapons are ostensibly left at the door, and potential new pacts are signaled by picking and wearing the magical roses that grow only during the festival.

nameZh: 水晶玫瑰 斯维因 纯洁花蕾
descriptionZh: 斯维因知道水晶玫瑰节庆上结成的联盟有多重要……又有多脆弱。他想要看到盛事完美进行的决心，使他与婕拉——水晶玫瑰的保护者——产生了联系。在她的帮助下，他希望这是有史以来最成功的节庆——届时他将作为这个节庆的设计师而闻名于世。
descriptionEn: Swain knows how important the alliances formed at the Festival of the Crystal Rose are… and how fragile. His determination to see the event go perfectly has gained him a connection with Zyra, the Rose's protector. With her help, he intends this to be the most successful festival ever—and that he will be celebrated as its architect.
heroNameZh: 诺克萨斯统领 斯维因

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在一年一度的水晶玫瑰节庆上，浪漫和欢乐弥漫在空气中，而敌手们在和平、中立的地方相遇，分享一个满是舞蹈与欢乐的夜晚，并为未来许下愿望。每个人都应该把他们的武器留在门口，作为对美好明天的承诺。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Romance and joy are in the air at the yearly Crystal Rose Festival, where adversaries meet on peaceful, neutral ground to share a night of dancing, merriment, and making wishes for the future. Everyone is expected to leave their weapons at the door as a promise for a better tomorrow.

universes.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，充满了经常破裂的魔法同盟和数百年积怨。而每年一度的水晶玫瑰节庆，则为强者们提供了一个中立的场所，来原谅彼此的怠慢并重新协商停战协议。大家会做做样子似的把武器留在门口，并通过采摘和佩戴只有在节庆期间生长的魔法玫瑰来示意有潜在的全新契约。
universes.descriptionEn: In a world of frequently-broken magical alliances and centuries-old grudges, the annual Crystal Rose Festival offers a neutral ground for the powerful to forgive slights and renegotiate truces. Weapons are ostensibly left at the door, and potential new pacts are signaled by picking and wearing the magical roses that grow only during the festival.

nameZh: 战斗公主 安妮 纹章之刻印·强运
descriptionZh: 安妮在泰勒姆王廷前展示了她的魔法天赋，将她亲爱的泰迪熊变成了一位由钢铁与火焰组成的骑士。尽管这对许多贵族来说几乎是一次近乎灾难性的表现，但女帝菲奥娜还是接受了这个孩子的潜力，并指定她作为继任者。安妮为了在未来的加冕礼上取得胜利而不断训练……但也不断给她的王室导师添乱。
descriptionEn: Annie revealed her magical talents before Telum's royal court, transforming her dear teddy bear into a knight of steel and flame. Though a near-fatal display for many aristocrats, Queen Fiora embraced the child's potential and named her successor. Annie trains to triumph in a future Coronation… and causes a fair amount of mischief for her regal mentor.

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……

They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 剪纸仙灵 嘉文四世 日进斗金
descriptionZh: 嘉文四世——这一地区的皇帝——不惜一切代价保护他的国度免受外来者的侵害，而这导致他经常与其他神发生冲突。但当“大恶人”烬构成了前所未有的威胁时，嘉文四世发现他自己正在与那些意料之外的盟友合作，为人类的生存铺平道路。
descriptionEn: The region's Emperor, Jarvan IV, does whatever it takes to protect his realm from outsiders, leading him to frequent clashes with other gods. But when the malicious Jhin poses a threat greater than any before, he finds himself working with unlikely allies to pave the way for humanity's survival.
heroNameZh: 德玛西亚皇子 嘉文四世
heroNameEn: the Exemplar of Demacia Jarvan IV

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，大年兽加里奥的失败让春节的新年传统得以兴盛，并且这些传统通过重述那个史诗故事而得以延续。这个故事本身就是一个活生生的世界——但当这个故事世界被突然扰打断时，故事中的各个角色必须共同努力来解决这个乱局，并书写他们自己的神话。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, the defeat of the Great Beast Galio gave rise to Lunar New Year traditions that are carried on through the retelling of that epic tale. Within the story itself lies a living world all its own—but when the world of the story is suddenly interrupted, the characters must work together to fix the mess and see their own myth through.

universes.descriptionZh: 故事、神话、传说：每个人都有一个自己的世界，在这个世界里，在讲述和重述角色们的故事时，这些角色会一遍又一遍地经历着考验和磨难。
universes.descriptionEn: Stories, myths, legends: within each lies a world unto itself, where characters act out their trials and tribulations over and over as their tales are told and retold.

skinNameZh: 剪纸仙灵 嘉文四世

nameZh: 西部魔影 伊芙琳 谦卑
descriptionZh: 这个可怜人看上去魂不守舍。完美。伊芙琳靠在吧台顶上，朝他倾身，弯起红唇甜蜜一笑：“给我讲一讲你的烦心事，帅哥。”并且他讲了。他给她讲了他的兄弟，以及一次不公平的交易，以及他如何觉得自己可能已经死了但又不确定……然后那个恶魔开始痛饮。“没事啦，亲爱的，”她柔声说。“你现在归我了。”
descriptionEn: The poor man looks haunted. Perfect. Evelynn leans over the bar top towards him with a sweet smile curling her red lips: “Tell me your woes, handsome.” And he does. He tells her of his brother, and a raw deal, and how he thinks he might be dead now but ain't sure... and the devil drinks deep. “It's alright, darlin',” she coos. “I've got you now.”

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

nameZh: 水晶玫瑰 迦娜 甜蜜花蕾
descriptionZh: 对安宁的渴望带来的不仅仅是一年一度的庆典。从这个普遍的愿望中诞生了精灵迦娜，她的魔力就像花环一样挂在夜空。尽管她被大多数人视为一个传奇人物，但客人们有时会说他们看到一位美丽的女士飘过。或许这就是水晶玫瑰之光的一个小把戏……
descriptionEn: The desire for peace brought about more than just a yearly festival. Born from this universal wish was Janna, a spirit whose magic hangs like a wreath over the night. Though she's regarded by most as a legend, guests sometimes say they see a beautiful woman float by. Maybe it's a trick of the crystal rose's light...

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在一年一度的水晶玫瑰节庆上，浪漫和欢乐弥漫在空气中，而敌手们在和平、中立的地方相遇，分享一个满是舞蹈与欢乐的夜晚，并为未来许下愿望。每个人都应该把他们的武器留在门口，作为对美好明天的承诺。

Everyone is expected to leave their weapons at the door as a promise for a better tomorrow.

Weapons are ostensibly left at the door, and potential new pacts are signaled by picking and wearing the magical roses that grow only during the festival.

nameZh: 幽梦玫瑰 泰隆 浪漫花蕾
descriptionZh: 在卡特琳娜——泰隆被领养的妹妹——于上次节庆中建立的联盟破裂后，他发誓要复仇。为了重振他们家族的荣光，他想要揭露并粉碎这个由华丽服饰和神圣誓言组成的盛会。今年的节庆上，没有任何事、任何人能逃脱他的怒火。
descriptionEn: After the alliance his adopted sister Katarina formed at the last festival was broken, Talon swore revenge. He intends to restore their family's honor by exposing and shattering the entire concept of this celebration of glittering finery and sacred vows. Nothing and no one at this year's festival will escape his wrath.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 水晶玫瑰节庆欢迎所有相信其和平明天梦想的人，尽管许多人已经对这个事业不再抱有幻想。那些组成幽梦玫瑰的人希望看到它结束。但没有人能对节日的魅力免疫；或许他们也会被傍晚的美景卷入其中并改变心意。

Those who make up the Withered Rose wish to see it come to an end. But no one is immune to the festival's charm; perhaps they too will be swept away by the evening's beauty and have a change of heart.

universes.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，充满了经常破裂的魔法同盟和数百年积怨。而每年一度的水晶玫瑰节庆，则为强者们提供了一个中立的场所，来原谅彼此的怠慢并重新协商停战协议。大家会做做样子似的把武器留在门口，并通过采摘和佩戴只有在节庆期间生长的魔法玫瑰来示意有潜在的全新契约。
universes.descriptionEn: In a world of frequently-broken magical alliances and centuries-old grudges, the annual Crystal Rose Festival offers a neutral ground for the powerful to forgive slights and renegotiate truces. Weapons are ostensibly left at the door, and potential new pacts are signaled by picking and wearing the magical roses that grow only during the festival.

nameZh: 龙的传人 李青 惕龙无咎
descriptionZh: 在全世界备受敬仰的武术家，李青在训练时更喜欢避开公众的视野，单独磨砺自己的技艺。传说他可以使用巨龙之怒打出一拳，但是如果有人能够确定的话，你就知道他们绝非是泛泛而谈。
descriptionEn: A famed martial artist beloved the world over, Lee Sin prefers to train far away from the public eye, honing his craft in solitude. Rumors claim that he can punch with the fury of a dragon—but if anyone knows for sure, they're not talking.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 真实伤害 艾克 无畏之志
descriptionZh: 天才少年艾克来自穷街陋巷，将音乐作为表达自我的一种方式。惊为天人的作词加上高超的制作技巧本可以让他出人头地，但他并没有这么做，而是选择留下来鼓舞他的街坊邻居们。现在，他激烈地抗拒着名利的诱惑，因而在年轻人和怀才者们当中拥趸甚多。在他们眼中，艾克就是个人潜力发挥到极致的典范。
descriptionEn: A boy genius from the rough streets, Ekko turned to music as a way to express himself. His prodigious lyricism and technological savvy could have bought him a way out, but instead, he chose to stay and uplift his neighborhood. Now, he fiercely resists the temptations of fame and glory, garnering a following among the young and hopeful who see him as an avatar for their own potential.
heroNameEn: the Boy Who Shattered Time Ekko

skinSets.descriptionZh: “什么是真实伤害？ 伙计，真实伤害就是未来！它集合了来自世界各地最优秀的艺术家们，通过最好的合作，制作最好的嘻哈音乐。我们领先游戏五步。其他人都得望尘莫及。” -艾克
skinSets.descriptionEn: “What is True Damage? Man, True Damage is the future! It's a collective of the best artists from around the world, coming together with the best collaboration, to make the best hip-hop music. We're five steps ahead of the game. Everyone else has gotta catch up.” -Ekko

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 亚索 春晓
descriptionZh: 据“兄弟之争”的故事记载，初生之土曾经发生过一场因荣誉而起的战争。年轻的弟弟是一位放浪形骸却备受尊敬的领主，后来因被指危害子民，被迫拿起武器捍卫自己的名誉。两兄弟在最后的交锋中双双丧命——过分追逐荣耀带来的致命教训。
descriptionEn: Pride once set the First Lands aflame, as recounted in the Tale of the Warring Brothers. The Younger was a roguish yet respected lord, until he was accused of crimes against his people and took up arms to defend his reputation. Both brothers fell in their final clash—a fatal lesson in hubris.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 天龙之子 伊泽瑞尔 龙行天下
descriptionZh: 无论哪里出了状况，整个王国的龙都知道会听到伊泽瑞尔的淘气笑声。他的玩笑虽然无害，但不要让这个开心果欺骗了你：他是一位精明的皇家斥候，与卡莎并肩作战，而后者已经在他层出不穷的恶作剧之中勇敢地经历了许多次冒险。要穿得像个人类去参加派对？听着就像是他所憧憬的美好时光。
descriptionEn: Wherever chaos is sown, dragons across the kingdom know to listen for Ezreal's mischievous laughter. His japes are harmless, but don't let that merry spirit fool you: he is a shrewd royal scout alongside Kai'Sa who has braved many adventures between bouts of pranking. Dressing up like a human to go party? Now that sounds like his idea of a good time.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

skinNameZh: 天龙之子 伊泽瑞尔

nameZh: 霸天异形 卡兹克 黄金异端
descriptionZh: 被命名为K-ZX的“霸天异形 卡兹克”是霸天机甲系列的第一台机器，专为对付怪兽威胁而部署。由于体积较小，它在城市环境下的表现最佳，并搭载了飞行功能来威慑平民。
descriptionEn: Designated K-ZX, the “Mecha Kha'Zix” unit was the first of the mecha line to be deployed against the kaiju threat. Due to its smaller size, it functions best in urban environments, adapting on the fly to threats against civilian populations.
heroNameZh: 虚空掠夺者 卡兹克

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当身形庞大的怪兽开始从海中、地上和空中发起进攻时，人类发展出了相同威力的霸天机甲单位以爆发性的徒手战斗抵御它们。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When colossal kaiju begin attacking from the sea, land, and air, humanity develops equally powerful mecha units to stop them in explosive hand-to-hand combat.

universes.descriptionZh: 耸立在城市之上，庞大的怪兽与高耸的机甲扭打在一起。谁会赢？
universes.descriptionEn: Towering above the city, gargantuan kaiju tussle with towering mechas. Who will win?

nameZh: 腥红之月 劫 鹤雪
descriptionZh: 尽管腥红之月教派内部离心离德，劫仍然是崔斯特不可动摇的得力助手和私属权力代理人。他用秘密、暗影和鲜血进行交易，同时利用他对魔鬼的掌控来提升这个教派的影响力。而崔斯特不知道的是，劫还在搜寻他的那个已被净雪之月给抢走的失踪助手。
descriptionEn: As loyalty fractures within the Blood Moon cult, Zed remains Twisted Fate's unshakable right hand and personal power broker. He trades in secrets, shadows, and blood, all while using his mastery over his demon to increase the cult's influence. What Twisted Fate doesn't know is that Zed is also searching for his lost acolyte, stolen by the Snow Moon.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 一个远古教派，寻求着不可抗拒的力量，总在血月之夜现身实行亵渎、秘传的仪式——用恶灵融合他们的肉身，并变成一个拥有恒增黑暗的存在。
skinSets.descriptionEn: An ancient cult, seeking irresistible power, surfaces on nights of the Blood Moon to perform profane, esoteric rites—merging their flesh with demonic spirits, and becoming one with an ever greater darkness.

universes.descriptionZh: 一个声音从寂静中回响：“翻腾吧，野兽们，教友们。艾欧尼亚在劫难逃，它的诸多月亮像饥饿的恶魔的眼睛一样升起，等待着你们忠诚的红色——抑或它们是无法越过的可怕荒芜？ 无论是哪种方式，我们都是沉浸在仪式和献祭中的躯壳。在月亮的顶峰，我们从肉中切肉，献上微薄的礼物——我们自身的一切。”
universes.descriptionEn: A voice echoes from the silence: “Writhe, beasts, brethren. The moons of a doomed Ionia rise like eyes of starved demons, awaiting the red of your fealty—or are they monstrous blights that cannot pass? Either way, we are vessels plunged in ritual and sacrifice. At the moon's peak, we carve flesh from flesh, offering the meager gift of all that we are.”

nameZh: 古琴余韵 娑娜 龙神天籁

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！

nameZh: 花仙子 莉莉娅 纹白
descriptionZh: 作为冬之廷女士和花仙心树的守护者，莉莉娅将各个花仙王国的历史记录在古树的年轮中，将各个事件定格成茂密的、不断成长的档案。当莉莉娅发现有人试图篡改她的工作时，她必须鼓起勇气——麻烦就要来了！
descriptionEn: Lady of the Winter Court and Keeper of the Seelie Heart-tree, Lillia records the history of the Faerie Queendoms in the ancient tree's rings, freezing events into forested, ever-growing archives. When Lillia discovers that someone has tried to tamper with her work, however, she must rally her courage—there is trouble afoot!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有花仙贵族都是自然意志的仆人，用他们的魔法实行自然的秩序和四季的更替。然而，在那个更高的目标之下，在满是丝绸、薄纱和黄金的各个奢华王庭之中，政治阴谋的游戏不断上演。 毕竟，权能——不管是魔法的、自然的还是政治的——总会激发竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: All fae nobility are servants to nature's will, carrying out the natural order and the turning of seasons with their magic. Beneath that higher purpose, however, a constant game of political intrigue plays out in luxurious courts of silk, gossamer, and gold. Power, after all—magical, natural, or political—always inspires competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 各式各样的花仙与林精都把各个花仙王国称为家园：所有由纯粹自然魔法和空灵之美组成的生物都喜欢月光狂欢、悦耳歌声、以及诡计多端的交易。
universes.descriptionEn: Pixies, nixies, hobs, redcaps, and more call the Faerie Queendoms home: all creatures of pure natural magic and ethereal beauty that delight in moonlight revels, mellifluous song, and tricksy dealings.

nameZh: K/DA 阿狸 魅惑之舞
descriptionZh: 阿狸决定改变她的形象，将旧的泡泡糖流行乐人设抛开，并把自己重新塑造为音乐产业内的一股不可阻挡的势力。五年之后，她带着全新的时尚造型和打动人心的歌喉归来——而这次的她并不是孤身一人。
descriptionEn: Setting her old bubblegum pop persona aside, Ahri was determined to shake up her image and reinvent herself as an unstoppable force within the music industry. Five years later, she has returned with a sleek new look and a killer sound—and this time she's not alone.

skinSets.descriptionZh: “在现实与幻想之间有一个地方，一切都有可能发生。你可以成为任何人，做任何事。这就是你的梦。在这个夹缝中的世界里，K/DA感到自信又强大。我们可以梦想成真，你们也可以。”——卡莎
skinSets.descriptionEn: “There is a place between fantasy and reality where anything can happen. You have the power to be anyone, and do anything. It is your dream. In our in-between world, K/DA feels confident and strong. We can do anything, and so can you.” -Kai'Sa

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。

About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 定海神珍 孙悟空 四海扬威
descriptionZh: 在获得了远古玉龙之力后，悟空的战斗技巧已经达到了登峰造极的高度。虽然他的性格依然急躁莽撞，但是他的新能力是毋庸置疑的。然而这些能力也成为了师傅的心头大患，因为玉龙之力也是一种诅咒。
descriptionEn: Imbued with the power of the legendary jade dragon, Wukong has honed his abilities to a razor sharp point.Though still headstrong and brash, his newfound power is undeniable—a worrying sign to his master, as the jade dragon carries a powerful curse...

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！

nameZh: 天龙之子 黛安娜 玉龙舞夜
descriptionZh: 龙之王国的图书馆是保存历代智慧之作的档案馆：也是由宫廷学者黛安娜保管的藏品。她是一位狂热的学者和战士，陪伴龙太子踏上旅程，记录龙与人类之间历史性的第一次相遇。
descriptionEn: The library of the Kingdom of Dragons is an illustrious archive of wisdom from ages past: a collection kept by Diana, scholar of the court. A fierce academic as well as a fighter, she accompanies the prince on his journey to document this historical first encounter between dragons and humans.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。

skinNameZh: 天龙之子 伊泽瑞尔

nameZh: 剪纸仙灵 娜美 吉祥如意
descriptionZh: 娜美控制波涛的野心让她与神帝嘉文四世之间引发了一场毁灭性的战斗，给这个仙境带来了巨大的灾难。但当这个世界面临更大的威胁——至恶的人类天性——时，娜美必须放下她的骄傲，与她以前的敌人们合作，从而阻止他们的故事被改写。
descriptionEn: Nami's ambition to control the waves led to a destructive battle between her and god-emperor Jarvan IV, causing a great calamity to befall the world. But when the world faces an even greater threat—human nature at its most devious—Nami must swallow her pride and work with her former enemies to stop their story from being rewritten.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，大年兽加里奥的失败让春节的新年传统得以兴盛，并且这些传统通过重述那个史诗故事而得以延续。这个故事本身就是一个活生生的世界——但当这个故事世界被突然扰打断时，故事中的各个角色必须共同努力来解决这个乱局，并书写他们自己的神话。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, the defeat of the Great Beast Galio gave rise to Lunar New Year traditions that are carried on through the retelling of that epic tale. Within the story itself lies a living world all its own—but when the world of the story is suddenly interrupted, the characters must work together to fix the mess and see their own myth through.

universes.descriptionZh: 故事、神话、传说：每个人都有一个自己的世界，在这个世界里，在讲述和重述角色们的故事时，这些角色会一遍又一遍地经历着考验和磨难。
universes.descriptionEn: Stories, myths, legends: within each lies a world unto itself, where characters act out their trials and tribulations over and over as their tales are told and retold.

nameZh: 西部魔影 永恩 忠诚
descriptionZh: 那个魂不守舍的人没有呼吸，只是倚靠在拴马桩上，眯着眼睛看着边境的黄昏——但它不是他。不完全是。真正的永恩是阴影和硝烟，随着它重新回到他肉身的静止状态而不断翻腾。“你们怎么就这样分开了？” 年轻的火药女巫问道。永恩叹息道，“说来话长，孩子。”
descriptionEn: The haunted man doesn't breathe, just leans against the hitching post and squints into the frontier dusk—but it ain't him. Not really. The real Yone is shadow and gunsmoke, roiling as it sinks back into the stillness of his corporeal form. “How'd you wind up split like that?” the young Powder Witch asks. Yone sighs, “It's a long story, kid.”

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 伊芙琳 幻之魂焰
descriptionZh: 大多数人都是通过努力来觉醒自己的斗魂，但这个战士……并非如此！只需要顺路拜访异象调查局然后嘣地一声！眼镜王蛇能量注入。当然，这个过程显然会涉及“人们能想到的最大限度的痛苦”。但看看现在的她吧！她来这里的目的，是抓捕一位逃无可逃的少女——有请伊芙琳！
descriptionEn: Most awaken their souls through hard work, but this fighter... no! All it took was a stop by the Department for the Eradication of Manifested Anomalies and boom! Cobra powers. SURE, apparently the procedure involves the "worst pain one can possibly imagine." But look at her now! Here to hunt down a daughter with nowhere left to run... it's Evelynn!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

universes.descriptionZh: 来自世界各地，那些斗魂已经觉醒的人们被邀请参加……斗魂武道大会！它是凌驾于所有娱乐之上的王者，是一个无与伦比的电视奇观！战士们在擂台上一对一单挑，直至只剩一人拿到大奖：灵魂最深处的愿望！而我会在这里，播报这一切！
universes.descriptionEn: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 天龙之子 迦娜 蛟龙得水
descriptionZh: 迦娜是王国中最擅长魔法的龙（也许除了国王本人），能够腾云驾雾，呼风唤雨。龙太子曾经问过迦娜是否可以收他为徒，而迦娜高兴地接受了；但她期待着给他展示龙族力量更加奇思妙想的用法。毕竟，他们要去参加庆典了。
descriptionEn: Janna is the most skilled dragon in the kingdom at sorcery (save for the king himself, perhaps), whipping up winds and steering the clouds. The prince asked if she might take him on as a pupil, and Janna happily accepted; but she is looking forward to showing him more whimsical uses of their power. After all, they have a festival to attend.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 红莲之刃 锐雯
descriptionZh: 再说一遍“疯兔子”。有种你就说给她听。
descriptionEn: Say “Hoppin' Mad” one more time. She dares you.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这就是一门生计！
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's a living!

universes.descriptionZh: 磨砺之路不仅仅是工作。它是斗争，是喧嚣，有时令人振奋，有时令人沮丧。它是一个为期一周的过山车，有喜剧性的过弯和悲惨的急落，只会在周一重新开始。我们是努力工作还是几乎不工作？在磨砺之路上，一切都一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The grind isn't just work. It's the struggle, the hustle, sometimes invigorating, sometimes demoralizing. It's a weeklong rollercoaster with comedic bends and tragic drops, only to start all over again on Monday. Are we working hard or hardly working? It's all the same on the grind.

nameZh: 幻灵白鸽 萨勒芬妮 梦幻强袭
descriptionZh: 萨勒芬妮是幻灵战队的通讯官，“椅子上的女孩”——直到她成为第一位幻灵白鸽，利用她天生敏感的听力来操作一套新的幻灵科技战甲，该战甲可以将声波进行武器化以震撼战场！当萨勒芬妮拦截到一个奇怪的求救信号时，她接到了第一个任务：找到来源，并带领团队前往营救。
descriptionEn: Seraphine was Anima Squad's comms officer, the "girl in the chair"—until she became the first Battle Dove, using her naturally sensitive hearing to operate a new AnimaTech suit that weaponizes sound waves to rock the battlefield! When she intercepts a strange distress call, Seraphine gets her first mission: find the source, and lead a team to the rescue.
heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

skinNameZh: 幻灵白鸽 萨勒芬妮

nameZh: 幻灵蝙蝠 霞 魅影闪击
descriptionZh: 霞——蝙蝠小队的前卫大拿——知道，有时你必须先斩后奏。霞来自最终都市外的一个试图建立但被摧毁的定居点，她对海魔人的怨恨很大程度上是私人恩怨。在战斗的间歇期，她利用自己的秘密训练来避免萨勒芬妮打听她一直在跟谁发消息。
descriptionEn: Bat Squad's edgy hotshot Xayah knows that sometimes you have to strike first and hard to make a statement. Hailing from an attempted settlement outside Final City that was destroyed, Xayah's grudge against the Primordians is deeply personal. Between battles, she uses her stealth training to avoid Seraphine prying about who the guy she's always texting is.

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

nameZh: 青花瓷 厄运小姐 月色
descriptionZh: 几个世纪以来，人类一直在尝试复制龙息的力量。随着火药的出现，大炮被巧妙地加工成更小更精致的形态，直到莎拉·厄运的母亲最终将其完善。她的双龙手枪延续的不仅是她自己家族的传承，而且是神话生物们本身的传承。
descriptionEn: Through the centuries, humans have tried to replicate the power of dragon's breath. With gunpowder came the cannon, which was finessed into smaller and more refined variants until it was ultimately perfected by Sarah Fortune's mother. Her dual dragon-pistols carry on the legacy of not only her own family, but of the creatures of myth themselves.
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 预知之眼 亚索 不怠
descriptionZh: 亚索在梦中瞥见了许多道路。其中一条道路中，看到他是一个老人，独自一人，远远偏离了他的路线。他已放弃了雄心、家庭、甚至爱情，一切都是为了弥补他再也记不起来的那些罪。这个幻象不是警告，而是提醒，因为亚索知道他总能回到自己的道路上。他只需要找到它……或者让它找到他。
descriptionEn: Yasuo glimpsed many paths in his dreams. One saw him as an old man, alone, having strayed far from his course. He had given up ambition, family, even love, all to atone for sins he could no longer remember. This vision was not a warning, but a reminder, for Yasuo knew he could always return to his path. He only needed to find it... or let it find him.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 一只羽饰骑士扇动翅膀，并在穿过符文大地的途中，一只海洋亚龙浮出水面。我们的生活像羊皮纸上的文字一样变幻无常；我们面前的道路未知而激动人心。如果之前选择的是较少人旅行过的一条路……会发生些什么呢？
skinSets.descriptionEn: A featherknight flaps its wings, and halfway across Runeterra, an Ocean Drake surfaces. Our lives play out, fickle as words on parchment; the paths before us unknown and exciting. What if the road taken instead... was the one less traveled?

universes.descriptionZh: 自身在其它生活中的掠影。另一个时代的宿命冲突。符文之地是一个充满可能性的世界，因为它的传说找到了新的目的和命运。
universes.descriptionEn: Glimpses of selves in other lives. Clashes of fate in another era. Runeterra is a world rich in possibility as its legends find new destinations and destinies.

nameZh: 北极星守护者 卢锡安 圣洁光带
descriptionZh: 卢锡安，被赛娜遗忘的挚爱，在紧要关头找到了她。他扑向锤石，牺牲了自己，毁灭了篡夺者，返还了北极光的神力。在他弥留之际，二人之间的点滴涌进了赛娜的脑海。她陪在他身边直到他生命的最后一刻，然后，为了让自己铭记这份不朽的羁绊，赛娜把卢锡安的灵魂变成了南极星。真爱永在。
descriptionEn: Lucian, Senna's forgotten love, had tracked her down. He threw himself at Thresh, sacrificing himself to destroy the usurper and return the Aurora's power. As he lay dying, memories of their love washed over Senna. She stayed with him until he passed and, to remind herself of their undying bond, turned his soul into the Southern Star. Love would endure.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当空气变得清新，第一场雪飘落时，看向天空，北极星就会出现。不要害怕，如果你不计回报地行善，你可能会获得极光赐福作为奖励。但请记住：无论你怎么做，你都不能把你的好运视为理所当然，因为北极星每年都会来，没有人能逃脱惩罚。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When the air grows crisp and the first snow falls, look to the sky, for Polaris will appear. Do not be afraid, for if you've been virtuous without expectation, you might be rewarded with the Aurora's blessings. But remember: no matter how you act, you cannot take your fortunes for granted, because Polaris comes every year, and no one escapes punishment.

universes.descriptionZh: 你可曾听过极光的那些传说？它们可能寒冷和黑暗，但如果你足够勇敢，你就会发现超乎你梦想的温暖和威严。所以坐在火炉旁，来听听这些北极光的传说……
universes.descriptionEn: Have you heard the stories of the Aurora? Cold and dark they can be, but if you're brave enough you'll find warmth and majesty grander than any dream you've had. So sit yourself by the fire and come listen to these Tales of Borealis...

skinNameZh: 北极星守护者 卢锡安

nameZh: 心之钢 伊泽瑞尔 锐意曲风
descriptionZh: 一首精心制作的神曲让伊泽瑞尔成为万众瞩目的焦点，但在这张专辑遭到批评时，他又再次过气，于是伊泽瑞尔决定是时候收回一些创作控制权了。现在，伊泽瑞尔离开了他的旧厂牌，并将自己的明星影响力借给了心之钢，找到了一些准备与他一起复出翻红的音乐家和朋友。
descriptionEn: After a manufactured one-hit wonder launched Ezreal into the spotlight, only for him to fall out of it again when the album got panned, Ezreal decided it was time he took some creative control back. Now, having left his old label and lending what star power he has to HEARTSTEEL, Ezreal has found musicians and friends he's ready to make a comeback with.

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 花仙子 崔丝塔娜 蓝闪
descriptionZh: 作为勇敢的王室卫队军需官和卡莉丝塔女士的新任得力助手，崔丝塔娜培育了各种神奇的植物武器来帮助保护女王陛下！它们大多数是某种形式的新芽、花朵、藤蔓或苔藓。所有这些都具有难以置信的破坏力。
descriptionEn: As plucky Quartermaster to the Royal Guard and Lady Kalista's new right hand fae, Tristana cultivates all sorts of magical plant-based weaponry to help protect Her Majesty the Queen! Most of them are some form of sprout, flower, vine, or moss. All of them are incredibly destructive.
heroNameZh: 麦林炮手 崔丝塔娜

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有花仙贵族都是自然意志的仆人，用他们的魔法实行自然的秩序和四季的更替。然而，在那个更高的目标之下，在满是丝绸、薄纱和黄金的各个奢华王庭之中，政治阴谋的游戏不断上演。 毕竟，权能——不管是魔法的、自然的还是政治的——总会激发竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: All fae nobility are servants to nature's will, carrying out the natural order and the turning of seasons with their magic. Beneath that higher purpose, however, a constant game of political intrigue plays out in luxurious courts of silk, gossamer, and gold. Power, after all—magical, natural, or political—always inspires competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 各式各样的花仙与林精都把各个花仙王国称为家园：所有由纯粹自然魔法和空灵之美组成的生物都喜欢月光狂欢、悦耳歌声、以及诡计多端的交易。
universes.descriptionEn: Pixies, nixies, hobs, redcaps, and more call the Faerie Queendoms home: all creatures of pure natural magic and ethereal beauty that delight in moonlight revels, mellifluous song, and tricksy dealings.

nameZh: 人工智能 悠米 星流电击
descriptionZh: 当金克丝偶然发现一个古老的海魔程序时，她情不自禁地对它进行了改造，创造出了呆在幻灵战队幕后的那只有智识的数码猫咪：人工智能悠米！现在，栖息在一个闪亮的全新全息身体中，这位人人都爱的线上助手、昆虫拍击者和摸头渴求者可以与她的盟友一起投入战斗。
descriptionEn: When Jinx stumbled onto an old Primordian program, she couldn't help but tinker with it, creating what would become the sentient digital cat behind the Anima Squad interface: Yuum.ai! Now inhabiting a shiny new hologram body, everyone's favorite online helper, bug swatter, and demander of head pats can hop into battle alongside her allies.

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 璐璐 海盐泡芙
descriptionZh: 当璐璐和她得力的副主厨皮克斯制作甜点时，甜食爱好者们总是会感到满足！他们的糕点魔法料理只需要一丝香气，就足以让最任性的顾客们沉醉。有人说他们的美食非常令人着迷，甚至具有改变现实的效果……
descriptionEn: Sweet tooths are always satisfied when Lulu and her helpful sous-chef Pix are crafting the desserts! Just one whiff of their pastry magic concoctions is enough to enchant even the most unruly customers. Some say their treats are so captivating that they even have reality altering effects…

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 玉剑传说 舞龙卫 胭脂
descriptionZh: 一百年来，舞龙卫本是旸刚派洞天的看守，但在救了一位落水僧人的子弟后，师父恩准她开始修炼。 她很享受化为人形所带来的种种纠葛。与星仙子不同，舞龙卫毫不怀疑自己的身份：至尊修仙学派的保护者。
descriptionEn: For 100 years, the dragon Shyvana watched over the Sprouting Courage School's gardens, but after saving one of the monk's sons from drowning, she was allowed to train. Transforming into a human, she enjoyed the challenge this new form would bring. Unlike Soraka, Shyvana has no doubt about who she is: a protector of the strongest school of immortality.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 青花瓷 莫甘娜 月色
descriptionZh: 没有人比莫甘娜更了解女巫丽桑卓的力量。将丽桑卓束缚在她的圣物上的那个魔法，是有代价的：说出这段咒语的生肖神卫也会被困住。莫甘娜牺牲了自己，而她的鸡生肖圣物的双翼将她包裹在瓷茧中长达数千年。再次醒来后，她要加倍奉还。
descriptionEn: There is no one who comprehends the power of the sorceress Lissandra more than Morgana. The magic that bound Lissandra to her relic came at a cost: the protector who uttered the words would be trapped as well. Morgana made this sacrifice, the wings of her Rooster Relic wrapping her in a porcelain cocoon for millennia. Awake once more, she seeks revenge.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 幽梦玫瑰 伊莉丝 浪漫花蕾
descriptionZh: 尽管从未收到过正式邀请，但伊莉丝每年都会出席。有传言说，她因在一个晚上的时间里因为编造谎言、结成和解散各种誓约而被列入黑名单。与会者还指出，她的追求者们似乎在之后从未再次拜访过这个庆典。
descriptionEn: Elise is in attendance at every annual gala, despite never once receiving a formal invitation. Rumor has it she's been blacklisted for spinning webs of lies, forming and disbanding allegiances in the span of a single evening. Attendees have also noted her suitors never seem to make a return visit to the festival.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 水晶玫瑰节庆欢迎所有相信其和平明天梦想的人，尽管许多人已经对这个事业不再抱有幻想。那些组成幽梦玫瑰的人希望看到它结束。但没有人能对节日的魅力免疫；或许他们也会被傍晚的美景卷入其中并改变心意。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Crystal Rose Festival welcomes all who believe in its dream of a peaceful tomorrow, though many have grown disenchanted with the whole affair. Those who make up the Withered Rose wish to see it come to an end. But no one is immune to the festival's charm; perhaps they too will be swept away by the evening's beauty and have a change of heart.

universes.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，充满了经常破裂的魔法同盟和数百年积怨。而每年一度的水晶玫瑰节庆，则为强者们提供了一个中立的场所，来原谅彼此的怠慢并重新协商停战协议。大家会做做样子似的把武器留在门口，并通过采摘和佩戴只有在节庆期间生长的魔法玫瑰来示意有潜在的全新契约。
universes.descriptionEn: In a world of frequently-broken magical alliances and centuries-old grudges, the annual Crystal Rose Festival offers a neutral ground for the powerful to forgive slights and renegotiate truces. Weapons are ostensibly left at the door, and potential new pacts are signaled by picking and wearing the magical roses that grow only during the festival.

nameZh: 天龙之子 卡莎 矫若惊龙
descriptionZh: 卡莎是皇家斥候，也是龙太子的好友。她很坚毅，在云端度过的时间比她的任何同龄人都多。虽然这是她第一次与人类直接互动，但她观察到的知识和机敏一定会在她与人类一起庆祝新年时派上用场。
descriptionEn: Royal scout and friend to the prince, Kai'Sa is a tenacious dragon who has spent more time beneath the clouds than any of her peers. Though this is the first time she has interacted with humans directly, her observed knowledge and agile grace are sure to be assets while joining them in the New Year's celebration.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 黑夜使者 嘉文四世 白夜
descriptionZh: 嘉文是真正的混沌磁石。就像飓风眼一样，他的毁灭不可避免地席卷了他前进道路上的任何人和任何东西。对他来说，混沌是造就真神的熔炉，只有那些在战争中幸存下来的人才有资格生活在接下来的全新创世时代。
descriptionEn: Jarvan is the magnetism of chaos made real. Like the eye of a hurricane, his destruction inevitably sweeps up anyone and anything in his path. To him, chaos is the forge from which true gods are made, and only those that survive the war will be worthy to live in the new age of creation that follows.
heroNameZh: 德玛西亚皇子 嘉文四世
heroNameEn: the Exemplar of Demacia Jarvan IV

skinSets.descriptionZh: 黑夜使者和黎明使者之间的冲突是永恒的。一方面，混沌和黑暗的力量带来了改变，而另一方面，秩序和光明的力量带来了结构。正是这些神和他们的后裔塑造了一个新生的世界，而谁也说不准未来到底会带来更光明的白昼……还是更黑暗的黑夜。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Timeless is the conflict between the Nightbringers and Dawnbringers. On one side, the forces of chaos and darkness bring change, while on the other, the forces of order and light bring structure. It is these gods and their descendents that shape a nascent world, and who can say whether the future will yield brighter days... or darker nights.

universes.descriptionZh: 万物生于冲突；没有什么能逃离它。和谐是一种幻觉，只有拥抱这种幻觉的那些人才能收获人生最伟大的各种回报。
universes.descriptionEn: All things are born from conflict; none can escape it. Harmony is an illusion, and only those who embrace that illusion will reap life's greatest rewards.

skinNameZh: 黑夜使者 嘉文四世

nameZh: 墨之影武者 易 金墨耀影
descriptionZh: 易大师的家人拒绝了卡勃尔派的控制，逃离了拉巴登城——结果却被消灭了。为了反击，他成为了首批墨之影武者，牺牲自己的寿命来换来了一个魔法墨纹，这个墨纹赋予了他举剑对抗卡勃尔派的力量。他不知道自己还能活多久；尽管如此，他还是会拯救他的城市……并报仇雪恨。
descriptionEn: Master Yi's family refused Cabal control, fleeing Rabadon City—only to be snuffed out. To fight back, he became one of the first Inkshadow Warriors, sacrificing his lifespan for a magical tattoo that grants him the power to raise his sword against the Cabal. He doesn't know how long he has left to live; still, he will save his city… and get his revenge.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在拉巴登城的郊外，一座破旧的神庙里居住着拉巴登人民最后的希望：墨之影武者们。他们每个人都牺牲了对他们来说最重要的东西，以便与远古灵体们签订一个契约，而这些远古灵体们为他们灌注了如此强大的魔法墨纹，以至于就连卡勃尔派也在颤抖。他们不再是无助者了。是时候收复他们的家园了。
skinSets.descriptionEn: On the outskirts of Rabadon City, a dilapidated temple houses the last hope for Rabadon's people: the Inkshadow Warriors. Each one sacrifices what is most important to them in order to make a contract with ancient spirits, who imbue them with magic tattoos so powerful, even the Cabal trembles. They are victims no more. It is time to take back their home.

universes.descriptionZh: 拉巴登城因魔法而繁荣。谁控制了魔法，谁就控制了拉巴登。而阴谋集团的控制是绝对的。任何反抗者都会被制服或被消灭……但义军即将来临。这些反抗者们所倚仗的武器是他们皮肤上直接绘制的危险魔法墨纹，而他们的目标是推翻卡勃尔派并将这座城市还给它的人民——不成功，便成仁。
universes.descriptionEn: Rabadon City thrives on magic. Whoever controls magic, controls Rabadon. And the Cabal's control is absolute. Any who resist are brought to heel or eliminated… but an Uprising is coming. Armed with dangerous magic inked directly into their skin, these rebels seek to topple the Cabal and give the city back to its people—or die trying.

nameZh: 青花瓷 厄运小姐 釉色
descriptionZh: 几个世纪以来，人类一直在尝试复制龙息的力量。随着火药的出现，大炮被巧妙地加工成更小更精致的形态，直到莎拉·厄运的母亲最终将其完善。她的双龙手枪延续的不仅是她自己家族的传承，而且是神话生物们本身的传承。
descriptionEn: Through the centuries, humans have tried to replicate the power of dragon's breath. With gunpowder came the cannon, which was finessed into smaller and more refined variants until it was ultimately perfected by Sarah Fortune's mother. Her dual dragon-pistols carry on the legacy of not only her own family, but of the creatures of myth themselves.
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。

They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

nameZh: 青花瓷 艾瑞莉娅 釉色
descriptionZh: 艾瑞莉娅早在成为生肖神卫之前就致力于保护古代圣物了。大学的第一年，她就在著名的考古研究所实习。这是她短暂一生的亮点……直到她被羊生肖圣物赋予了神话力量，并被卷入了一场长达数百年的战争。与之相比，学业就略显苍白了。
descriptionEn: Irelia was dedicated to the preservation of ancient relics long before she became a protector. Her first year at university, she interned at the renowned Archeology Institute. It was the highlight of her short life... until she was granted mythical powers by the Ram Relic and thrust into a centuries-old war. Schoolwork sort of pales in comparison.
heroNameZh: 刀锋舞者 艾瑞莉娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
