nameZh: 王国机神白虎 贾克斯 云霄
descriptionZh: 作为全大陆最负盛名的武器大师，贾克斯一直渴望着一件合适的武器，以及一场合适的战斗。当艾斯特王国的智囊们汇聚一堂——使用似乎是上天赐予的奇怪科技——以建造一台百折不挠的阿瓦隆时，贾克斯终于被打动了。他乐于见到利维坦的入侵，并希望这些巨大的敌人们能证明它们就是他毕生所寻的挑战。
descriptionEn: Famed as the greatest weapons master in all the land, Jax has been itching for a proper weapon, and a proper fight. When the best minds of the Estercrest Kingdom came together—using strange technology seemingly gifted to them by the heavens—to construct an indomitable Avalon, Jax was finally impressed. He welcomes the leviathan invasion, hoping these monstrous foes will prove to be the challenge he has been searching for his entire life.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 多个伟大的王国彼此纷争了几个世代，直到一个新敌人的到来。为了反击，他们得到了赐福，获得了来自天堂的赠礼。他们会克服旧怨，拯救未来吗？
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Great Kingdoms warred for generations until the arrival of a new enemy. To fight back, they are blessed with gifts from the heavens. Will they rise above their past to save their future?

universes.descriptionZh: 多个伟大的王国彼此纷争了几个世代，直到一个新敌人的到来。为了反击，他们得到了赐福，获得了来自天堂的赠礼。他们会克服旧怨，拯救未来吗？
universes.descriptionEn: The Great Kingdoms warred for generations until the arrival of a new enemy. To fight back, they are blessed with gifts from the heavens. Will they rise above their past to save their future?

nameZh: 霸天异形 卡兹克 丛林灾厄
descriptionZh: 被命名为K-ZX的“霸天异形 卡兹克”是霸天机甲系列的第一台机器，专为对付怪兽威胁而部署。由于体积较小，它在城市环境下的表现最佳，并搭载了飞行功能来威慑平民。
descriptionEn: Designated K-ZX, the “Mecha Kha'Zix” unit was the first of the mecha line to be deployed against the kaiju threat. Due to its smaller size, it functions best in urban environments, adapting on the fly to threats against civilian populations.
heroNameZh: 虚空掠夺者 卡兹克

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当身形庞大的怪兽开始从海中、地上和空中发起进攻时，人类发展出了相同威力的霸天机甲单位以爆发性的徒手战斗抵御它们。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When colossal kaiju begin attacking from the sea, land, and air, humanity develops equally powerful mecha units to stop them in explosive hand-to-hand combat.

universes.descriptionZh: 耸立在城市之上，庞大的怪兽与高耸的机甲扭打在一起。谁会赢？
universes.descriptionEn: Towering above the city, gargantuan kaiju tussle with towering mechas. Who will win?

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 烬 幻之魂焰
descriptionZh: 别问他是怎么做到的，这位扭曲的导师就是能在适当的条件下解锁任何人的灵魂能量！做好准备吧，因为他的考验可是会要人命的！他已经准备好在世界上最大的舞台上充分展示他的艺术，甚至可能向那个悬赏猎人复仇！让我们把掌声给到……烬！
descriptionEn: Don't ask him how, but this twisted mentor can unlock ANY person's soul power under the right conditions! Just be prepared, because his trials are deadly! He's ready to put his art on full display on the world's biggest stage and maybe even get some revenge on a bounty hunter along the way! Let's give it up for… Jhin!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

universes.descriptionZh: 来自世界各地，那些斗魂已经觉醒的人们被邀请参加……斗魂武道大会！它是凌驾于所有娱乐之上的王者，是一个无与伦比的电视奇观！战士们在擂台上一对一单挑，直至只剩一人拿到大奖：灵魂最深处的愿望！而我会在这里，播报这一切！
universes.descriptionEn: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 花仙子 拉克丝 纹白
descriptionZh: 拉克丝是在大法师米利欧座下学习的一位年轻女术士，准备证明她不只是一位无所事事的夏之廷女士。她负责将阳光透过晨露分解成彩虹，每天在太阳升起之前都有很多工作要做——但她有的是决心！
descriptionEn: A young sorceress studying under Archmage Milio, Lux is ready to prove that she's not just an idle Lady of the Summer Court. Responsible for splitting sunbeams into rainbows through the morning dew, she has a lot of work to conquer each day before the sun rises—but she is nothing if not determined!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有花仙贵族都是自然意志的仆人，用他们的魔法实行自然的秩序和四季的更替。然而，在那个更高的目标之下，在满是丝绸、薄纱和黄金的各个奢华王庭之中，政治阴谋的游戏不断上演。 毕竟，权能——不管是魔法的、自然的还是政治的——总会激发竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: All fae nobility are servants to nature's will, carrying out the natural order and the turning of seasons with their magic. Beneath that higher purpose, however, a constant game of political intrigue plays out in luxurious courts of silk, gossamer, and gold. Power, after all—magical, natural, or political—always inspires competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 各式各样的花仙与林精都把各个花仙王国称为家园：所有由纯粹自然魔法和空灵之美组成的生物都喜欢月光狂欢、悦耳歌声、以及诡计多端的交易。
universes.descriptionEn: Pixies, nixies, hobs, redcaps, and more call the Faerie Queendoms home: all creatures of pure natural magic and ethereal beauty that delight in moonlight revels, mellifluous song, and tricksy dealings.

nameZh: 暗影妖狐 阿狸 入梦之影
descriptionZh: 村民们讲述着一只神秘冰狐的各种故事，据说在与王国接壤的多雪森林的深处，它会在午夜月光下变成人类。他们不知道的是，这只狐狸，阿狸，曾经是一位公主。因诅咒而过着一种如她的内心那样狂野的生活，她白天在森林里奔跑，希望能找到一个人来打破她永恒的诅咒。
descriptionEn: Deep in the snowy forests bordering the kingdom, villagers tell tales of a mysterious icefox who, under the light of the midnight moon, becomes human. What they don't know is that this fox, Ahri, was once a princess. Cursed to live a life as wild as her heart, she runs through the forests during the day, hoping to find someone to break her eternal curse.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前的珍宝，闪闪发光，触手可及。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Treasures from days long passed, glimmering just within reach.

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前的珍宝，闪闪发光，触手可及。
universes.descriptionEn: Treasures from days long passed, glimmering just within reach.

nameZh: 西部魔影 执行人 卡特琳娜 纯洁
descriptionZh: “我的人民被诈骗了。我的目标是收回我们的欠款，”外来者说道，并把她的匕首别在一张机械恶魔的通缉海报上。当她凝视着每个尘土飞扬的旅行者时，她的眼睛像烧焦的煤一样燃烧，“我听说你们都计划跳上硫磺铁路，先驱者们。如果你们要去打倒这个恶魔，我想加入进来。”
descriptionEn: “My people got swindled. I aim to collect what we're owed,” the Outsider says, pinning her dagger in a wanted poster of the Mechanical Devil. Her eyes burn like stoked coal as she fixes each dusty traveler in her gaze, “And I hear y'all plan on jumpin' the Sulfur Rail, Harbingers. If you're gonna take this devil down, I want in.”
heroNameZh: 不祥之刃 卡特琳娜

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

skinNameZh: 西部魔影 执行人 卡特琳娜

nameZh: 北极星钢影 卡蜜尔 智慧纽带
descriptionZh: 赛娜还在寻觅，火冒三丈的卡蜜尔自己找上门来。她曾是一位舞者，优雅高贵却冷酷无情。由于忤逆了上一任北极星而遭到极刑惩罚，失去了双腿。现在她获得了比血肉之躯更强大的下肢。卡蜜尔伺机设伏，偷袭了赛娜，还叫来了她的同伙——塞拉斯和锤石。北极光怪盗团登场了。
descriptionEn: As Senna continued her search, the bitter Camille pursued her with simmering rage. She was an elegant but ruthless dancer who ran afoul of a previous Polaris and was punished for it, enough so to lose her legs. Wielding newly empowered limbs, she ambushed Senna and summoned her compatriots, Sylas and Thresh. The Aurora thieves had arrived.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当空气变得清新，第一场雪飘落时，看向天空，北极星就会出现。不要害怕，如果你不计回报地行善，你可能会获得极光赐福作为奖励。但请记住：无论你怎么做，你都不能把你的好运视为理所当然，因为北极星每年都会来，没有人能逃脱惩罚。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When the air grows crisp and the first snow falls, look to the sky, for Polaris will appear. Do not be afraid, for if you've been virtuous without expectation, you might be rewarded with the Aurora's blessings. But remember: no matter how you act, you cannot take your fortunes for granted, because Polaris comes every year, and no one escapes punishment.

universes.descriptionZh: 你可曾听过极光的那些传说？它们可能寒冷和黑暗，但如果你足够勇敢，你就会发现超乎你梦想的温暖和威严。所以坐在火炉旁，来听听这些北极光的传说……
universes.descriptionEn: Have you heard the stories of the Aurora? Cold and dark they can be, but if you're brave enough you'll find warmth and majesty grander than any dream you've had. So sit yourself by the fire and come listen to these Tales of Borealis...

skinNameZh: 北极星钢影 卡蜜尔

nameZh: 2024 全球总决赛 佛耶戈 眼见为实
descriptionZh: 以此庆祝2024年在伦敦举办的全球总决赛。
descriptionEn: Celebrating Worlds 2024 in London.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有游戏中最伟大的舞台。两支队伍在数百万粉丝面前对决。只有一支队伍会被加冕为冠军。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The greatest stage in all of gaming. Two teams face off before millions of fans. Only one will be crowned the champion.

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

skinNameZh: 2024 全球总决赛 佛耶戈

nameZh: 天龙之子 卡莎 飞龙乘云
descriptionZh: 卡莎是皇家斥候，也是龙太子的好友。她很坚毅，在云端度过的时间比她的任何同龄人都多。虽然这是她第一次与人类直接互动，但她观察到的知识和机敏一定会在她与人类一起庆祝新年时派上用场。
descriptionEn: Royal scout and friend to the prince, Kai'Sa is a tenacious dragon who has spent more time beneath the clouds than any of her peers. Though this is the first time she has interacted with humans directly, her observed knowledge and agile grace are sure to be assets while joining them in the New Year's celebration.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 青花瓷 艾瑞莉娅 月色
descriptionZh: 艾瑞莉娅早在成为生肖神卫之前就致力于保护古代圣物了。大学的第一年，她就在著名的考古研究所实习。这是她短暂一生的亮点……直到她被羊生肖圣物赋予了神话力量，并被卷入了一场长达数百年的战争。与之相比，学业就略显苍白了。
descriptionEn: Irelia was dedicated to the preservation of ancient relics long before she became a protector. Her first year at university, she interned at the renowned Archeology Institute. It was the highlight of her short life... until she was granted mythical powers by the Ram Relic and thrust into a centuries-old war. Schoolwork sort of pales in comparison.
heroNameZh: 刀锋舞者 艾瑞莉娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 心之钢 伊泽瑞尔 天纵才华
descriptionZh: 一首精心制作的神曲让伊泽瑞尔成为万众瞩目的焦点，但在这张专辑遭到批评时，他又再次过气，于是伊泽瑞尔决定是时候收回一些创作控制权了。现在，伊泽瑞尔离开了他的旧厂牌，并将自己的明星影响力借给了心之钢，找到了一些准备与他一起复出翻红的音乐家和朋友。
descriptionEn: After a manufactured one-hit wonder launched Ezreal into the spotlight, only for him to fall out of it again when the album got panned, Ezreal decided it was time he took some creative control back. Now, having left his old label and lending what star power he has to HEARTSTEEL, Ezreal has found musicians and friends he's ready to make a comeback with.

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 灌篮高手 德莱厄斯 金色神话
descriptionZh: 在拥有超过一百种不同的代言合同和数千万全球粉丝后，德莱厄斯已经将自己从一个能秀的篮球奇才转型成了一个引领世界的灌篮权威。他最近已经完善了灌篮镇高速，他在那儿可以猛烈地灌篮，好让星球上的所有公共交通同时爆炸。
descriptionEn: Sporting over a hundred different endorsement deals and tens of millions of fans the world over, Darius has transformed himself from a showy basketball prodigy to the world's leading authority on dunking. He has recently perfected the Dunktown Express, where he dunks so hard that all public transit on the planet simultaneously explodes.
heroNameZh: 诺克萨斯之手 德莱厄斯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这个世界上有两种人：会灌篮的人，和被灌篮的人。如果你不知道你是哪一种，那就得小心了！因为你就要被灌篮了！
skinSets.descriptionEn: There are two types of people in this world: those that dunk, and those who get dunked. If you don't know which one you are, then watch out! 'Cuz you're about to GET DUNKED!

universes.descriptionZh: 磨砺之路不仅仅是工作。它是斗争，是喧嚣，有时令人振奋，有时令人沮丧。它是一个为期一周的过山车，有喜剧性的过弯和悲惨的急落，只会在周一重新开始。我们是努力工作还是几乎不工作？在磨砺之路上，一切都一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The grind isn't just work. It's the struggle, the hustle, sometimes invigorating, sometimes demoralizing. It's a weeklong rollercoaster with comedic bends and tragic drops, only to start all over again on Monday. Are we working hard or hardly working? It's all the same on the grind.

skinNameZh: 灌篮高手 德莱厄斯

nameZh: 北极星使者 彗 圣洁光带
descriptionZh: 北极星的使者——彗，正在沮丧中苦苦等待。当赛娜和赫卡里姆来到凡人的世界找到他时，狂风大作，飞雪连天。身为使者的他，用画笔在天空中泼洒北极光，为世间降下初雪。在赫卡里姆的示意下，他挥动画笔，扫开乌云，露出苍茫的天空。可是北极光在哪里？
descriptionEn: The herald of Polaris, Hwei, waited in a despondent mood. When Senna and Hecarim found him among the world of man, a violent blizzard raged overhead. As herald, he used his brush to paint the Aurora across the skies, bringing the first snow. At Hecarim's beckoning, he waved his brush, parting the clouds to reveal a barren sky. Where was the Aurora?

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当空气变得清新，第一场雪飘落时，看向天空，北极星就会出现。不要害怕，如果你不计回报地行善，你可能会获得极光赐福作为奖励。但请记住：无论你怎么做，你都不能把你的好运视为理所当然，因为北极星每年都会来，没有人能逃脱惩罚。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When the air grows crisp and the first snow falls, look to the sky, for Polaris will appear. Do not be afraid, for if you've been virtuous without expectation, you might be rewarded with the Aurora's blessings. But remember: no matter how you act, you cannot take your fortunes for granted, because Polaris comes every year, and no one escapes punishment.

universes.descriptionZh: 你可曾听过极光的那些传说？它们可能寒冷和黑暗，但如果你足够勇敢，你就会发现超乎你梦想的温暖和威严。所以坐在火炉旁，来听听这些北极光的传说……
universes.descriptionEn: Have you heard the stories of the Aurora? Cold and dark they can be, but if you're brave enough you'll find warmth and majesty grander than any dream you've had. So sit yourself by the fire and come listen to these Tales of Borealis...

nameZh: 龙的传人 李青 龙啸九天
descriptionZh: 在全世界备受敬仰的武术家，李青在训练时更喜欢避开公众的视野，单独磨砺自己的技艺。传说他可以使用巨龙之怒打出一拳，但是如果有人能够确定的话，你就知道他们绝非是泛泛而谈。
descriptionEn: A famed martial artist beloved the world over, Lee Sin prefers to train far away from the public eye, honing his craft in solitude. Rumors claim that he can punch with the fury of a dragon—but if anyone knows for sure, they're not talking.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 北极星使者 安妮 七彩光斑
descriptionZh: 赛娜启程去寻找北极光，但首先遇到的是一个小女孩——安妮，她正独自站在自家门前。她最珍视的童年伙伴——家中的宠物熊，不久前死掉了。安妮希望北极星能复活他，但赛娜拒绝了，只是给了她一只小熊玩偶。“生离死别在所难免，但他的记忆将寄托在这份礼物身上。”
descriptionEn: Senna set off to search for the Aurora, only to encounter the child, Annie, outside her estate. Her most cherished friend was her family's pet bear, who recently died. Annie wished for Polaris to bring him back to life, but Senna refused, and instead presented the bear in toy form. "Loss is a part of life, but his memories will live inside this gift.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当空气变得清新，第一场雪飘落时，看向天空，北极星就会出现。不要害怕，如果你不计回报地行善，你可能会获得极光赐福作为奖励。但请记住：无论你怎么做，你都不能把你的好运视为理所当然，因为北极星每年都会来，没有人能逃脱惩罚。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When the air grows crisp and the first snow falls, look to the sky, for Polaris will appear. Do not be afraid, for if you've been virtuous without expectation, you might be rewarded with the Aurora's blessings. But remember: no matter how you act, you cannot take your fortunes for granted, because Polaris comes every year, and no one escapes punishment.

universes.descriptionZh: 你可曾听过极光的那些传说？它们可能寒冷和黑暗，但如果你足够勇敢，你就会发现超乎你梦想的温暖和威严。所以坐在火炉旁，来听听这些北极光的传说……
universes.descriptionEn: Have you heard the stories of the Aurora? Cold and dark they can be, but if you're brave enough you'll find warmth and majesty grander than any dream you've had. So sit yourself by the fire and come listen to these Tales of Borealis...

nameZh: 幻灵战斗兔 阿萝拉 梦幻强袭
descriptionZh: 作为幻灵战队唯一的科研专家，阿萝拉利用她对海魔人的了解（以及生物工程博士学位）来翻译和改编海魔科技。虽然她的工作为幻灵战队的设备带来了令人难以置信的进步，但她真正追求的是帮助世界像她一样了解海魔人。
descriptionEn: As Anima Squad's sole research specialist, Aurora uses her understanding of the Primordians (and PhD in bioengineering) to translate and adapt Primordian technology. While her work has led to incredible advancements in Anima Squad's equipment, her true passion is helping the world understand Primordians as she does.

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

skinNameZh: 幻灵战斗兔 阿萝拉

nameZh: 神龙尊者 夜之龙 薇恩 集仙
descriptionZh: 薇恩发誓要追捕因布兰德的大肆破坏而出现的各种燃烧、腐烂的武装势力。她未曾动摇过，即使在一个遥远的海岸被逼入绝境时，她也一直战斗到了垂死边缘。命运使然，她的险胜恰逢一次新夜轮换，并且午夜之龙神降临，为她的灵体灌注了受到赐福的黑暗，锋利得如同龙鳞。
descriptionEn: Vayne vowed to hunt the blazing, rotting forces that arose from Brand's destruction. She never faltered, even when cornered on a remote coast, where she fought to the brink of death. By fate, her narrow victory coincided with the turn of a new night, and the Midnight Dragon came down to imbue her spirit with blessed darkness, sharp as draconic scales.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 尊荣的巨龙们居住在偏远的雄奇瑰丽之地，为了避免外面的凡界纷争，它们只会非常罕见地将礼物赐给极少数被它们选中的人。神龙尊者们就是幸运且强大到足以获得这种终极赐福的人。他们用它来行善还是行恶，都取决于他们自己，以及任何强大到足以制止他们的人。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Majestic dragons dwell in remote places of wild beauty, avoiding mortal affairs outside of rarely bestowing their gifts on only a select few. The Dragonmancers are those fortunate and powerful enough to have gained the ultimate blessing. Whether they then use that for good or for evil is up to them, and anyone strong enough to stop them.

universes.descriptionZh: 圣兽们守护着整个世界，能够把任何人变成强大的存在，但前提是那个灵魂值得他们的祝福。无论他们的力量是用于善还是恶，一旦赐予，就无法收回。
universes.descriptionEn: Divine beasts watch over the world entire, capable of turning anyone into powerful beings, but only if that soul is worthy of their blessings. Whether their power is used for good or evil, once the gift is given, it cannot be taken away.

skinNameZh: 神龙尊者 夜之龙 薇恩

nameZh: 青花瓷 莫甘娜 金辉玉洁
descriptionZh: 没有人比莫甘娜更了解女巫丽桑卓的力量。将丽桑卓束缚在她的圣物上的那个魔法，是有代价的：说出这段咒语的生肖神卫也会被困住。莫甘娜牺牲了自己，而她的鸡生肖圣物的双翼将她包裹在瓷茧中长达数千年。再次醒来后，她要加倍奉还。
descriptionEn: There is no one who comprehends the power of the sorceress Lissandra more than Morgana. The magic that bound Lissandra to her relic came at a cost: the protector who uttered the words would be trapped as well. Morgana made this sacrifice, the wings of her Rooster Relic wrapping her in a porcelain cocoon for millennia. Awake once more, she seeks revenge.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 金克丝 提子班戟
descriptionZh: 金克丝决心证明自己是世界上最棒的糕点师。她利用她那混乱与技艺的独特调配成果，给她的主顾们留下了深刻的印象，并在竞争中脱颖而出！虽然她擅长咸味美食，但她偶尔也会享受一些甜食。不过……在她处于吃糖后的兴奋状态时，千万别去挡她的道。
descriptionEn: Determined to prove that she's the best pastry chef around, Jinx uses her unique blend of chaos and technique to impress her patrons and blow away the competition! Although she specializes in savory treats, she'll occasionally indulge in a little sugary goodness from time to time. But… don't get in her way while she's in the middle of a sugar rush.

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 女帝 菲奥娜 纹章之刻印·坚毅
descriptionZh: 泰勒姆——一个残酷的女帝之国——的贵族们密谋反对菲奥娜的上台，夺走了她的眼睛并对她的死亡大肆宣传。然而，她从鲜花和火焰中现身，然后在“神圣加冕礼”上获胜。女帝菲奥娜现在负责监督国立钢铁花园的武器制造，并通过训练和锻炼一位脾气暴躁的公主来确保她的权力继承。
descriptionEn: Nobles in the cutthroat queendom of Telum conspired against Fiora's rise to power, taking her eye and proclaiming her dead. Yet from flowers and flame she arose, then prevailed, in the Grand Coronation. Queen Fiora now oversees arms manufacturing in her nation's steel gardens, and secures her succession by training and tempering a certain fiery princess.

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……
universes.descriptionEn: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 战斗公主 安妮 纹章之刻印·敏锐
descriptionZh: 安妮在泰勒姆王廷前展示了她的魔法天赋，将她亲爱的泰迪熊变成了一位由钢铁与火焰组成的骑士。尽管这对许多贵族来说几乎是一次近乎灾难性的表现，但女帝菲奥娜还是接受了这个孩子的潜力，并指定她作为继任者。安妮为了在未来的加冕礼上取得胜利而不断训练……但也不断给她的王室导师添乱。
descriptionEn: Annie revealed her magical talents before Telum's royal court, transforming her dear teddy bear into a knight of steel and flame. Though a near-fatal display for many aristocrats, Queen Fiora embraced the child's potential and named her successor. Annie trains to triumph in a future Coronation… and causes a fair amount of mischief for her regal mentor.

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……
universes.descriptionEn: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 女帝 格温 纹章之刻印·敏锐
descriptionZh: 卡利戈，一个遥远的、古老的女帝之国，长期以来被认为已经消失在时间中。来自卡利戈的格温冲破了这个国家的保护云层，与伊莱西亚的其他国度重新建立了联系。她的前任——女帝伊苏尔德——相信格温的纯洁心灵和敏锐头脑会证实卡利戈的力量并与其他统治者们结盟——因为黑暗时代就在前方，只有一份坚定不移的盟约才能防止最坏的情况发生。
descriptionEn: Gwen of Caligo—a faraway, ancient queendom long thought lost to time—cut through the nation's protective clouds to reconnect with the rest of Elysia. Her predecessor, Queen Isolde, trusts Gwen's pure heart and sharp mind to affirm Caligo's strength and ally with fellow rulers—for dark times lie ahead, and only a steadfast pact may prevent the worst.

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……
universes.descriptionEn: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 女帝 厄运小姐 纹章之刻印·敏锐
descriptionZh: 女帝卡特琳娜的法令传遍了整个艾丽西亚：“神圣加冕礼”是各国之间两军对阵的荣耀战斗。瑟瑞尼亚的厄运小姐接纳了这一改变，指挥着她的空中舰队以一种爆炸性的方式炫耀着财富和弹药。虽然盟友是与世隔绝的奥莱，但厄运小姐的加冕证明了空中部队的残酷无情。
descriptionEn: Queen Katarina's decree rang throughout Elysia: the Grand Coronation ordains honorable battle among nations, army versus army. Miss Fortune of Cyrenia welcomed this change, commanding her sky-fleet in an explosive display of wealth and munitions. While allied to the secluded Aurai, Miss Fortune's crowning proves the ruthlessness of the brigades above.
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

universes.descriptionZh: 伊莱西亚曾经被无休止的战争给弄得支离破碎，而其中的诸多女帝之国已经认识到了她们世界的真实本质：把她们这个幻想位面结合到一起的那股魔力，只有通过冲突才能得以维持。因此，她们通过“神圣加冕礼”的统一冲突而结成了同盟，尽管有些联盟正在开始出现裂痕……
universes.descriptionEn: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

nameZh: 这货不是银狐 库奇
descriptionZh: 库奇是一位训狗师，有着一些不切实际的关于犬类空气动力学的想法。他已进入了世界上最为重要的宠物秀，同行的还有一只能够飞行的彭布罗克威尔士柯基。为什么他做了这个？他希望获得什么？他到底真是一个约德尔人，抑或不过是一个非常矮小的人类？这些全都是很重要的问题。
descriptionEn: A dog trainer with some impractical ideas about canine aerodynamics, Corki has entered the world's foremost pet show with a flight-enabled Pembroke Welsh Corgi. Why has he done this? What does he hope to gain? Is he really a Yordle, or just a very small man? These are all important questions.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 世界上已知的最古老的竞争：人类最好的朋友对抗互联网上最伟大的英雄。只有一个阵营会从猫狗之间的激烈战斗中获胜。希望他们的皮毛不要太脏：唯一比失败更糟糕的就是洗澡了。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The oldest rivalry the world has ever known: man's best friend pitted against the internet's greatest heroes. Only one faction will emerge victorious from the gnawing maw of battle between cats and dogs. Hopefully they don't get their fur too dirty: the only thing worse than losing is bathtime.

universes.descriptionZh: 世界上已知的最古老的竞争：人类最好的朋友对抗互联网上最伟大的英雄。只有一个阵营会从猫狗之间的激烈战斗中获胜。希望他们的皮毛不要太脏：唯一比失败更糟糕的就是洗澡了。
universes.descriptionEn: The oldest rivalry the world has ever known: man's best friend pitted against the internet's greatest heroes. Only one faction will emerge victorious from the gnawing maw of battle between cats and dogs. Hopefully they don't get their fur too dirty: the only thing worse than losing is bathtime.

nameZh: 西部魔影 伊芙琳 忠诚
descriptionZh: 这个可怜人看上去魂不守舍。完美。伊芙琳靠在吧台顶上，朝他倾身，弯起红唇甜蜜一笑：“给我讲一讲你的烦心事，帅哥。”并且他讲了。他给她讲了他的兄弟，以及一次不公平的交易，以及他如何觉得自己可能已经死了但又不确定……然后那个恶魔开始痛饮。“没事啦，亲爱的，”她柔声说。“你现在归我了。”
descriptionEn: The poor man looks haunted. Perfect. Evelynn leans over the bar top towards him with a sweet smile curling her red lips: “Tell me your woes, handsome.” And he does. He tells her of his brother, and a raw deal, and how he thinks he might be dead now but ain't sure... and the devil drinks deep. “It's alright, darlin',” she coos. “I've got you now.”

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

nameZh: 神凰行者 幽羽玄凰 萨勒芬妮 仙翰
descriptionZh: 萨勒芬妮是一名平民的捍卫者，她的音乐将她的社群团结在一起，以共同对抗一股试图消灭他们的力量。神凰听到了萨勒芬妮优美的歌声，并赐予她力量来对黑暗进行还击。
descriptionEn: A champion of the common folk, Seraphine's music united her community in defense against a mysterious force that sought to wipe them out. The fenghuang heard Seraphine's graceful song, and blessed her with the power to fight the darkness back.
heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

skinSets.descriptionZh: 一只传说中的瑞羽圣凰守护着世界。只有最真挚的心，才会得到这只神凰的祝福。她的捍卫者们会获得一根凰羽——每根凰羽都包含难以想象的元素力量，给予她们必要的手段来保护所有良善之人免受潜伏在阴影中的各个势力的伤害。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Only the truest hearts are blessed by the divine fenghuang, a legendary phoenix who watches over the world. Her champions receive a single feather—each one containing unimaginable elemental power, granting them the means needed to protect all that is innocent and good from forces lurking in the shadows.

universes.descriptionZh: 圣兽们守护着整个世界，能够把任何人变成强大的存在，但前提是那个灵魂值得他们的祝福。无论他们的力量是用于善还是恶，一旦赐予，就无法收回。
universes.descriptionEn: Divine beasts watch over the world entire, capable of turning anyone into powerful beings, but only if that soul is worthy of their blessings. Whether their power is used for good or evil, once the gift is given, it cannot be taken away.

skinNameZh: 神凰行者 幽羽玄凰 萨勒芬妮

nameZh: 玉剑传说 星仙子 丁香
descriptionZh: 幼年时的星仙子本是旸刚派的童女，也理应成为旸刚派的弟子，但她嫌恶既定的命数。在武神贾克斯的古老故事中曾经说过，他相信真正的力量来自于逍遥自在，因此星仙子违逆了父母的意愿，前往混意派接受修行。她将踏上独属其一人的大道。
descriptionEn: A child of Sprouting Courage School monks, Soraka was expected to follow them, but she hated having the choice already made for her. Remembering the old tales of God Staff Jax, who believed true power came from assuming nothing, Soraka shunned her parents' wishes to train at the Flowing Intuition School. She'll earn immortality her own way.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 墨之影武者 永恩 灵墨刻影
descriptionZh: 两兄弟失去了家园，成为了墨之影武者。其中一个放弃了他的自由，而另一个放弃了他的身份。 永恩为他的墨纹付出了高昂的代价：没有人记得他的存在。现在，他仅仅是一个被称为“千面具之人”的无名陌生人，保护着难民免受卡勃尔派的侵害，直到他们可以被送到亚索的保护之下为止。
descriptionEn: Two brothers lost their home and became Inkshadow Warriors. One gave up his freedom, and the other his identity. Yone paid a steep price for his tattoo: no one remembers that he existed. Now known only as a faceless stranger called the “Man of Masks,” he shields refugees from the Cabal until they can be delivered into Yasuo's protection.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在拉巴登城的郊外，一座破旧的神庙里居住着拉巴登人民最后的希望：墨之影武者们。他们每个人都牺牲了对他们来说最重要的东西，以便与远古灵体们签订一个契约，而这些远古灵体们为他们灌注了如此强大的魔法墨纹，以至于就连卡勃尔派也在颤抖。他们不再是无助者了。是时候收复他们的家园了。
skinSets.descriptionEn: On the outskirts of Rabadon City, a dilapidated temple houses the last hope for Rabadon's people: the Inkshadow Warriors. Each one sacrifices what is most important to them in order to make a contract with ancient spirits, who imbue them with magic tattoos so powerful, even the Cabal trembles. They are victims no more. It is time to take back their home.

universes.descriptionZh: 拉巴登城因魔法而繁荣。谁控制了魔法，谁就控制了拉巴登。而阴谋集团的控制是绝对的。任何反抗者都会被制服或被消灭……但义军即将来临。这些反抗者们所倚仗的武器是他们皮肤上直接绘制的危险魔法墨纹，而他们的目标是推翻卡勃尔派并将这座城市还给它的人民——不成功，便成仁。
universes.descriptionEn: Rabadon City thrives on magic. Whoever controls magic, controls Rabadon. And the Cabal's control is absolute. Any who resist are brought to heel or eliminated… but an Uprising is coming. Armed with dangerous magic inked directly into their skin, these rebels seek to topple the Cabal and give the city back to its people—or die trying.

nameZh: 海魔至尊 亚托克斯 呼啸俯冲
descriptionZh: 当海魔人第一次发起进攻时，人类毫无防备——直到幻灵战队成立，成为人类的最后一道防线。但他们不再安全，因为海魔人也随之进化。他们的顶端存在名为亚托克斯，而他对人类的理解只会进一步加深他的仇恨。他的肉体没有极限，他的剑刃毫不留情。他是幻灵末日的先兆。
descriptionEn: When the Primordians first attacked, humanity was unprepared—until Anima Squad formed to become its last defense. But they are safe no longer, for the Primordians evolved in turn. Their apex being is called Aatrox, whose understanding of humanity only furthers his hatred. His flesh has no limits, his sword no mercy. He is the harbinger of Anima's end.
heroNameZh: 暗裔剑魔 亚托克斯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 海魔人被从陆地上赶出来，蛰伏于深海中，等待了数个世纪之久……直到他们再也无法忍受地表居民们，以及地表居民们对这个星球的破坏。于是，海魔女王做出了判决：人类在太阳下的时代已经结束，海魔人的时代才刚刚开始。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Cast from dry land, the Primordians bided their time deep beneath the sea, biding their time for centuries… until they could no longer abide the surface-dwellers any longer, nor their abuses of the planet. Thus the Primordian Queen's judgment was made: humanity's era in the sun is over, and that of the Primordians has only just begun.

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

skinNameZh: 海魔至尊 亚托克斯

nameZh: 幻灵孤狼 亚索 魅影闪击
descriptionZh: 作为狼队的第一任队长，亚索在入侵初期与锐雯并肩作战。他一度消失，直到几年后才作为身经百战的生存专家重新出现，仍然穿着他原来的战斗服。他来此警告幻灵战队，敌人已经进化了——如果他们想要生存下去，就需要所有人手（和爪子）全力备战。
descriptionEn: The first captain of the Wolf Squad, Yasuo fought alongside Riven in the early days of the invasion. He disappeared only to reemerge years later a battle-hardened survivalist, still wearing his original suit. He's here to warn Anima Squad that the enemy has evolved—and if they want to survive, they'll need all hands (and paws) on deck.

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

nameZh: 海之歌 萨勒芬妮 冰爽浪花
descriptionZh: 在短暂休息给灵感充电之后，萨勒芬妮回来了！她没有直接投身单人巡演，而是利用海之歌音乐节的轻松能量来放松自己重返歌坛。没有演出曲目，她会聆听她的听众并融入音乐的潮流。
descriptionEn: After taking a break to recharge her creative spirit, Seraphine is back! Rather than dive straight into a solo tour, she's drawing on the relaxed energy of the Ocean Song Festival to ease herself back into singing. With no setlist, she's going to listen to her audience and let the musical current take her.
heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

skinSets.descriptionZh: 没有什么比海之歌音乐节更能散发出“海滩氛围和酷炫曲调”的生活方式了。从萨勒芬妮的柔和歌曲到永恩的实验性DJ现场，每个人都有一种氛围，所以，尽情感受脚趾间的沙子、品尝充满咸味的空气、沉浸在夏天最好的音乐中吧。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Nothing exudes the "beach vibes and cool tunes" lifestyle more than the Ocean Song Festival. From Seraphine's mellow songs to Yone's experimental DJ set, there's a vibe for everyone, so feel the sand between your toes, taste the salty air, and lose yourself to the best music of the summer.

universes.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
universes.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 战斗学院 蕾欧娜 独角兽
descriptionZh: 蕾欧娜是莱布利斯学院战斗俱乐部的一名奇怪的啦啦队员，她的黑暗一面会在战斗中展现，那时她的母性关爱的人格就会被嗜血给完全替代。这个变化是如此剧烈，以至于最粗暴的学生们都会留意让她保持善良的那一面，以期避免她发怒。
descriptionEn: An oddly cheery member of Labrys Academy's Battle Club, Leona's dark side comes out in combat, when her motherly, protective persona is utterly replaced by bloodlust. The change is so dramatic that even the most violent students tend to stay on her good side, hoping to avoid her wrath.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在这些院校中，只有强者才能生存。尽管它们的成立是为了纪念它们的神之武器，但每个学院的学生都在通往荣耀的道路上努力使它的力量成为自己的力量。无论它是在课堂，还是在战场，都在主导着竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: At these institutions, only the strong survive. Though they were founded to honor their God Weapon, the students at each academy strive to make its strength their own on their path to glory. Whether it's the classroom, or the battlefield, dominate the competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 散布在全球各地的神之武器将社会变成了一个由力量驱动的社会。这些有感知力的碑石召唤着那些配得上的人，并将其礼物赠予其主体，打算在这个饱受战争蹂躏的世界中扩张其征服之地。被选中是一种荣誉勋章，向任何可能反对他们的人灌输恐惧。
universes.descriptionEn: Scattered across the globe, the God Weapons morphed society into one driven by power. These sentient monuments call to those who are worthy and bestow their gifts upon their subjects, aiming to expand their conquest in this war-torn world. To be chosen is a badge of honor, instilling fear into any who may oppose them.

nameZh: 幻灵蝙蝠 霞 梦幻强袭
descriptionZh: 霞——蝙蝠小队的前卫大拿——知道，有时你必须先斩后奏。霞来自最终都市外的一个试图建立但被摧毁的定居点，她对海魔人的怨恨很大程度上是私人恩怨。在战斗的间歇期，她利用自己的秘密训练来避免萨勒芬妮打听她一直在跟谁发消息。
descriptionEn: Bat Squad's edgy hotshot Xayah knows that sometimes you have to strike first and hard to make a statement. Hailing from an attempted settlement outside Final City that was destroyed, Xayah's grudge against the Primordians is deeply personal. Between battles, she uses her stealth training to avoid Seraphine prying about who the guy she's always texting is.

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。

nameZh: 海之歌 艾希 冰爽浪花
descriptionZh: 艾希是炙手可热的服装公司“弗雷”的首席执行官。在北方总部不见天日地埋头工作一年后，她已经感到筋疲力尽。海之歌音乐节听起来是一个完美的机会，让她可以舒展筋骨，混进人潮，彻底沉醉于美妙的音乐中。
descriptionEn: As the CEO of the hot clothing company Frel, Ashe is dead tired after spending a year heads-down in work with little sun at her Northern headquarters. The Ocean Song Festival sounds like the perfect place for her to warm up, disappear into a crowd, and lose herself to some fabulous music.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 没有什么比海之歌音乐节更能散发出“海滩氛围和酷炫曲调”的生活方式了。从萨勒芬妮的柔和歌曲到永恩的实验性DJ现场，每个人都有一种氛围，所以，尽情感受脚趾间的沙子、品尝充满咸味的空气、沉浸在夏天最好的音乐中吧。

nameZh: 海之歌 永恩 月夜潮汐
descriptionZh: 永恩很紧张。作为一名DJ，他冷静、专注、即兴，但海之歌是他作为DJ和作词人的第一场音乐会。在找到他的歌词秘密藏匿处后，他的朋友奈德丽在他拒唱时自愿唱出这些歌词。他可能还没准备好唱歌，但他们仍然会听到他的声音。
descriptionEn: Yone is nervous. As a DJ he's calm, focused, and improvisational, but Ocean Song is his first concert as a DJ and lyricist. After finding his secret stash of lyrics, his friend Nidalee volunteered to belt them out herself when he refused. He may not be ready to sing, but they'll still hear his voice.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 没有什么比海之歌音乐节更能散发出“海滩氛围和酷炫曲调”的生活方式了。从萨勒芬妮的柔和歌曲到永恩的实验性DJ现场，每个人都有一种氛围，所以，尽情感受脚趾间的沙子、品尝充满咸味的空气、沉浸在夏天最好的音乐中吧。

nameZh: 星之守护者 阿卡丽 未来之光
descriptionZh: 阿卡丽时断时续地担任着新一代星之守护者的联合队长。她越来越意识到，她所宣誓的誓言已经注定了她的死亡，而这导致了她的战斗技巧被蒙上了一层阴影。尽管她全心全意为光明而战，但她发现黑暗同样强大……也许，甚至更加强大……
descriptionEn: On-again off-again co-captain of a new generation of Star Guardians, Akali's skill in battle is shadowed by her growing realization that the Oath she swore has condemned her to die. Though she fights for the light with all her heart, she finds that darkness is just as powerful... perhaps, even more so...

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

skinNameZh: 星之守护者 阿卡丽

nameZh: SKT T1 辛德拉 至强
descriptionZh: 以此致敬Faker在2016年全球总决赛中使用辛德拉的夺胜表现。这是Faker第三个世界冠军皮肤。前两次是2013和2015年全球总决赛SKT夺冠。
descriptionEn: Honoring Faker's winning performance as Syndra during the 2016 World Championship. This is Faker's third World Champion skin, following his wins with SKT at the 2013 and 2015 World Championships.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 恭喜2016年全球总决赛冠军：SK Telecom T1！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2016: SK Telecom T1!

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

nameZh: 殿堂传奇 乐芙兰 至强
descriptionZh: 记住，乐芙兰，你是隐忍的守护者。你代表着谋略、理性、和巧思，用诡术欺骗那些自以为是的人，守护我的力量。我们的力量。  最重要的是，引领我的天选者历经试炼，让世人永远铭记不死大魔王。
descriptionEn: Remember your duty as my Keeper of Patience, LeBlanc. You embody all that is strategic, methodical, and clever, as you deceive those who think themselves worthy of my power. Our power. Above all else, guide my chosen through their trials and influence the masses in the name of the Unkillable Demon King.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 从前，众神将他们的力量封存在四块屹世晶片中：混沌、和谐、隐忍、活力。晶片的神力会向来访的勇士发出凶险的试炼，同时应允他们铭志不朽。时至今日，各路豪杰纷纷前来挑战，只为留下一段人神共赏的传奇。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, gods of myth sealed their strength within the four Shards of the Risen: Chaos, Harmony, Patience, and Vigor. Each presented a life-threatening trial to warriors who sought its power, promising to immortalize them in history. To this day, fighters across the land rise to the challenge in hopes of leaving a legacy that even a god will respect.

universes.descriptionZh: 为了避免被永远从历史中抹去，许多人冒着生命危险成为“殿堂传奇”——一位受到这个世界的创世神们认可的勇士。那些成功的人被赋予了深不可测的力量，并被委托代表那些选择他们的神。
universes.descriptionEn: To avoid being erased from history forever, many risk their lives to become a Risen Legend—a warrior recognized by the gods who birthed this world. Those who succeed are bestowed with unfathomable power and entrusted to represent the gods that chose them.

nameZh: 殿堂传奇 乐芙兰 登神
descriptionZh: 记住，乐芙兰，你是隐忍的守护者。你代表着谋略、理性、和巧思，用诡术欺骗那些自以为是的人，守护我的力量。我们的力量。  最重要的是，引领我的天选者历经试炼，让世人永远铭记不死大魔王。

Above all else, guide my chosen through their trials and influence the masses in the name of the Unkillable Demon King.

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 拉克丝 幻之魂焰
descriptionZh: 在离家出走时，她认为最好的藏身之处是在电视上？！不过说实话，各位，这位女士有一些痛苦经历……我们都知道擂台是解决那个问题的*地方*！现在，如果让我猜的话——我确实要猜——我敢说她会用那个灵魂的愿望来让她的抓马人生消失不见。有请拉克丝！
descriptionEn: On the run from her family, and she figured the best place to hide would be ON TV?! Seriously though, folks, this lady has some trauma... and we all know the ring is *the* place to work that out! Now, if I was a betting man—and I am—I'd say she'd use that soul's desire to make her drama disappear. It's Lux!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

universes.descriptionZh: 来自世界各地，那些斗魂已经觉醒的人们被邀请参加……斗魂武道大会！它是凌驾于所有娱乐之上的王者，是一个无与伦比的电视奇观！战士们在擂台上一对一单挑，直至只剩一人拿到大奖：灵魂最深处的愿望！而我会在这里，播报这一切！
universes.descriptionEn: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 春晖神女 艾希 玉露金风
descriptionZh: 艾希——大海皇帝的女儿——在远离家乡的废弃岛屿上寻求慰藉，因为她的人民遭受了厄运。在那里，她与一条奇怪的蛟龙和一个阴险的准国王结盟，希望他们的潜在力量可以帮她夺回她的帝国。这是一次经过一番苦战才得来的胜利，但真正的战争远未结束，那就是：外交。
descriptionEn: Her people slaughtered, Ashe—daughter of the Emperor of the Great Sea—sought solace on an abandoned island far from home. There, she made alliances with a strange serpent and a sinister would-be king, in the hope that their untapped might could help seize her empire back. It was a hard-fought victory, but the true battle is far from over: diplomacy.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 魅惑女巫 迦娜 炫金
descriptionZh: 迦娜最爱的季节又来了——这个时节里，黑暗的灵体从地上升起，并且隐藏的糖果宝藏将被所有人享用。做出你最棒的乔装，然后驰骋入黑夜中，因为巫聚时分即将来临！
descriptionEn: It's Janna's favorite season once again—when dark spirits rise from the earth, and hidden troves of candy are enjoyed by all. Don your best disguise and ride into the night, for the witching hour is upon us!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 谁说女巫们不能嬉闹？不管是谁，那家伙现在可能是一只青蛙了。或是其他一些被诅咒的害虫，注定永远在街上徘徊，从远处观看庆典前夜的庆祝活动。相当严厉的惩罚，但你在期待什么？ 她们可能知道如何举办派对，但到了晚上，她们仍然是女巫！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Who said witches can't have fun? Whoever it was, they're probably a frog now. Or some other cursed vermin, doomed to forever wander the streets, watching the eve's celebrations from afar. Pretty harsh punishment, but what did you expect? They may know how to throw a party, but at the end of the night, they're still witches!

universes.descriptionZh: 父母们在他们的孩子们讲述着关于邪恶女巫之类的故事：她们每年都会有一个晚上潜伏在街道之中。 “待在床上，小家伙，因为黑暗是她们的朋友。” 这些故事只有一部分是真的；虽然这个迷人夜晚的食尸鬼喜欢吓人，但他们绝不会伤害孩子的一根头发。那些特别淘气的除外。
universes.descriptionEn: Parents tell their children stories of wicked witches and the like, those that lurk the streets one night each year. "Stay in your bed, little one, for darkness is their friend." These tales are only partly true; while the ghouls of this enchanted evening love a good scare, they'd never harm a hair on a child's head. Except for the very naughty ones.

nameZh: 青花瓷 艾瑞莉娅 金辉玉洁
descriptionZh: 艾瑞莉娅早在成为生肖神卫之前就致力于保护古代圣物了。大学的第一年，她就在著名的考古研究所实习。这是她短暂一生的亮点……直到她被羊生肖圣物赋予了神话力量，并被卷入了一场长达数百年的战争。与之相比，学业就略显苍白了。
descriptionEn: Irelia was dedicated to the preservation of ancient relics long before she became a protector. Her first year at university, she interned at the renowned Archeology Institute. It was the highlight of her short life... until she was granted mythical powers by the Ram Relic and thrust into a centuries-old war. Schoolwork sort of pales in comparison.
heroNameZh: 刀锋舞者 艾瑞莉娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 格温 酒醉樱桃
descriptionZh: 格温是咖啡馆顾客服务的友善面容，总是面带微笑和一尘不染的糕点欢迎顾客。不过不要被愚弄了——当无赖顾客威胁她的朋友们时，她并不怕用她的切糖剪子来做些其他事情。
descriptionEn: Gwen is the friendly face of customer service for the cafe, always there to welcome patrons with a smile and an immaculately-plated pastry. Don't be fooled, though—she isn't afraid to use her candy-cutting shears for other things when rogue customers threaten her friends.

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 青花瓷 德莱厄斯 金辉玉洁
descriptionZh: 德莱厄斯从远处观望着虎生肖圣物的当代神卫，默默地评判着他的后辈。在他还是神卫时，虎生肖可是骄傲的象征……现在，生肖神卫似乎要把这个职责托付给任何一个辅修考古学的人。在重回物理状态后，德莱厄斯相信他可以给这个孩子露一两手。
descriptionEn: Darius has watched the modern-day protector of the Tiger Relic from afar, silently judging his descendant. Back when he was protector, the Tiger was a symbol of pride... Now it seems the Zodiac will hand off the duty to anyone with a minor in archeology. Returned to physical form, Darius believes he can show this kid a thing or two.
heroNameZh: 诺克萨斯之手 德莱厄斯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。

They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 星之守护者 阿卡丽 热情之光
descriptionZh: 阿卡丽时断时续地担任着新一代星之守护者的联合队长。她越来越意识到，她所宣誓的誓言已经注定了她的死亡，而这导致了她的战斗技巧被蒙上了一层阴影。尽管她全心全意为光明而战，但她发现黑暗同样强大……也许，甚至更加强大……
descriptionEn: On-again off-again co-captain of a new generation of Star Guardians, Akali's skill in battle is shadowed by her growing realization that the Oath she swore has condemned her to die. Though she fights for the light with all her heart, she finds that darkness is just as powerful... perhaps, even more so...

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

skinNameZh: 星之守护者 阿卡丽

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 拉克丝 无限斗志
descriptionZh: 在离家出走时，她认为最好的藏身之处是在电视上？！不过说实话，各位，这位女士有一些痛苦经历……我们都知道擂台是解决那个问题的*地方*！现在，如果让我猜的话——我确实要猜——我敢说她会用那个灵魂的愿望来让她的抓马人生消失不见。有请拉克丝！
descriptionEn: On the run from her family, and she figured the best place to hide would be ON TV?! Seriously though, folks, this lady has some trauma... and we all know the ring is *the* place to work that out! Now, if I was a betting man—and I am—I'd say she'd use that soul's desire to make her drama disappear. It's Lux!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

universes.descriptionZh: 来自世界各地，那些斗魂已经觉醒的人们被邀请参加……斗魂武道大会！它是凌驾于所有娱乐之上的王者，是一个无与伦比的电视奇观！战士们在擂台上一对一单挑，直至只剩一人拿到大奖：灵魂最深处的愿望！而我会在这里，播报这一切！
universes.descriptionEn: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 战斗学院 盖伦 不死鸟
descriptionZh: 作为“拉克丝”的哥哥，盖伦是他们家唯一的亲生孩子，但他从小就被父母忽视了，因为他的父母将他们的所有时间都花在研发神之武器的碎片上，而这个碎片终有一日会成为他们的女儿。当他以越来越不良的方式发泄自己的愤怒时，莱布利斯找到他入学，而他在那里最终加入了战斗俱乐部。
descriptionEn: 'Brother' to Lux, Garen is the only biological child of his family, but was neglected from an early age as his parents spent all their time developing the god-weapon fragment that would one day become their daughter. As he vented his anger in increasingly delinquent ways, Labrys sought him out for enrollment, where he eventually joined the Battle Club.
heroNameZh: 德玛西亚之力 盖伦

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在这些院校中，只有强者才能生存。尽管它们的成立是为了纪念它们的神之武器，但每个学院的学生都在通往荣耀的道路上努力使它的力量成为自己的力量。无论它是在课堂，还是在战场，都在主导着竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: At these institutions, only the strong survive. Though they were founded to honor their God Weapon, the students at each academy strive to make its strength their own on their path to glory. Whether it's the classroom, or the battlefield, dominate the competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 散布在全球各地的神之武器将社会变成了一个由力量驱动的社会。这些有感知力的碑石召唤着那些配得上的人，并将其礼物赠予其主体，打算在这个饱受战争蹂躏的世界中扩张其征服之地。被选中是一种荣誉勋章，向任何可能反对他们的人灌输恐惧。
universes.descriptionEn: Scattered across the globe, the God Weapons morphed society into one driven by power. These sentient monuments call to those who are worthy and bestow their gifts upon their subjects, aiming to expand their conquest in this war-torn world. To be chosen is a badge of honor, instilling fear into any who may oppose them.

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 波比 焦糖布丁
descriptionZh: 波比偶然发现了一柄神奇的锤子，据说它的每次挥舞都会留下最可口的招待美食。在此之后，波比发现了她真正的使命：喂饱咖啡馆里饥肠辘辘的顾客们！然而，任何人只要敢惹她的朋友……就可能会发现，她的招待并不总是那么甜蜜。
descriptionEn: After stumbling upon a magical hammer said to leave behind the tastiest treats from every swing, Poppy discovered her true calling: feeding the cafe's hungry customers! Anybody who messes with her friends, though… might find out that those treats aren't always so sweet.

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 魔女 娜美 饕餮
descriptionZh: 它们从深海中召唤娜美，它们的声音带着一个承诺，许以她前所未知的更强力量。娜美需要做的就是供养它。她现在已经放弃了她的誓言，她的魔女集会，在永恒之森的浑浊水道下方进行了无数个黑夜的潜伏，寻找着她对利维坦的下一个祭品。
descriptionEn: They called to Nami from the deep, their voice carrying a promise of power greater than any she had ever known. All Nami needed to do was feed it. She has now forsaken her oaths, her coven, spending endless nights lurking just below the murky waterways of the Elderwood in search of her next sacrifice to the Leviathan.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 女巫们蛰伏以待，一个充满了骇人美貌的姐妹会，她们的希望从不再神圣的双唇中低语而出。她们谈到了古神们的膨胀尸体，谈到了用人类早已遗忘的魔法进行的古老仪式，谈到了她们所谓的“秩序”的回归，但也有人称之为“苦难”。听！人类的末日即将来临。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The witches lay in wait, a sisterhood of frightening pulchritude, their hopes whispered forth from desacralized lips. They speak of the bloating corpses of Old Gods, of ancient rites carried out with magics long forgotten to mortal mind, of the return of what they call "order", but others call "suffering". Hark! Mankind's end fast approaches.

universes.descriptionZh: 起初，古神们统治着世界。人类对他们的爱是如此之大，以至于某个古神敢于让他们永远成为她肉体的一部分。她吞噬了太阳本身，并从那空无的天堂降临，激励她的骑士们消灭所有剩下的人。几个世纪后，他们屹立不倒，成为对抗崛起的魔女团之暗的唯一希望。
universes.descriptionEn: In the beginning, the Old Gods reigned. So great was humankind's love for them that one dared to make them a part of her flesh forever. She devoured the sun itself and, descending from that empty heaven, inspired her knights to decimate all those that remained. Centuries later, they stand, the only hope against the rising Coven's darkness.

nameZh: 魔女 辛德拉 饕餮
descriptionZh: 它们来到辛德拉身边，在腐肉飞翼雷鸣般的扑动中，召唤她从凡性的桎梏中自我解脱。跟随飞翼的污风来到一个仪式场所，她和另一个女巫一起将“长角王”从他的腐烂坟墓中唤醒。她现在力求对所有反对魔女集会或古神的人进行报复。
descriptionEn: They came to Syndra in a thundering flutter of carrion wings, beckoning her to free herself from the limitations of mortals. Following the wings' foul wind to a ritual site, she along with another witch awakened the Horned King from his putrid tomb. She now seeks retribution against all who stand against the Coven or the Old Gods.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 女巫们蛰伏以待，一个充满了骇人美貌的姐妹会，她们的希望从不再神圣的双唇中低语而出。她们谈到了古神们的膨胀尸体，谈到了用人类早已遗忘的魔法进行的古老仪式，谈到了她们所谓的“秩序”的回归，但也有人称之为“苦难”。听！人类的末日即将来临。

Mankind's end fast approaches.

nameZh: 魔女 伊莉丝 饕餮
descriptionZh: 它们很久前来到伊莉丝身边，从灌木丛中爬过，它们的许多眼睛与她的眼睛锁定，好似达成了协议。用一位古神的深不可测的力量，换取她的献祭和人性。伊莉丝以一位蜘蛛神的形象重生，在永恒之森的边缘徘徊，引诱那些愚蠢到相信她只是民间故事的人前往他们的尽头。
descriptionEn: They came to Elise long ago, crawling through the underbrush, their many eyes locked with hers as a deal was made. The unfathomable powers of an Old God for her devotion and humanity. Reborn in the image of an arachnoid deity, Elise lingers along the edges of the Elderwood, enticing to their doom all those foolish enough to believe her a mere folktale.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 女巫们蛰伏以待，一个充满了骇人美貌的姐妹会，她们的希望从不再神圣的双唇中低语而出。她们谈到了古神们的膨胀尸体，谈到了用人类早已遗忘的魔法进行的古老仪式，谈到了她们所谓的“秩序”的回归，但也有人称之为“苦难”。听！人类的末日即将来临。

Mankind's end fast approaches.

nameZh: 魔女 阿卡丽 虚荣
descriptionZh: 它们来到阿卡丽身边，以不可思议的速度从树冠上包围了她，它们的嘲讽引导她深入永恒之森的深处，直到最后她迷了路。然后一个声音在她耳边低语着这个选择：要么独自死在森林中，要么在它们的掌控中存活下去。于是她走出了森林……直接投入魔女集会的怀抱。
descriptionEn: They came to Akali encircling from the tree canopy at an impossible speed, their taunts leading her deeper still into the Elderwood until at last she was lost. Then a voice whispered the choice right into her ear: die in these woods alone or emerge in their charge. And so she walked out of the woods... straight into the arms of the Coven.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 女巫们蛰伏以待，一个充满了骇人美貌的姐妹会，她们的希望从不再神圣的双唇中低语而出。她们谈到了古神们的膨胀尸体，谈到了用人类早已遗忘的魔法进行的古老仪式，谈到了她们所谓的“秩序”的回归，但也有人称之为“苦难”。听！人类的末日即将来临。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The witches lay in wait, a sisterhood of frightening pulchritude, their hopes whispered forth from desacralized lips. They speak of the bloating corpses of Old Gods, of ancient rites carried out with magics long forgotten to mortal mind, of the return of what they call "order", but others call "suffering". Hark! Mankind's end fast approaches.

universes.descriptionZh: 起初，古神们统治着世界。人类对他们的爱是如此之大，以至于某个古神敢于让他们永远成为她肉体的一部分。她吞噬了太阳本身，并从那空无的天堂降临，激励她的骑士们消灭所有剩下的人。几个世纪后，他们屹立不倒，成为对抗崛起的魔女团之暗的唯一希望。
universes.descriptionEn: In the beginning, the Old Gods reigned. So great was humankind's love for them that one dared to make them a part of her flesh forever. She devoured the sun itself and, descending from that empty heaven, inspired her knights to decimate all those that remained. Centuries later, they stand, the only hope against the rising Coven's darkness.

nameZh: 魔女 阿狸 饕餮
descriptionZh: 它们来到阿狸身边，在第一缕暮光中——暗光豺狼的笑声，一直追猎着这个世界，正如它转向自身不可避免的熵增。 作为凶恶的掠食者和强大的女巫，阿狸从被她引诱靠近的所有生物那里吸取生命，并将其输送向她在黑暗中的领主。
descriptionEn: They came to Ahri at the first stirrings of dusk—the laughter of the Half-Light Jackal, ever stalking the world as it turned towards its own inevitable entropy. A vicious predator and powerful witch, Ahri sucks the life from all she lures close, siphoning it towards her lord within the gloom.

Mankind's end fast approaches.

nameZh: 花仙子 拉克丝 蓝闪
descriptionZh: 拉克丝是在大法师米利欧座下学习的一位年轻女术士，准备证明她不只是一位无所事事的夏之廷女士。她负责将阳光透过晨露分解成彩虹，每天在太阳升起之前都有很多工作要做——但她有的是决心！
descriptionEn: A young sorceress studying under Archmage Milio, Lux is ready to prove that she's not just an idle Lady of the Summer Court. Responsible for splitting sunbeams into rainbows through the morning dew, she has a lot of work to conquer each day before the sun rises—but she is nothing if not determined!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有花仙贵族都是自然意志的仆人，用他们的魔法实行自然的秩序和四季的更替。然而，在那个更高的目标之下，在满是丝绸、薄纱和黄金的各个奢华王庭之中，政治阴谋的游戏不断上演。 毕竟，权能——不管是魔法的、自然的还是政治的——总会激发竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: All fae nobility are servants to nature's will, carrying out the natural order and the turning of seasons with their magic. Beneath that higher purpose, however, a constant game of political intrigue plays out in luxurious courts of silk, gossamer, and gold. Power, after all—magical, natural, or political—always inspires competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 各式各样的花仙与林精都把各个花仙王国称为家园：所有由纯粹自然魔法和空灵之美组成的生物都喜欢月光狂欢、悦耳歌声、以及诡计多端的交易。
universes.descriptionEn: Pixies, nixies, hobs, redcaps, and more call the Faerie Queendoms home: all creatures of pure natural magic and ethereal beauty that delight in moonlight revels, mellifluous song, and tricksy dealings.

nameZh: 黎明使者 薇恩 虹辉
descriptionZh: 作为一位急于向黎明使者展示自己潜力的自负神明，薇恩出于对众神预言的毁灭带给她的深深恐惧而无情地猎杀着黑夜使者们。她的行为如此暴力，以至于她因为在身后留下了更多的混沌而逐渐黑化。尽管如此，她仍希望击败嘉文这一功绩将会足以巩固她在光明之中的地位。
descriptionEn: An overconfident god keen to show her potential to the Dawnbringers, Vayne ruthlessly hunts the Nightbringers out of her deep fear of the gods' foretold destruction. So violent are her actions that she undermines herself by leaving even more chaos in her wake. Still, she hopes killing Jarvan will be enough to cement her standing within the light.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 黑夜使者和黎明使者之间的冲突是永恒的。一方面，混沌和黑暗的力量带来了改变，而另一方面，秩序和光明的力量带来了结构。正是这些神和他们的后裔塑造了一个新生的世界，而谁也说不准未来到底会带来更光明的白昼……还是更黑暗的黑夜。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Timeless is the conflict between the Nightbringers and Dawnbringers. On one side, the forces of chaos and darkness bring change, while on the other, the forces of order and light bring structure. It is these gods and their descendents that shape a nascent world, and who can say whether the future will yield brighter days... or darker nights.

universes.descriptionZh: 万物生于冲突；没有什么能逃离它。和谐是一种幻觉，只有拥抱这种幻觉的那些人才能收获人生最伟大的各种回报。
universes.descriptionEn: All things are born from conflict; none can escape it. Harmony is an illusion, and only those who embrace that illusion will reap life's greatest rewards.

nameZh: 战斗学院 卡特琳娜 盛典礼服
descriptionZh: 卡特琳娜是一个与杜朗德尔学院的政治活动保持远离的顽劣独行者。作为一个秉性好斗的二年级学生，她也是刺客俱乐部的一名顶级成员——这个俱乐部也是仅有的一个允许在学校批准的决斗中击杀对手的校内俱乐部。鲜有其他学生敢靠近她。
descriptionEn: Katarina is a rough-edged loner who stays far away from the politics of Durandal Academy. A 2nd year student with a chip on her shoulder, she is also a top member of the Assassin Club—the only club on campus allowed to kill opponents in school-sanctioned duels. Few other students ever dare approach her.
heroNameZh: 不祥之刃 卡特琳娜

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在这些院校中，只有强者才能生存。尽管它们的成立是为了纪念它们的神之武器，但每个学院的学生都在通往荣耀的道路上努力使它的力量成为自己的力量。无论它是在课堂，还是在战场，都在主导着竞争。
skinSets.descriptionEn: At these institutions, only the strong survive. Though they were founded to honor their God Weapon, the students at each academy strive to make its strength their own on their path to glory. Whether it's the classroom, or the battlefield, dominate the competition.

universes.descriptionZh: 散布在全球各地的神之武器将社会变成了一个由力量驱动的社会。这些有感知力的碑石召唤着那些配得上的人，并将其礼物赠予其主体，打算在这个饱受战争蹂躏的世界中扩张其征服之地。被选中是一种荣誉勋章，向任何可能反对他们的人灌输恐惧。
universes.descriptionEn: Scattered across the globe, the God Weapons morphed society into one driven by power. These sentient monuments call to those who are worthy and bestow their gifts upon their subjects, aiming to expand their conquest in this war-torn world. To be chosen is a badge of honor, instilling fear into any who may oppose them.

skinNameZh: 战斗学院 卡特琳娜

nameZh: 银龙裁决 泰隆 潜龙在渊
descriptionZh: 据说泰隆的刀锋是在暗影巨龙的火焰中铸造而成的，之后他用这把刀割开了他已被腐化的家主的喉咙。从此泰隆的刀锋在消失于阴影之前总能轻易消灭它的对手，许多人相信每当强者欺凌弱者时，刀锋总会显现。
descriptionEn: Legend says that Talon's blades were forged in the fire of a shadow dragon, and that he turned against his corrupt masters, cutting through them one by one before vanishing into the night. Many believe he will appear again whenever the strong take advantage of the weak.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 三大帝国争夺土地和权力，全力以赴地备战。大军将会交锋。英雄将会崛起。传奇将会诞生。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Three great empires vie for land and power, bringing their all to bear in a test of martial might. Armies will clash. Heroes will rise. Legends will be made.

universes.descriptionZh: 帝国正在试图重组分裂的城邦，与此同时勇敢的战士和坚韧的将军正在疆场证明自己的价值。这是一个充满战争的时代，也是一个英杰辈出的时代。
universes.descriptionEn: Rival empires vie for power as they attempt to unify the lands, while brave warriors and stoic generals test their skill against the greatest heroes of the era. It is a time of war, and a time of legends.

nameZh: 星之守护者 娑娜 未来之光
descriptionZh: 安静且深沉的娑娜不和守护者们在一起时是一名作曲家……而与他们在一起时则是一名拥有惊人能量的战士，用充满音波的星光将敌人们震开。虽然她不说话，但她总会发出自己的声音，要么通过行动……要么通过她话痨一般的佣兽斩击演奏者：起司。
descriptionEn: Quiet and reflective, Sona spends her time away from the Guardians as a composer of music... and her time with them as a fighter of incredible power, blasting enemies away with sonically charged starlight. Though she cannot speak, she always makes her voice heard through deeds... or her chatterbox familiar-slash-interpreter, Chiizu.

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

nameZh: 星之守护者 奥莉安娜 未来之光
descriptionZh: 当这个机器人少女对始源之星许愿时，它便实现了她的愿望：成为人类。与这个礼物一同到来的还有身为星之守护者的责任。那也是奥莉安娜甘愿担负的责任。她陨落的几率是……1.3%。成功融入高中生？可能性看起来不大。
descriptionEn: When this robot girl wished upon the First Star, it granted her deepest desire: to become human. With that gift came all the responsibilities of a Star Guardian. Orianna analyzed the risks. Her chances of falling are… 1.3%. Of successfully blending in with high schoolers? The odds aren't looking great.
heroNameZh: 发条魔灵 奥莉安娜

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。

universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

nameZh: 墨之影武者 永恩 云墨漾影
descriptionZh: 两兄弟失去了家园，成为了墨之影武者。其中一个放弃了他的自由，而另一个放弃了他的身份。 永恩为他的墨纹付出了高昂的代价：没有人记得他的存在。现在，他仅仅是一个被称为“千面具之人”的无名陌生人，保护着难民免受卡勃尔派的侵害，直到他们可以被送到亚索的保护之下为止。
descriptionEn: Two brothers lost their home and became Inkshadow Warriors. One gave up his freedom, and the other his identity. Yone paid a steep price for his tattoo: no one remembers that he existed. Now known only as a faceless stranger called the “Man of Masks,” he shields refugees from the Cabal until they can be delivered into Yasuo's protection.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在拉巴登城的郊外，一座破旧的神庙里居住着拉巴登人民最后的希望：墨之影武者们。他们每个人都牺牲了对他们来说最重要的东西，以便与远古灵体们签订一个契约，而这些远古灵体们为他们灌注了如此强大的魔法墨纹，以至于就连卡勃尔派也在颤抖。他们不再是无助者了。是时候收复他们的家园了。
skinSets.descriptionEn: On the outskirts of Rabadon City, a dilapidated temple houses the last hope for Rabadon's people: the Inkshadow Warriors. Each one sacrifices what is most important to them in order to make a contract with ancient spirits, who imbue them with magic tattoos so powerful, even the Cabal trembles. They are victims no more. It is time to take back their home.

universes.descriptionZh: 拉巴登城因魔法而繁荣。谁控制了魔法，谁就控制了拉巴登。而阴谋集团的控制是绝对的。任何反抗者都会被制服或被消灭……但义军即将来临。这些反抗者们所倚仗的武器是他们皮肤上直接绘制的危险魔法墨纹，而他们的目标是推翻卡勃尔派并将这座城市还给它的人民——不成功，便成仁。
universes.descriptionEn: Rabadon City thrives on magic. Whoever controls magic, controls Rabadon. And the Cabal's control is absolute. Any who resist are brought to heel or eliminated… but an Uprising is coming. Armed with dangerous magic inked directly into their skin, these rebels seek to topple the Cabal and give the city back to its people—or die trying.

nameZh: 墨之影武者 亚索 金墨耀影
descriptionZh: 与易大师一起流离失所的亚索现在使用他的墨纹在拉巴登城区和各城郊之间御风而行，在神秘的千面具之人的帮助下保护那些寻求庇护的平民。尽管他放弃了自己的自由以换取力量，但他将这个代价看作是对无法帮助那些最需要帮助的人的忏悔。
descriptionEn: Displaced from his home alongside Master Yi, Yasuo now uses his Inkshadow tattoos to ride the wind between Rabadon City and the outskirts, protecting civilians seeking asylum with help from the mysterious Man of Masks. Though he gave up his freedom in exchange for power, he sees the price as penance for being unable to help those who needed it most.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在拉巴登城的郊外，一座破旧的神庙里居住着拉巴登人民最后的希望：墨之影武者们。他们每个人都牺牲了对他们来说最重要的东西，以便与远古灵体们签订一个契约，而这些远古灵体们为他们灌注了如此强大的魔法墨纹，以至于就连卡勃尔派也在颤抖。他们不再是无助者了。是时候收复他们的家园了。

It is time to take back their home.

Armed with dangerous magic inked directly into their skin, these rebels seek to topple the Cabal and give the city back to its people—or die trying.

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 格温 幻之魂焰
descriptionZh: 她去过世界的尽头……以及彼岸……去拯救她的朋友！根据我现在看到的排名表，她必须和这个朋友一决高下才能赢得这次武道大会！噢！我发誓，这不是故意安排的，伙计们。这可是实况电视节目！一个心怀友谊的少女拿着能够起死回生的剪子：有请格温！
descriptionEn: She went to the ends of the world... and beyond... to save her friend! And according to the bracket that I'm looking at with my very eyes, she's going to have to fight him to win this tournament! OOF! I swear, this isn't scripted folks. It's LIVE TV! A girl with friendship in her heart and magical scissors that raise the dead in her hands: Gwen!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

universes.descriptionZh: 来自世界各地，那些斗魂已经觉醒的人们被邀请参加……斗魂武道大会！它是凌驾于所有娱乐之上的王者，是一个无与伦比的电视奇观！战士们在擂台上一对一单挑，直至只剩一人拿到大奖：灵魂最深处的愿望！而我会在这里，播报这一切！
universes.descriptionEn: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 2023 全球总决赛 雷克顿 潜力解封
descriptionZh: 用来纪念在韩国举办的2023全球总决赛。
descriptionEn: Celebrating Worlds 2023 in Korea.
heroNameEn: the Butcher of the Sands Renekton

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有游戏中最伟大的舞台。两支队伍在数百万粉丝面前对决。只有一支队伍会被加冕为冠军。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The greatest stage in all of gaming. Two teams face off before millions of fans. Only one will be crowned the champion.

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

skinNameZh: 2023 全球总决赛 雷克顿

nameZh: 天龙之子 黛安娜 云起龙骧
descriptionZh: 龙之王国的图书馆是保存历代智慧之作的档案馆：也是由宫廷学者黛安娜保管的藏品。她是一位狂热的学者和战士，陪伴龙太子踏上旅程，记录龙与人类之间历史性的第一次相遇。
descriptionEn: The library of the Kingdom of Dragons is an illustrious archive of wisdom from ages past: a collection kept by Diana, scholar of the court. A fierce academic as well as a fighter, she accompanies the prince on his journey to document this historical first encounter between dragons and humans.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 青花瓷 厄运小姐 金辉玉洁
descriptionZh: 几个世纪以来，人类一直在尝试复制龙息的力量。随着火药的出现，大炮被巧妙地加工成更小更精致的形态，直到莎拉·厄运的母亲最终将其完善。她的双龙手枪延续的不仅是她自己家族的传承，而且是神话生物们本身的传承。
descriptionEn: Through the centuries, humans have tried to replicate the power of dragon's breath. With gunpowder came the cannon, which was finessed into smaller and more refined variants until it was ultimately perfected by Sarah Fortune's mother. Her dual dragon-pistols carry on the legacy of not only her own family, but of the creatures of myth themselves.
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

skinSets.descriptionZh: 有这样一个世界，古老灵体和神奇生物在现代社会的边缘茁壮成的，被称为十二生肖圣物的强大瓷器是释放巨大力量的关键。它们受到守护者们的保护：不朽的守护者们负责防止生肖圣物落入坏人之手。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 净雪之月 莫甘娜 冬虹
descriptionZh: 作为净雪之月的女祭司和首席驱魔师，莫甘娜的魔法被用来束缚和摧毁任何已经发现的腐化。一旦信徒们完成了他们的试炼并将他们的记忆和情感献给了阿狸，就轮到莫甘娜履行她的职责了，那就是将他们的灵魂束缚在净雪之月上，从而完成他们的入教仪式。
descriptionEn: As a priestess and chief exorcist of the Snow Moon, Morgana's magic has been used to bind and destroy corruption wherever it is found. Once disciples complete their trials and offer their memories and emotions to Ahri, it is Morgana's duty to chain their souls to the Snow Moon, completing their initiation into the Order.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当净雪之月升到艾欧尼亚令人谦卑的群山上方时，一股寒意掠过大地。敬奉它之名的那些人——一个由坚定的刺客们组成的教派——开始了他们的仪式。伴随着净雪而来的是净化，一种只有通过牺牲人性才能实现的净化。
skinSets.descriptionEn: As the Snow Moon rises beyond the humbling mountains of Ionia, a chill passes across the land. Those who worship in its name—a cult of unwavering assassins—commence their ritual. With snow comes purification, a cleansing only possible through the sacrifice of one's humanity.

universes.descriptionZh: 一个声音从寂静中回响：“翻腾吧，野兽们，教友们。艾欧尼亚在劫难逃，它的诸多月亮像饥饿的恶魔的眼睛一样升起，等待着你们忠诚的红色——抑或它们是无法越过的可怕荒芜？ 无论是哪种方式，我们都是沉浸在仪式和献祭中的躯壳。在月亮的顶峰，我们从肉中切肉，献上微薄的礼物——我们自身的一切。”
universes.descriptionEn: A voice echoes from the silence: “Writhe, beasts, brethren. The moons of a doomed Ionia rise like eyes of starved demons, awaiting the red of your fealty—or are they monstrous blights that cannot pass? Either way, we are vessels plunged in ritual and sacrifice. At the moon's peak, we carve flesh from flesh, offering the meager gift of all that we are.”

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 伊芙琳 毅之魂焰
descriptionZh: 大多数人都是通过努力来觉醒自己的斗魂，但这个战士……并非如此！只需要顺路拜访异象调查局然后嘣地一声！眼镜王蛇能量注入。当然，这个过程显然会涉及“人们能想到的最大限度的痛苦”。但看看现在的她吧！她来这里的目的，是抓捕一位逃无可逃的少女——有请伊芙琳！
descriptionEn: Most awaken their souls through hard work, but this fighter... no! All it took was a stop by the Department for the Eradication of Manifested Anomalies and boom! Cobra powers. SURE, apparently the procedure involves the "worst pain one can possibly imagine." But look at her now! Here to hunt down a daughter with nowhere left to run... it's Evelynn!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

universes.descriptionZh: 来自世界各地，那些斗魂已经觉醒的人们被邀请参加……斗魂武道大会！它是凌驾于所有娱乐之上的王者，是一个无与伦比的电视奇观！战士们在擂台上一对一单挑，直至只剩一人拿到大奖：灵魂最深处的愿望！而我会在这里，播报这一切！
universes.descriptionEn: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 斗魂觉醒 瑟提 无限斗志
descriptionZh: 这位战士来这里是为了证明拳头可以成为一切的答案！也就是说，假定一切的问题是“一个人如何赢得历史上最多的本地锦标赛？”他这样做不仅仅是为了看起来不错——尽管这也是一个不错的奖励——而是为了跻身为斗魂传奇人物，让他的妈妈感到骄傲。有请瑟——提！
descriptionEn: This fighter is here to prove that fists CAN be the answer to everything! That is, assuming the question of everything is "how does one person win the most local tourneys in recorded history?" And he's not just doing it to look good—though that is a nice bonus—he's rising up the ranks to soul fightin' legend to make his momma proud. It's Sssssett!

skinSets.descriptionZh: 他们的斗魂通过试炼而觉醒：要么是在战场上作战，要么是在意志的曲折战线中作战。每个人都被赋予了反应他们本性的独特能力和召唤出他们意志本质的能量。有些人磨练自己的力量，通过训练来调和它.....其他人只会把它当作毁灭的武器来使用。他们是……斗魂战士！

Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!
