Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

nameZh: 玉剑传说 舞剑仙 空翠烟霏
descriptionZh: 很久以前，半神艾瑞莉娅向一位刚愎自用的龙王发出了挑战，并在他的所有仆从面前当场击败了他。龙王傲慢的讽刺艾瑞莉娅，而她则将龙王的力量封印在了她的神圣刀刃中，以让他在人类中寻找谦逊。
descriptionEn: Long ago, the demigoddess Irelia challenged a headstrong dragon king to a duel, defeating him before all the members of his assembled court. In his hubris, he lashed out at her, and in return she sealed his power within her sacred blade, so that he might find humility among humankind.
heroNameZh: 刀锋舞者 艾瑞莉娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 心之钢 永恩 金声玉振
descriptionZh: 永恩曾经是一位传奇级的DJ/制作人，但他对音乐行业的幻想逐渐破灭并神秘地退圈了，让粉丝和评论家们浮想联翩。与心之钢其他成员的会面使永恩摆脱了创作恐慌，现在的他对音乐的热情重新燃起，决心带领这支乐团走向顶峰。
descriptionEn: Once a legendary DJ/producer, Yone grew disillusioned with the music industry and mysteriously dropped off the grid, leaving fans and critics alike wanting more. Meeting the other members of HEARTSTEEL pulled him out of his creative funk, and with his passion for music now reignited, Yone is determined to take this band straight to the top.

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 玉剑传说 无劫 胭脂
descriptionZh: 当无劫得道成仙并开始将目光投向其他领域时，新的野心油然而生：开悟无处不在，所以他也必须无处不在。 在发现他的探索后，天目派驱逐了他。不过，无劫并不在意，因为他发现了一种新的魔道威能，可使他无所不在、无所不知。
descriptionEn: When Zed became immortal and began studying the other realms, a new desire took hold: knowledge was everywhere, so he needed to BE everywhere. Upon discovering his explorations, the Grounded Foresight School banished him. Zed doesn't care, though, for he's found a new demonic power, allowing him to be everywhere and all-knowing.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……

universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 金克丝 核桃巴菲
descriptionZh: 金克丝决心证明自己是世界上最棒的糕点师。她利用她那混乱与技艺的独特调配成果，给她的主顾们留下了深刻的印象，并在竞争中脱颖而出！虽然她擅长咸味美食，但她偶尔也会享受一些甜食。不过……在她处于吃糖后的兴奋状态时，千万别去挡她的道。
descriptionEn: Determined to prove that she's the best pastry chef around, Jinx uses her unique blend of chaos and technique to impress her patrons and blow away the competition! Although she specializes in savory treats, she'll occasionally indulge in a little sugary goodness from time to time. But… don't get in her way while she's in the middle of a sugar rush.

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 墨之影武者 卡莎 金墨耀影
descriptionZh: 卡莎的父亲死于卡勃尔派之手，作为年轻幸存者的她逃离了这座城市并加入了义军。她为了拒绝让别人为她而战，牺牲了自己的自主性来换取反击的机会，并接受了她生存所需的神奇共生墨纹。卡莎终于有了复仇的工具。她会看到正义得到伸张。
descriptionEn: A young survivor who lost her father to the Cabal, Kai'Sa fled the city and joined the Uprising. Refusing to allow others to fight a battle on her behalf, she sacrificed her independence for the chance to fight back, receiving a magical, symbiotic tattoo she needs in order to live. Kai'Sa finally has the tools to get revenge. She will see justice done.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在拉巴登城的郊外，一座破旧的神庙里居住着拉巴登人民最后的希望：墨之影武者们。他们每个人都牺牲了对他们来说最重要的东西，以便与远古灵体们签订一个契约，而这些远古灵体们为他们灌注了如此强大的魔法墨纹，以至于就连卡勃尔派也在颤抖。他们不再是无助者了。是时候收复他们的家园了。
skinSets.descriptionEn: On the outskirts of Rabadon City, a dilapidated temple houses the last hope for Rabadon's people: the Inkshadow Warriors. Each one sacrifices what is most important to them in order to make a contract with ancient spirits, who imbue them with magic tattoos so powerful, even the Cabal trembles. They are victims no more. It is time to take back their home.

universes.descriptionZh: 拉巴登城因魔法而繁荣。谁控制了魔法，谁就控制了拉巴登。而阴谋集团的控制是绝对的。任何反抗者都会被制服或被消灭……但义军即将来临。这些反抗者们所倚仗的武器是他们皮肤上直接绘制的危险魔法墨纹，而他们的目标是推翻卡勃尔派并将这座城市还给它的人民——不成功，便成仁。
universes.descriptionEn: Rabadon City thrives on magic. Whoever controls magic, controls Rabadon. And the Cabal's control is absolute. Any who resist are brought to heel or eliminated… but an Uprising is coming. Armed with dangerous magic inked directly into their skin, these rebels seek to topple the Cabal and give the city back to its people—or die trying.

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 璐璐 焦糖布丁
descriptionZh: 当璐璐和她得力的副主厨皮克斯制作甜点时，甜食爱好者们总是会感到满足！他们的糕点魔法料理只需要一丝香气，就足以让最任性的顾客们沉醉。有人说他们的美食非常令人着迷，甚至具有改变现实的效果……
descriptionEn: Sweet tooths are always satisfied when Lulu and her helpful sous-chef Pix are crafting the desserts! Just one whiff of their pastry magic concoctions is enough to enchant even the most unruly customers. Some say their treats are so captivating that they even have reality altering effects…

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 神龙尊者 圣龙李青 登龙
descriptionZh: 李青是一名苦修战士，对正义有着潮鸣电挚般的热忱。他攀登上了圣龙敖兴所在的山峰，希望得到他的赐福。李青以传说中的神龙尊者的身份从顶峰归来，将雷霆万钧般的惩罚带给了各处的恶棍们——而这都被他的龙主尽收眼底。
descriptionEn: A warrior ascetic consumed with an electric passion for justice, Lee Sin climbed the mountain of the storm dragon Ao Shin, hoping to receive his blessing. Having returned from the summit as a legendary Dragonmancer, Lee Sin now doles out thunderous punishment to villains everywhere—ever under the watchful eye of his draconic patron.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 尊荣的巨龙们居住在偏远的雄奇瑰丽之地，为了避免外面的凡界纷争，它们只会非常罕见地将礼物赐给极少数被它们选中的人。神龙尊者们就是幸运且强大到足以获得这种终极赐福的人。他们用它来行善还是行恶，都取决于他们自己，以及任何强大到足以制止他们的人。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Majestic dragons dwell in remote places of wild beauty, avoiding mortal affairs outside of rarely bestowing their gifts on only a select few. The Dragonmancers are those fortunate and powerful enough to have gained the ultimate blessing. Whether they then use that for good or for evil is up to them, and anyone strong enough to stop them.

universes.descriptionZh: 圣兽们守护着整个世界，能够把任何人变成强大的存在，但前提是那个灵魂值得他们的祝福。无论他们的力量是用于善还是恶，一旦赐予，就无法收回。
universes.descriptionEn: Divine beasts watch over the world entire, capable of turning anyone into powerful beings, but only if that soul is worthy of their blessings. Whether their power is used for good or evil, once the gift is given, it cannot be taken away.

skinNameZh: 神龙尊者 圣龙李青

nameZh: 征服者 韦鲁斯 炫金
descriptionZh: 以此纪念2018年于欧洲举办的季中邀请赛。
descriptionEn: Commemorating the 2018 Mid-Season Invitational in Europe.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 纪念《英雄联盟》季中冠军赛和春季赛。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Commemorating the League of Legends Mid-Season Invitational and Spring Split tournaments.

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

nameZh: 幻灵战斗猫 金克丝 梦幻强袭
descriptionZh: 金克丝是一支孤猫拆家小队，她天生的捣蛋冲动转向了更有成效的目标：与原初星人作战。她不是真正的士兵，似乎不关心人类的事务，也不听从命令——但金克丝的战功是没有争议的。
descriptionEn: Jinx is a one-cat demolitions squad, her natural destructive impulses turned toward more productive ends: fighting off the Primordians. She's not really a soldier, doesn't seem to care about humanity's cause, and doesn't follow orders -- but there's no arguing with Jinx's results.

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

skinNameZh: 幻灵战斗猫 金克丝

nameZh: 星之守护者 辛德拉 未来之光
descriptionZh: 令人敬畏的辛德拉是一位来自古老时代的星之守护者，她的过去隐藏在阴影中。她是阿狸小队的智囊，虽然深得队长的信任，但也有些成员怀疑辛德拉为了自己的个人野心可以不惜任何代价。
descriptionEn: Feared and admired, Syndra is a formidable Star Guardian from an earlier era, whose history is cloaked in shadow. She acts as an advisor on Ahri's team, but despite her captain's trust, some members suspect there is no price that Syndra won't pay to achieve her personal ambitions.

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第二季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 资深星之守护者阿狸和厄运小姐突然重新出现在瓦罗兰城。她们的前一支小队已在一场未知事件中被摧毁，而她们正是来此重建团队。为了打破每一位已宣誓的星之守护者的宿命，她们在虚空野兽降临这座城市时与拉克丝等人一起加入战斗。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Veteran Star Guardians Ahri and Miss Fortune suddenly reappear in Valoran City, having rebuilt their team after an unknown event destroyed their previous squad. Seeking to defy the destiny of every Star Guardian who takes up the oath, they join the fight alongside Lux and company as Void Beasts descend upon the city.

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

skinNameZh: 星之守护者 辛德拉

nameZh: 神龙之翼 库奇 飞龙腾云
descriptionZh: 库奇的后勤维护人员非常肯定的告诉他这套造型绝对适合春节，机身用龙头装饰来吓退恶灵。之后他的飞机上还改装了焰火喷射装置和机枪与导弹……也许也是用来吓退恶灵的吧。
descriptionEn: Corki's pit crew made sure to outfit him with a special ship for Lunar Revel, emblazoned with the visage of a dragon to scare off evil spirits. It has been further modified to spray bullets and fire explosives… presumably also to scare off evil spirits.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 春节到了——派对也到了！家人朋友聚在一起，共同享用美食与佳节时光。现在，点燃一根火柴，然后观看焰火吧！
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Lunar New Year has arrived—and so has the party! With food and festivities to spare, it's all about ringing it in with friends and family. Now strike up a match and watch the fireworks!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 天龙之子 卡莎 云起龙骧
descriptionZh: 卡莎是皇家斥候，也是龙太子的好友。她很坚毅，在云端度过的时间比她的任何同龄人都多。虽然这是她第一次与人类直接互动，但她观察到的知识和机敏一定会在她与人类一起庆祝新年时派上用场。
descriptionEn: Royal scout and friend to the prince, Kai'Sa is a tenacious dragon who has spent more time beneath the clouds than any of her peers. Though this is the first time she has interacted with humans directly, her observed knowledge and agile grace are sure to be assets while joining them in the New Year's celebration.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 天龙之子 迦娜 云起龙骧
descriptionZh: 迦娜是王国中最擅长魔法的龙（也许除了国王本人），能够腾云驾雾，呼风唤雨。龙太子曾经问过迦娜是否可以收他为徒，而迦娜高兴地接受了；但她期待着给他展示龙族力量更加奇思妙想的用法。毕竟，他们要去参加庆典了。
descriptionEn: Janna is the most skilled dragon in the kingdom at sorcery (save for the king himself, perhaps), whipping up winds and steering the clouds. The prince asked if she might take him on as a pupil, and Janna happily accepted; but she is looking forward to showing him more whimsical uses of their power. After all, they have a festival to attend.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 天龙之子 易 云起龙骧
descriptionZh: 龙太子的武术老师必须拥有绝顶的实力，并且没有哪个龙的技艺比易大师更加出色了。真正的大师必须既是战士又是诗人，既是冠军又是艺术家——并且本着学习的精神，必须时刻准备好应对任何事情。
descriptionEn: A prince requires a master of the highest caliber to teach him martial arts, and there is no dragon of greater skill than Master Yi. A true master must be both warrior and poet, champion and artist—and in the spirit of learning, must always be ready for anything.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 为了更好地了解自己治下的子民，龙族皇室和随从们从天宫中下凡，化作人形与凡人们共同庆祝新年。
skinSets.descriptionEn: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 玉剑传说 翼剑仙 珠光
descriptionZh: 天目派传习的是见微知著的能力，但是随着翼剑仙接近得道，怀疑也悄然而至。 父母的意外离世促使她想要尽可能地掌控自己的生活，可由于师父无劫将她逐出师门，她的信念开始动摇。 她现在只希望，修得长生能让她最终抛开一切疑虑。
descriptionEn: The Grounded Foresight School teaches power in knowing one's surroundings, but as Kayle nears immortality, doubt has crept in. Her parents' random deaths fostered a desire to exert as much control as possible in her life, but with her teacher Zed's banishment, the ground is now shaky. Immortality, she hopes, will finally give her solid footing.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 玉剑传说 琴仙子 丁香
descriptionZh: 作为炽血派刚刚得道的仙子，琴仙子的威能在于从混乱的嘈杂中寻获和谐。 对她来说，得道成仙只能通过找到与同胞的和谐相处来实现，因此她将她的学生视为仙音妙律中不可或缺的强音。 正是在这种共同的热情中，一切皆有可能。
descriptionEn: As a newly immortal member of the Radiant Passion School, Sona's power is in building harmony from dissonance. To her, immortality only comes through finding your shared harmony with your fellow people, and she sees her students as strong notes to be built into immortal chords. It is in this shared passion that makes anything possible.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 星之守护者 萨勒芬妮 未来之光
descriptionZh: 萨勒芬妮的全银河系巡回个人演唱会刚刚结束，是时候回到星之守护者的行列了。能和新的英雄组队让她超级兴奋，她也毫不掩饰地传递着自己的热情。他们在为真爱而战……还有比这更浪漫的事吗？！
descriptionEn: Seraphine has toured the entire galaxy as a solo act, but now it's time for a Star Guardian collab. She's ecstatic to team up with a new group of heroes, and she isn't afraid to share that enthusiasm. They're fighting for true love… what could be more romantic than that?!
heroNameZh: 星籁歌姬 萨勒芬妮

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

skinNameZh: 星之守护者 萨勒芬妮

nameZh: 星之守护者 金克丝 黑洞
descriptionZh: 金克丝让自己的队友很头疼，她是个行事冲动、玩世不恭的星之守护者，只喜欢巨大闪亮的爆炸。不过只要战斗开始，金克丝必定会冲锋陷阵，保护其他人，尤其是她的儿时密友拉克丝。
descriptionEn: Much to the annoyance of her team, Jinx is an impulsive and sometimes cynical Star Guardian who loves a good, glittery explosion. However, when the fighting starts, Jinx will throw herself into the battle to protect others, especially her childhood friend Lux.

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第一季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 高中生拉克丝和她的星之守护者小队获得了始源之星的神奇力量，秘密地保护世界免受星际怪物的侵害。但是谁来保护他们免受瓦洛兰城高中的戏剧性影响呢？
skinSets.descriptionEn: Magically empowered by the First Star, high schooler Lux and her team of Star Guardians secretly protect the world from interstellar monsters. But who will protect them from the drama of Valoran City High?

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

skinNameZh: 星之守护者 金克丝

nameZh: 南天之怒 沃里克 炫金天神
descriptionZh: 作为小时候送给春晖神女的礼物，沃里克一直陪在她身边长大，守护天界不受黑暗入侵。他比自己的同伴内瑟斯更加狂暴和野性，沃里克一直守着南方，无情猎杀所有敌人直至世界的尽头。
descriptionEn: Gifted to the Lunar Empress when she was a child, Warwick was raised alongside her to guard the immortal realm from an encroaching darkness. More beastly and feral than his companion Nasus, Warwick stands watch in the south, relentlessly pursuing foes to the ends of the world.
heroNameEn: the Uncaged Wrath of Zaun Warwick

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 咖啡甜心 兰博 核桃巴菲
descriptionZh: 作为咖啡馆的得力咖啡师，兰博总是提供热气腾腾的美味！他那套值得信赖的咖啡师制服虽然不是传统形制，却能有效满足任何一家咖啡馆的需求。在品尝他的饮品之前一定要检查一下温度——他的创意之作就是因偶尔失控而闻名的！
descriptionEn: As the cafe's handy barista, Rumble always provides piping hot deliciousness! His trusty coffee making suit is unconventional, but effective for any cafe's needs. Just make sure to check the temperature before taking a sip of his drinks—his inventions are known for occasionally going haywire!

universes.descriptionZh: 美食就是魔法——名副其实！在由优雅的下午茶时光和迷人的糕点组成的世界中，法师们制作神奇的马卡龙，烘培迷人的羊角面包，并提供魔法烤饼给数十名渴望品尝的顾客们。
universes.descriptionEn: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

nameZh: 净雪之月 阿狸 水竹
descriptionZh: 作为古老而强大的北极狐灵，阿狸自净雪之月教团成立以来就一直存在。这是一种共生的安排：契约者们通过牺牲自己的情感和记忆来满足她的胃口，从而净化自己。阿狸是他们丢失记忆的守护者，通过她的信徒们体验外面的世界，他们的眼睛现在空洞而冰冷。
descriptionEn: An ancient and powerful arctic fox spirit, Ahri has been around since the founding of the Snow Moon order. It is a symbiotic arrangement: agents purify themselves by sacrificing their emotions and memories to her appetite. Ahri is the keeper of their lost memories, experiencing the outside world through her devotees, their eyes now vacant and cold.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当净雪之月升到艾欧尼亚令人谦卑的群山上方时，一股寒意掠过大地。敬奉它之名的那些人——一个由坚定的刺客们组成的教派——开始了他们的仪式。伴随着净雪而来的是净化，一种只有通过牺牲人性才能实现的净化。
skinSets.descriptionEn: As the Snow Moon rises beyond the humbling mountains of Ionia, a chill passes across the land. Those who worship in its name—a cult of unwavering assassins—commence their ritual. With snow comes purification, a cleansing only possible through the sacrifice of one's humanity.

universes.descriptionZh: 一个声音从寂静中回响：“翻腾吧，野兽们，教友们。艾欧尼亚在劫难逃，它的诸多月亮像饥饿的恶魔的眼睛一样升起，等待着你们忠诚的红色——抑或它们是无法越过的可怕荒芜？ 无论是哪种方式，我们都是沉浸在仪式和献祭中的躯壳。在月亮的顶峰，我们从肉中切肉，献上微薄的礼物——我们自身的一切。”
universes.descriptionEn: A voice echoes from the silence: “Writhe, beasts, brethren. The moons of a doomed Ionia rise like eyes of starved demons, awaiting the red of your fealty—or are they monstrous blights that cannot pass? Either way, we are vessels plunged in ritual and sacrifice. At the moon's peak, we carve flesh from flesh, offering the meager gift of all that we are.”

nameZh: 冠军之志 瑞兹 凯旋圣装
descriptionZh: 以此庆祝2019年在欧洲举办的全球总决赛。
descriptionEn: Celebrating Worlds 2019 in Europe.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有游戏中最伟大的舞台。两支队伍在数百万粉丝面前对决。只有一支队伍会被加冕为冠军。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The greatest stage in all of gaming. Two teams face off before millions of fans. Only one will be crowned the champion.

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

nameZh: 玉剑传说 神机花火 青竹
descriptionZh: 神机花火在婴儿时期便失去了双亲，幸而被一个机关师家庭收养，她的动手能力得以见长。 他们的爱点燃了她心底的本愿，就是奋不顾身地帮助他人。由于她的非凡才能，家人供她进入了虔衷派。 神机花火是一个充满梦想和好奇心的学生，她将利用得道的力量帮助她所能帮助的每一个人。
descriptionEn: Orphaned as a baby, Zeri was taken in by a family of inventors who cultivated her tinkering tendencies. Their love ignited a deep desire to help others over herself, and because of her prodigious talents, her family paid her admission to the Tempered Faith School. A student full of dreams and curiosity, Zeri will use immortality to help everyone she can.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

universes.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

skinNameZh: 玉剑传说 神机花火

nameZh: 玉剑传说 苍鸾 丁香
descriptionZh: 苍鸾是一位来自天庭且令人畏惧的仙宫之主。她对舞剑仙封印巨龙之力的行为满是鄙弃。在战斗中击败她的同时，苍鸾很快意识到，这位年轻的半仙已将这股力量隐藏了起来，因此她现在正在坚决无情地寻找一种方式，来将这股力量归还到它应在的主人那里。
descriptionEn: A feared sorceress queen from the heavenly kingdoms, Morgana looked on with disdain as Irelia sealed away the power of a dragon. Crushing her in combat, Morgana soon realized the young demigoddess had hidden that power away, and now ruthlessly searches for a way to return it to its rightful owner.

universes.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

nameZh: 屠龙勇士 布隆 金瞳龙首之盾
descriptionZh: 第一代屠龙勇士早在几百年之前就开始与他们的敌人交战了，在他们取得胜利后，整个大陆进入了一片祥和之中。然而当巨龙重回大地，大多数的战士早已去世，所有的重任就放在了布隆的肩上，他必须手持巨盾保护所有无辜的人民免遭其害。
descriptionEn: Dragonslayers first rose to battle their ancient foes hundreds of years ago, and after their victory, the land fell into a long, forgetful peace. When the dragons returned, most of the ancient warriors had passed away, leaving Braum to take up their task with only his mighty shield to defend the innocent.
heroNameZh: 弗雷尔卓德之心 布隆
heroNameEn: the Heart of the Freljord Braum

skinSets.descriptionZh: 世界已经被巨龙之火吞噬过两次，被铸造英雄的余烬毁灭过两次。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Twice did dragonfire consume the world. Twice from the embers were heroes forged.

universes.descriptionZh: 世界已经被巨龙之火吞噬过两次，被铸造英雄的余烬毁灭过两次。
universes.descriptionEn: Twice did dragonfire consume the world. Twice from the embers were heroes forged.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 亚索 霜见
descriptionZh: 据“兄弟之争”的故事记载，初生之土曾经发生过一场因荣誉而起的战争。年轻的弟弟是一位放浪形骸却备受尊敬的领主，后来因被指危害子民，被迫拿起武器捍卫自己的名誉。两兄弟在最后的交锋中双双丧命——过分追逐荣耀带来的致命教训。
descriptionEn: Pride once set the First Lands aflame, as recounted in the Tale of the Warring Brothers. The Younger was a roguish yet respected lord, until he was accused of crimes against his people and took up arms to defend his reputation. Both brothers fell in their final clash—a fatal lesson in hubris.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 可爱可爱粉红红 布里茨
descriptionZh: 布里茨以让他的蜂兵陷入胶着处境而闻名。也许是因为那个巨大的蜂窝状机械臂。
descriptionEn: Beezcrank has a reputation for getting his bee-infantry into sticky situations. Probably because of that giant honey-comb mech-arm.
heroNameZh: 蒸汽机器人 布里茨

skinSets.descriptionZh: 嗡。嗡嗡嗡。嗡，嗡，嗡嗡嗡。嗡……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Bzzz. Bzzz bzzz bzzz. Bzzz! Bzzz, bzz, bzz bzz bzz. Bzzz...

universes.descriptionZh: 嗡。嗡嗡嗡。嗡，嗡，嗡嗡嗡。嗡……
universes.descriptionEn: Bzzz. Bzzz bzzz bzzz. Bzzz! Bzzz, bzz, bzz bzz bzz. Bzzz...

nameZh: 幻灵战斗队长 厄运小姐 勇气赞歌
descriptionZh: 在前任队长锐雯神秘失踪后，莎拉 · 厄运是第二位担负“幻灵战斗队长”头衔的人。考虑到锐雯作为战争英雄的地位，这个头衔就好比一双大一码的兔靴，但莎拉聪明、老练并且勇敢，足以在为了人类的战斗中创造她自己的传奇。
descriptionEn: Sarah Fortune is the second to take on the title of Anima Squad Commander, after her predecessor Riven's mysterious disappearance. They're big leporine shoes to fill, considering Riven's status as a war hero, but Sarah is smart, skilled, and courageous enough to forge her own legend in the fight for humanity.
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

skinNameZh: 幻灵战斗队长 厄运小姐

nameZh: 冠军之隐 劫 凯旋圣装
descriptionZh: 以此庆祝2016年在北美举办的全球总决赛。
descriptionEn: Celebrating Worlds 2016 in North America.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有游戏中最伟大的舞台。两支队伍在数百万粉丝面前对决。只有一支队伍会被加冕为冠军。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The greatest stage in all of gaming. Two teams face off before millions of fans. Only one will be crowned the champion.

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

nameZh: 心之钢 伊泽瑞尔 金声玉振
descriptionZh: 一首精心制作的神曲让伊泽瑞尔成为万众瞩目的焦点，但在这张专辑遭到批评时，他又再次过气，于是伊泽瑞尔决定是时候收回一些创作控制权了。现在，伊泽瑞尔离开了他的旧厂牌，并将自己的明星影响力借给了心之钢，找到了一些准备与他一起复出翻红的音乐家和朋友。
descriptionEn: After a manufactured one-hit wonder launched Ezreal into the spotlight, only for him to fall out of it again when the album got panned, Ezreal decided it was time he took some creative control back. Now, having left his old label and lending what star power he has to HEARTSTEEL, Ezreal has found musicians and friends he's ready to make a comeback with.

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 持七彩冰棍的雪人 易
descriptionZh: 易是一个被魄罗之王赋予了生命魔法的谦卑雪人，正在努力变成地表最英勇的骑士……随着冰王图奇的入侵将至，易应该会获得表现的机会。
descriptionEn: A humble snowman brought to life by the magic of the Poro King, Yi strives to become the most gallant knight in all the land… and with the imminent invasion of Ice King Twitch, he might just get his chance.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在神奇的冬季仙境中，魄罗王之的统治至高无上，向他王庭的所有人传播欢乐和喜悦。尽管其他人都想篡夺国王的王位，但他们都对冬境仙灵们有着共同的热爱。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Within the magical Winterlands, the Poro King reigns supreme, spreading joy and merriment to all of his court. Even as others work to usurp the king, all share a common love for winter's wonders.

universes.descriptionZh: 一年中还有比空气清新、雪花蓬松、巧克力热腾腾的冰雪节更好的时候吗？投掷雪球或吟唱颂歌；只要你怀着好心情，一切都会好起来的，然后你就没有什么好怕的了。
universes.descriptionEn: Is there a better time of year than Snowdown, when the air is crisp, the snow fluffy, and the chocolate hot? Toss a snowball or sing a carol; as long as you have good cheer, all will be well, and you'll have nothing to fear.

skinNameZh: 持胡萝卜的雪人 易

nameZh: 最终BOSS 维迦 里・大魔王
descriptionZh: 作为一个有拿破仑情结的小Boss，维迦闯进了街机世界并且召唤了许多来自其他游戏的Boss作为他的帮手。他们将联手达成他们的终极目标：为自己征服这个世界，并且最终为这个英雄带来一次真正的Game Over。
descriptionEn: Once merely a mini-boss with a Napoleon complex, Veigar has ripped into the code of Arcade World to summon hundreds of other bosses to his side. Together they'll stop at nothing to reach his ultimate goal: take the world for himself, and give the heroes a final Game Over.
heroNameEn: the Tiny Master of Evil Veigar

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在电玩迪亚的服务器深处存在着一系列被所有玩家称为“战斗BOSS”的邪恶故障。他们的受损代码给他们带来了新的自由……但也带来了新的挑战。为了完成他们对电玩世界的删除，许多BOSS同意搁置他们的分歧(直到……不便透露)。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Deep within Arcadia's servers lies a sinister series of glitches known to all gamers as the Battle Bosses. Their corrupted code has brought them newfound freedom… but also new challengers. To complete their deletion of the Arcade World, many of the Bosses have agreed to put aside their differences (until it's… inconvenient).

universes.descriptionZh: 在屏幕上闪烁的“投币开玩”，对任何称职的玩家来说都是一种不可抗拒的提议。但是，当他们从简陋的街机游戏厅抽离，投入到英雄和战场BOSS的世界时，这些平平无奇的玩家将不得不凭借他们所具备的全部反应力和连招来进行战斗。因为电玩世界的玩家们……是用命在玩。
universes.descriptionEn: Insert Coin to Play" flashes on the screen, an irrestistable offer for any gamer worth their salt. But whisked away from their humble arcade into a world of Heroes and Battle Bosses, these ordinary players will have to fight with all the reflexes and combos they can muster. Because gamers in Arcadia... are playing with their lives.

nameZh: 玉剑传说 寒潭夭夭 胭脂
descriptionZh: 在舞剑仙被仙宫之主击败的同时，封印着无影那股龙力的力量也被削弱了……这使得他的一些法力泄露到了凡间。寒潭夭夭曾是一条平平无奇的鱼，梦想着成为龙。而她得到了这股法力的一部分，并且发现了她真正的形态已经开始觉醒。
descriptionEn: When the demigoddess Irelia was bested by a heavenly empress, the seal over Talon's draconic power began to weaken… allowing some of his magic to leak into the world. Once a mere fish who dreamed of being a dragon, Nami has received some of this power, and has found her true form beginning to awaken.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 很久以前，在一片远古之地上，很多灵魂聚集在众神下方，以测试他们的能力限度。愚蠢且自大，勇敢且公正，他们的旅程被写进了历史的不朽篇章中……
skinSets.descriptionEn: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

skinNameZh: 玉剑传说 寒潭夭夭

nameZh: 破败军团 厄运小姐 灵岛征伐使
descriptionZh: 厄运小姐曾以为当比尔吉沃特的海盗女王就足够了。尽管完成了复仇，但莎拉现在又面临着比尔吉沃特各派系争夺控制权的乱局。佛耶戈的驾临为她提供了一个能够把任何人踩在脚下的机会，即使这是有代价的。
descriptionEn: Miss Fortune thought that being the Pirate Queen of Bilgewater would be enough. Even with her revenge complete, Sarah now faced a new chaos with Bilgewater's factions vying for control. Viego's arrival offered her an opportunity to seize the strength needed to crush anyone beneath her heel, even if it came at a price.
heroNameZh: 赏金猎人 厄运小姐

skinSets.descriptionZh: 蚀魂夜将它的黑雾散布在符文大地，肆意地腐蚀着。有些人，在它的影响下，受到了动摇并追随了破败之王，从而相信他们的目标一致。但是佛耶戈只想要伊苏尔德回来；他没有任何盟友。帮助他阻止光明哨兵们的破败军团们只不过是一个心碎情种的游戏中的棋子。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Harrowing spreads its Black Mist across Runeterra, corrupting indiscriminately. Some, in its presence, are swayed to follow the Ruined King, believing their goals aligned. But Viego wants only the return of Isolde; he has no allies. The Ruined who aid him in halting the Sentinels are mere pawns in a broken-hearted lover's game.

universes.descriptionZh: 黑雾聚集，蚀魂夜到来，并且破败之王已经再次崛起。佛耶戈的腐败席卷了符文之地，将好友变为仇敌并使诸国屈服。仅有的有能力阻挡他的一群人，就是光明哨兵：一个由赛娜和卢锡安领导的古老教团。他们必须从全境的每个角落将英雄们召集起来，以对黑雾进行反击并一劳永逸地终结破败之王的恐怖统治。
universes.descriptionEn: The Black Mist gathers, the Harrowing comes, and the Ruined King has risen once more. Viego's corruption blankets Runeterra, turning friends into foes and bringing entire nations to their knees. The only ones with the power to stop him are the Sentinels of Light: an ancient order led by Senna and Lucian. They must call upon champions from every corner of the realm to fight back the Black Mist and end the Ruined King's reign of terror once and for all.

skinNameZh: 破败军团 厄运小姐

nameZh: 冠军之矛 卡莉丝塔 凯旋圣装
descriptionZh: 以此庆祝2015年在欧洲举办的全球总决赛。
descriptionEn: Celebrating Worlds 2015 in Europe.
heroNameZh: 复仇之矛 卡莉丝塔

nameZh: 冰雪风暴 希维尔 炫金
descriptionZh: 狂野而且急躁的战争女神希维尔只在乎两件事：战斗的律动和钱币的低语。她在冰原上无情地追猎赏金目标，用巨大的锋刃雪花砍倒对手，如同残酷凛冽的冰雪风暴。
descriptionEn: The wild and brash Battle Mistress known as Sivir cares only for the thrill of combat and the rattle of coin. She relentlessly hunts her bounties across the ice, cutting down opponents with a massive, razor-sharp snowflake as hard and unforgiving as the cruelest snowstorm.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在神奇的冬季仙境中，魄罗王之的统治至高无上，向他王庭的所有人传播欢乐和喜悦。尽管其他人都想篡夺国王的王位，但他们都对冬境仙灵们有着共同的热爱。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Within the magical Winterlands, the Poro King reigns supreme, spreading joy and merriment to all of his court. Even as others work to usurp the king, all share a common love for winter's wonders.

universes.descriptionZh: 一年中还有比空气清新、雪花蓬松、巧克力热腾腾的冰雪节更好的时候吗？投掷雪球或吟唱颂歌；只要你怀着好心情，一切都会好起来的，然后你就没有什么好怕的了。
universes.descriptionEn: Is there a better time of year than Snowdown, when the air is crisp, the snow fluffy, and the chocolate hot? Toss a snowball or sing a carol; as long as you have good cheer, all will be well, and you'll have nothing to fear.

nameZh: 心之钢 凯隐 金声玉振
descriptionZh: 凯隐将他的音乐作为武器——不管是他自己还是他恶魔般的另一个自我，拉亚斯特。虽然他接受了一位流行音乐王子的所有训练，但他在最后一支乐队拆伙之后的糟糕名声使他成为了业界弃儿。凯隐决心要激怒那些黑子，于是加入了心之钢，只为找到他能真正信任的创意合作伙伴（和朋友？）。
descriptionEn: Kayn wields his music like a weapon—both as himself and as his demonic alter ego, Rhaast. Though he's got all the training of a pop music prince, his bad reputation after the breakup of his last band made him an industry pariah. Determined to spite the haters, Kayn joined HEARTSTEEL only to find creative partners (and friends?) he might actually trust.

skinSets.descriptionZh:
“心之钢是场上人气最高的新乐团，其成员有凯隐和伊泽瑞尔等艺术家——”
“有我们乐团所有成员！”
“冷静点，瑟提。”
“等等，这又是哪本杂志的，奎桑提？”
“请集中注意力！”
“嘿永恩，我们可以上台了吗？”
“我们——哦，好吧，厄斐琉斯刚刚走开了……”
skinSets.descriptionEn:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 霸天异形 卡兹克 刹那银光
descriptionZh: 被命名为K-ZX的“霸天异形 卡兹克”是霸天机甲系列的第一台机器，专为对付怪兽威胁而部署。由于体积较小，它在城市环境下的表现最佳，并搭载了飞行功能来威慑平民。
descriptionEn: Designated K-ZX, the “Mecha Kha'Zix” unit was the first of the mecha line to be deployed against the kaiju threat. Due to its smaller size, it functions best in urban environments, adapting on the fly to threats against civilian populations.
heroNameZh: 虚空掠夺者 卡兹克

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当身形庞大的怪兽开始从海中、地上和空中发起进攻时，人类发展出了相同威力的霸天机甲单位以爆发性的徒手战斗抵御它们。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When colossal kaiju begin attacking from the sea, land, and air, humanity develops equally powerful mecha units to stop them in explosive hand-to-hand combat.

universes.descriptionZh: 耸立在城市之上，庞大的怪兽与高耸的机甲扭打在一起。谁会赢？
universes.descriptionEn: Towering above the city, gargantuan kaiju tussle with towering mechas. Who will win?

nameZh: 偶像歌手 阿狸 高山杜鹃
descriptionZh: 阿狸在她十几岁的时候就被她的唱片公司发现，在她最初的五首单曲进入百大热门榜时席卷了音乐界，并在2013年流行闪耀奖上获得了“最具天赋的K-pop新秀奖”。从那以后，她一直在俘获人心和横扫各种奖项。然而，在完美的外表下，阿狸感到被越来越多的要求给困住了……
descriptionEn: Discovered by her record label when she was still a teen, Ahri took the music world by storm when her first five singles hit the Top 100, winning Most Talented New K-pop Artist at the 2013 Pop Shine Awards. She's been stealing hearts and sweeping awards ever since. However, underneath that perfect exterior, Ahri is feeling trapped by increasing demands...

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当你在排行榜的顶端时，没有人能把你打下来。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When you're at the top of the charts, no one can bring you down.

universes.descriptionZh: 当然，它与一票难求的体育馆、时尚前卫的弄潮儿、欢呼的人群有关； 但它也与扬声器的音量太大有关，您的双耳会有歌声萦绕，就像它们想要一起唱歌一样。与炽热的舞台灯光、沉重的低音和稳定的鼓点有关。它与肾上腺素的高涨有关，从内到外点燃你。这种感觉？就是音乐。
universes.descriptionEn: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

nameZh: 闭月之颜 貂蝉 炫金莲华
descriptionZh: 在公开反对她的家族后，卡特琳娜放弃了公主的生活而四处猎杀最伟大的三国英雄。在夜幕的掩护下消灭自己的敌人，她开始缓慢地实现自己的野心。
descriptionEn: In open defiance of her clan, Katarina has left behind the life of a princess to hunt the greatest heroes of the Warring Kingdoms. Striking under shadow of night, she is slowly cutting her way through her foes… one general at a time.
heroNameZh: 不祥之刃 卡特琳娜

skinSets.descriptionZh: 三大帝国争夺土地和权力，全力以赴地备战。大军将会交锋。英雄将会崛起。传奇将会诞生。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Three great empires vie for land and power, bringing their all to bear in a test of martial might. Armies will clash. Heroes will rise. Legends will be made.

universes.descriptionZh: 帝国正在试图重组分裂的城邦，与此同时勇敢的战士和坚韧的将军正在疆场证明自己的价值。这是一个充满战争的时代，也是一个英杰辈出的时代。
universes.descriptionEn: Rival empires vie for power as they attempt to unify the lands, while brave warriors and stoic generals test their skill against the greatest heroes of the era. It is a time of war, and a time of legends.

nameZh: 玄晖霓裳 嫦娥

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 卡西奥佩娅 流火
descriptionZh: 曾经有位聪慧而又美丽的公主，与自己的姐妹积怨颇深。她认为自己才是王位的正统继承人，因此想要毒害自己的对手——但不知为何，她柔软的皮肤上忽然现出了蛇鳞。那一夜，这位魅力无穷的蛇女便消失在群山之中。但时至今日，虔诚的信徒仍在寻求着她的指引。
descriptionEn: There once was a princess as clever as she was beautiful, who harbored a bitter feud with her sister. Convinced she was the rightful heir to the throne, she tried to poison her rival—but instead, serpent scales bloomed across her soft skin. The Alluring Serpent disappeared that night into the mountains, but the faithful still seek her counsel to this day.
heroNameZh: 魔蛇之拥 卡西奥佩娅

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

skinNameZh: 灵魂莲华 卡西奥佩娅

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 锐雯 流火
descriptionZh: 从前有位剑圣，在战斗中无情斩落数百人，因此闻名于世。但她手中的剑记得自己夺走的每一条生命——她向最后的敌人挥剑时，那利刃骤然碎裂，带着这位永不停息的战士一同消逝。传说，她的灵魂仍被自己可怕的过往纠缠，不断在世间搜寻着断剑的残片。
descriptionEn: A blademaster of old was famed for cutting down hundreds in battle without mercy. But her sword remembered every life taken—and when she swung at what would be her final enemy, the weeping blade shattered, taking the Restless Warrior with it. Her spirit is said to still scour the world for the blade's lost pieces, haunted by her own bloody legacy.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。

From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 星之守护者 卡莎 热情之光
descriptionZh: 作为一个天生的领袖，卡莎非常重视自己作为队长的工作……也许这对她来说有点过头了。尽管如此，她的小队仍然尊重她的指挥，甚至会跟随她执行哪怕是最危险的任务。而在执行任务时，她将狙击高优先级的目标，然后用星光动力导弹轰炸剩余敌人。
descriptionEn: A born leader with a head for tactics, Kai'Sa takes her job as captain extremely seriously... perhaps too much for her own good. Still, her squad respects her command and will follow her into even the most dangerous missions, where she'll snipe priority targets and spray the rest with payloads of starlight-powered missiles.

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

nameZh: 星之守护者 霞 烈羽
descriptionZh: 多年以前，霞曾在对抗佐伊的战斗中与爱人一起遇害。随后，这对眷侣被复活并转而对抗他们的盟友——霞似乎对这样的转变非常满意。她愤怒于星之守护者们弃她于死地不顾，因而心怀恨意——尽管疑虑已经开始浮现。
descriptionEn: Many years ago, Xayah was destroyed in the fight against Zoe, alongside her lover Rakan. The pair were then resurrected and turned against their allies -- a change Xayah seems almost happy about. Blaming the Star Guardians for abandoning her to die, she has taken a bitter, personal stand against them, even as doubts begin to creep in...

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第三季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 阿狸从前的小队重新露面，曾经将他们撕裂的事件已经将他们改变……并且随之而来的是星之守护者从未面临过的威胁。这个团队是放下旧怨并使自身免于毁灭呢？还是将成为暮光之星的下一批受害者呢？
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ahri's old squad resurfaces, changed from the events that once tore them apart... and followed by a threat beyond anything the Star Guardians have ever faced. Can the group move past old grudges and save themselves from annihilation? Or will they simply be the next victims of the Twilight Star?

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

nameZh: 无畏竞巅峰 薇恩
descriptionZh: 薇恩曾经是猎杀所有被污染者的猎手，现在却成为了她曾经想要摧毁的事物。她扭曲的思想扭曲了她的感知，使她在每一个生物中都看到了一个敌人。她肆无忌惮地夺取灵魂，良心上丝毫没有沾染这些卑鄙行为的污点。
descriptionEn: Once a hunter of all things tainted, Vayne has become the very thing she sought to destroy. Her twisted mind warps her perception, causing her to see an enemy in every living thing. She takes souls with impunity, with no stain of these vile deeds upon her conscience.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 灵魂就是生命、光明和力量——并且在一个没有慈悲的世界里，它们被无情的死亡之主们偷走并吞噬。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Souls are life, light, power—and in a world without mercy, they are stolen and consumed by remorseless masters of death.

universes.descriptionZh: 灵魂就是生命、光明和力量——并且在一个没有慈悲的世界里，它们被无情的死亡之主们偷走并吞噬。
universes.descriptionEn: Souls are life, light, power—and in a world without mercy, they are stolen and consumed by remorseless masters of death.

nameZh: 巅峰剑仙 菲奥娜 天神下凡
descriptionZh: 以此致敬TheShy在2018全球总决赛中使用菲奥娜的夺胜表现。
descriptionEn: Honoring TheShy's winning performance as Fiora during the 2018 World Championship.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 恭喜2018年全球总决赛冠军：Invictus Gaming！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2018: Invictus Gaming!

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

nameZh: 无畏猎手 卡莎 极境飞跃
descriptionZh: 以此致敬JackeyLove在2018全球总决赛中使用卡莎的夺胜表现。
descriptionEn: Honoring JackeyLove's winning performance as Kai'Sa during the 2018 World Championship.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 恭喜2018年全球总决赛冠军：Invictus Gaming！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2018: Invictus Gaming!

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

nameZh: 无畏圣弩 薇恩 绝境狂杀
descriptionZh: 薇恩曾经是猎杀所有被污染者的猎手，现在却成为了她曾经想要摧毁的事物。她扭曲的思想扭曲了她的感知，使她在每一个生物中都看到了一个敌人。她肆无忌惮地夺取灵魂，良心上丝毫没有沾染这些卑鄙行为的污点。

universes.descriptionEn: Souls are life, light, power—and in a world without mercy, they are stolen and consumed by remorseless masters of death.

nameZh: 巅峰之拳 瑟提 明镜止水
descriptionZh: 瑟提曾经是一个遭到遗弃的孩子，发誓要获得力量去摧毁任何让他感到软弱的人。炎龙注意到了他的豪气和凶猛，赐予了他如黑曜石般坚硬的皮肤。现在的瑟提用他超人类的强壮打出了地下拳王的名气，并且他晶状皮肤反射的每一击都会让他的敌人们颤抖不已。
descriptionEn: Once an outcast child, Sett swore he would gain power to destroy anyone who made him feel weak. The Obsidian Dragon took notice of his grit and ferocity and blessed him with obsidian-hardened skin. Sett now uses his superhuman strength to make a name for himself as a pit fighter, and every hit that bounces off his crystalline skin makes his enemies tremble.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 尊荣的巨龙们居住在偏远的雄奇瑰丽之地，为了避免外面的凡界纷争，它们只会非常罕见地将礼物赐给极少数被它们选中的人。神龙尊者们就是幸运且强大到足以获得这种终极赐福的人。他们用它来行善还是行恶，都取决于他们自己，以及任何强大到足以制止他们的人。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Majestic dragons dwell in remote places of wild beauty, avoiding mortal affairs outside of rarely bestowing their gifts on only a select few. The Dragonmancers are those fortunate and powerful enough to have gained the ultimate blessing. Whether they then use that for good or for evil is up to them, and anyone strong enough to stop them.

universes.descriptionZh: 圣兽们守护着整个世界，能够把任何人变成强大的存在，但前提是那个灵魂值得他们的祝福。无论他们的力量是用于善还是恶，一旦赐予，就无法收回。
universes.descriptionEn: Divine beasts watch over the world entire, capable of turning anyone into powerful beings, but only if that soul is worthy of their blessings. Whether their power is used for good or evil, once the gift is given, it cannot be taken away.

skinNameZh: 神龙尊者 炎龙瑟提

nameZh: 无畏游侠 卢锡安 不败圣枪
descriptionZh: 作为一名前联邦法警和雇佣枪手，卢锡安的灵魂在与某个恶魔达成协议时就已经腐化了。而签订这份协议，正是为了挽救他唯一真爱之人的生命。两种情绪交织之下，且背负着地狱力量的诅咒，现在的他在前线猎杀这个恶魔以寻求复仇。
descriptionEn: A former federal marshal and gunslinger for hire, Lucian's soul was corrupted when he made a deal with the devil in order to spare the life of his one true love. Double-crossed, and cursed with the powers of hell, he now hunts this devil across the high frontier, seeking revenge.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 枪手和执法人员在高边疆的无情阳光下骑行，同时追逐着生存和救赎。天堂已成瓦砾，地狱空空如也，而所有的恶魔都在这里。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

universes.nameZh: 西部魔影 厄运金属
universes.descriptionZh: 工业革命的鼎盛时期，旅行者们开始涌向不驯的西部，为了寻求财运和成功，而宁愿置身于一个残忍的远古世界的未知恐惧中。这段时期属于勇敢的枪手、恶劣的无赖、难测的诸神、与野蛮的恶魔。
universes.descriptionEn: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

nameZh: 无畏骑士 瑟庄妮 赤子初心
descriptionZh: 曾有个小女孩被困在魄罗国王的魔法冰雪大陆上，被魄罗收养并长大成人，这就是瑟庄妮。如今的她已是魄罗王国最伟大的英雄之一，骑着一只慵懒馋嘴的战斗魄罗，对抗任何威胁她第二故乡的人。
descriptionEn: Stranded as a child in the Poro King's enchanted Winterlands, Sejuani was taken in by the poros and raised as their own. She is now one of their greatest champions, riding a slobbery, snack-obsessed war poro against any who would threaten her adoptive home.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在神奇的冬季仙境中，魄罗王之的统治至高无上，向他王庭的所有人传播欢乐和喜悦。尽管其他人都想篡夺国王的王位，但他们都对冬境仙灵们有着共同的热爱。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Within the magical Winterlands, the Poro King reigns supreme, spreading joy and merriment to all of his court. Even as others work to usurp the king, all share a common love for winter's wonders.

universes.descriptionZh: 一年中还有比空气清新、雪花蓬松、巧克力热腾腾的冰雪节更好的时候吗？投掷雪球或吟唱颂歌；只要你怀着好心情，一切都会好起来的，然后你就没有什么好怕的了。
universes.descriptionEn: Is there a better time of year than Snowdown, when the air is crisp, the snow fluffy, and the chocolate hot? Toss a snowball or sing a carol; as long as you have good cheer, all will be well, and you'll have nothing to fear.

nameZh: 无畏意志 墨菲特 必不可挡
descriptionZh: 以此致敬Doinb在2019全球总决赛中使用墨菲特的夺胜表现。
descriptionEn: Honoring Doinb's winning performance as Malphite during the 2019 World Championship.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 恭喜2019年全球总决赛冠军：FunPlus Phoenix！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2019: FunPlus Phoenix!

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

descriptionZh: 以此致敬Rookie在2018全球总决赛中使用乐芙兰的夺胜表现。
descriptionEn: Honoring Rookie's winning performance as LeBlanc during the 2018 World Championship.

nameZh: 春晖神女 拉克丝 流风回雪
descriptionZh: 从小就被教导要保护天界免受黑暗的侵袭，春晖神女和她的伙伴们承诺要守护整个世界。虽然拉克丝已经是非常强大的半神，但是她还是需要来自忠诚的伙伴沃里克和内瑟斯的帮助。
descriptionEn: Groomed from a young age to guard the immortal realm from darkness, the Lunar Empress and her companions are said to stand watch over the world. Lux, though a powerful demigod in her own right, draws aid from the ever-faithful Warwick and Nasus.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 与朋友和敌人一起庆祝过去一年的各种故事。光彩夺目的花灯直达夜空，被逐渐消失的焰火照亮。红包们在大家的手中传递，很少见面的亲人和家族欢欣鼓舞，怀着同一种共识：新的一年即将到来。愿它成为你最好的一年！
skinSets.descriptionEn: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

universes.descriptionZh: 是时候回顾过去，与亲友们一起庆祝，团聚在一起铭记发生的一切，即使有好事也有坏事。当烟花照亮夜空时，我们期待着，新的一年会充满我们与珍视之人的美好回忆。
universes.descriptionEn: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

nameZh: 冠军典狱长 锤石 凯旋圣装
descriptionZh: 以此庆祝2013年在北美举办的全球总决赛。
descriptionEn: Celebrating Worlds 2013 in North America.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有游戏中最伟大的舞台。两支队伍在数百万粉丝面前对决。只有一支队伍会被加冕为冠军。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The greatest stage in all of gaming. Two teams face off before millions of fans. Only one will be crowned the champion.

nameZh: 冰雪游神 巴德 炫金
descriptionZh: 巴德神通广大的宇宙力量和他不可捉摸的天性是打雪仗的巨大优势。他召唤的冰雪大陆魔法企鹅队列、自动加热的可可饮料、还有通向未知的传送门，全都让这个冰雪游神无往不利。
descriptionEn: Bard's vast cosmic powers and inscrutable nature are great assets in a snowball fight. Summoning an array of enchanted Winterland penguins, self-warming cups of cocoa, and portals to nowhere give this Wandering Caretaker an unbeatable edge.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 冰雪佳节将来到，三条战线雪飘飘……\n坦克冲锋吹号角，恰逢上路来得妙，\n金币满满口袋饱，巫妖之祸任逍遥......
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's beginning to look a lot like Snow Day, up and down the lanes... \nThough your tank may be rushing in, Top is backing again, \nThey have gold to spend on a Lich Bane...

universes.descriptionZh: 一年中还有比空气清新、雪花蓬松、巧克力热腾腾的冰雪节更好的时候吗？投掷雪球或吟唱颂歌；只要你怀着好心情，一切都会好起来的，然后你就没有什么好怕的了。
universes.descriptionEn: Is there a better time of year than Snowdown, when the air is crisp, the snow fluffy, and the chocolate hot? Toss a snowball or sing a carol; as long as you have good cheer, all will be well, and you'll have nothing to fear.

nameZh: 社会名流 乐芙兰 紫罗兰魅影
descriptionZh: 乐芙兰目前正在躲避一场国际性的追捕行动，因为之前她把一架满载着乘客的喷气机弄消失了，然后意识到她根本不知道他们去哪了以及怎样把他们带回来。
descriptionEn: LeBlanc is currently evading an international manhunt after making a jet liner filled with passengers disappear, then realizing she had no idea where they went or how to bring them back.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 这就是一门生计！
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's a living!

universes.descriptionZh: 磨砺之路不仅仅是工作。它是斗争，是喧嚣，有时令人振奋，有时令人沮丧。它是一个为期一周的过山车，有喜剧性的过弯和悲惨的急落，只会在周一重新开始。我们是努力工作还是几乎不工作？在磨砺之路上，一切都一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The grind isn't just work. It's the struggle, the hustle, sometimes invigorating, sometimes demoralizing. It's a weeklong rollercoaster with comedic bends and tragic drops, only to start all over again on Monday. Are we working hard or hardly working? It's all the same on the grind.

nameZh: 星之吞噬者 莫甘娜 热情之末
descriptionZh: 莫甘娜是一个出身神秘的反派，她相信正义和秩序等概念正在阻碍着宇宙……她愿意做任何事情来让它回到一种熵增状态。她将星之守护者作为毁灭的目标，在对他们进行一番无情的折磨后，赐予他们最终的夺命一击。
descriptionEn: A villainess of mysterious origins, Morgana believes that concepts like justice and order are holding the universe back... and she's willing to do anything to return it to a state of entropy. Targeting the Star Guardians for destruction, she torments them relentlessly before dealing the final, crushing blow.

skinSets.nameZh: 星之守护者 第四季
skinSets.descriptionZh: 瓦洛兰城因佐伊的入侵而伤痕累累，现在由新一代的星之守护者保卫。远古的敌人在瓦洛兰城中出现。黑暗在上空聚集，卡莎和阿卡丽与她们未经考验的小队一起备战，准备对抗他们无法理解的诸多势力……以及在远方等待着的真正威胁。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

universes.descriptionZh: 星之守护者们有一段黑暗、神秘的过往。
universes.descriptionEn: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

skinNameZh: 星之吞噬者 莫甘娜

nameZh: 幻灵战斗兔 锐雯 梦幻强袭
descriptionZh: 在原初星人入侵的初期失去了许多同伴后，锐雯自愿加入并最终成为了幻灵小队的一员。在一连串的胜利之后，她声名鹊起：一个人人敬仰的战争英雄。……那么，为什么在这个世界最需要她的时候，她却突然消失了？
descriptionEn: Riven volunteered for what would eventually become Anima Squad after losing many comrades in the early days of the Primordian invasion. A string of victories later, she is famous: a war hero looked up to by all. ...So why has she suddenly vanished when the world needs her most?

universes.descriptionZh: 人类濒临绝境，几乎被名为原初星人的深海入侵者的一支高科技军队击败。加入幻灵战队：精英战士们使用打捞来的原初星科技来抵抗世界的终结。为了拯救人类，他们将不得不像动物一样战斗。
universes.descriptionEn: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

nameZh: 怦然心动 凯特琳 未相见心已至
descriptionZh: 我讨厌你走路的样子，就像你是购物中心的凯特琳小公主，而我只是阴沟老鼠。我讨厌你在周围没有其他人时看我的眼神，在镇上却死都不肯和我一起。也许我们的整件事只是一个巨大的错误。所以如果你想让我走，我就走。但是请求我的话，我就留。——蔚
descriptionEn: I hate the way you walk around, like you're Princess Caitlyn of the mall, and I'm just some gutter rat. I hate the way you look at me when there's no one else around, but wouldn't be caught dead with me in town. Maybe our whole thing was just a huge mistake. So if you want me to go, I'm gone. But ask, and I will stay. -Vi

skinSets.descriptionZh: 洋溢着学院风且风度翩翩的心动派与宁愿逃课去滑板场闲逛的心伤组没有太多共同之处。但他们在一件事上达成了一致：他们已经受够了这个为了人们萌生感情而硬造出来的愚蠢节日。那么，为什么他们似乎无法摆脱这种小鹿乱撞的感觉呢？
skinSets.descriptionEn: The preppy and perfectly poised Heartthrob clique don't have much in common with the Heartache crew, who would much rather be ditching class to hang out at the skatepark. But they agree on one thing: they've had it with this silly made up holiday dedicated to people catching feelings. So why can't they seem to shake the butterflies from their stomachs?

universes.descriptionZh: 在刻板的小团体、尴尬的小组项目和俗气的假日之间，校园生活枯燥且乏味。但坠入爱河并不在教学大纲里，并且它会让事情变得更复杂。
universes.descriptionEn: Between the rigid cliques, awkward group projects, and cheesy holidays, school was rough but routine. But getting lovestruck wasn't in the syllabus, and it's gonna make things way more complicated.

nameZh: 泳池派对 凯特琳 粉红冰川
descriptionZh: 对于凯特琳来说，完美的夏日就是躺在奢华的泳池边、吃刨冰、喝热带特饮。当然，还有让行人吃上几发水弹。她可真的很喜欢射击。
descriptionEn: For Caitlyn, nothing says a perfect summer's day like lounging at a luxurious poolside, eating shaved ice and drinking tropical libations. And shooting people. She really loves shooting people.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

universes.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
universes.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 觅心萝莉 金克丝 是心动啊
descriptionZh: 爱情即是战场，而金克丝有备而来！她武装着挚爱同伴“鱼骨头”，已经准备好要伤别人的心——和骨头了。但如果她足够喜欢你，她就打算玩得友善一些。也许吧。很有可能不是。
descriptionEn: Love is a battlefield, and Jinx comes prepared! Armed with her beloved companion Fishbones, she's ready to break hearts—and bones. But if she likes you enough, she's prepared to play nice. Maybe. Probably not.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 大多数人都在安静的公园或友好的茶馆里寻找恋人。但那些关系不会长久。在战场上形成的各种纽带，就像直接穿过敌人心脏的子弹一样具有穿透力……才是能够持续下去的关系。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Most seek out sweethearts in quiet parks or friendly tea shops. But those relationships never last. The bonds formed on the battlefield, piercing like bullets straight through the hearts of enemies... those endure.

universes.descriptionZh: 所以……你愿意吗？
universes.descriptionEn: So... will you?

nameZh: 冠军掠夺者 卡兹克 凯旋圣装
descriptionZh: 以此庆祝2018年在韩国举办的全球总决赛。
descriptionEn: Celebrating Worlds 2018 in Korea.
heroNameZh: 虚空掠夺者 卡兹克

skinSets.descriptionZh: 所有游戏中最伟大的舞台。两支队伍在数百万粉丝面前对决。只有一支队伍会被加冕为冠军。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The greatest stage in all of gaming. Two teams face off before millions of fans. Only one will be crowned the champion.

universes.descriptionZh: 有人说最大的奖赏是在全场欢呼的粉丝们面前举起召唤师奖杯……也有人说是现金。在《英雄联盟》团队中制作皮肤的那些人？ 我们认为赢得全球总冠军最棒的地方就是在你最喜欢的游戏中得到永生。而且我们一视同仁！
universes.descriptionEn: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

skinNameZh: 冠军掠夺者 卡兹克

nameZh: 冠军之刃 锐雯 2016 凯旋圣装
descriptionZh: 以此庆祝2016年在北美举办的全球总决赛。
descriptionEn: Celebrating Worlds 2016 in North America.

nameZh: 山海绘卷 科加斯 朱红
descriptionZh: 科加斯是一头虚构、巨大的野兽，被画进了神秘的山海绘卷中，皆因他的暴食导致了永恒的业力惩罚。科加斯已经掌握了山海绘卷通向多重宇宙的连接，并且计划将他自己的世界和所有其它的世界都统统吞噬掉。
descriptionEn: A mythical, titanic beast painted within the mysterious Shan Hai Scrolls, whose gluttony resulted in eternal karmic punishment, Cho'gath has seized upon the Scrolls' connection to the multiverse and plans to devour both his own world and then all others.
heroNameEn: the Terror of the Void Cho'Gath

skinSets.descriptionZh: 在传说中的山海绘卷中，神明们和神话生物们在各个神奇的土地上游荡，挥舞着元素的力量。有些人满足于接受给定的调色板，而另一些人则希望跳出界限，用一支新的画笔描绘他们的生活。
skinSets.descriptionEn: Within the fabled Shan Hai Scrolls, gods and mythical creatures roam magical lands, wielding the power of the elements. Some are content to live with the palette they've been given, while others wish to jump beyond the borders and paint their lives with a new brush.

universes.descriptionZh: 没有人能说出神秘的山海绘卷是何人或在何时创作的。只需要一眼就可以看出这幅画是通向魔法和奇迹世界的一扇窗户，但也许它更像是一扇门扉？
universes.descriptionEn: No one can say who created the mysterious Shan Hai Scrolls, or when. All it takes is one glimpse to see the painting is a window to a world of magic and wonder, but perhaps it is more of a doorway?

nameZh: 泳池派对 辛德拉 荔枝枝连击
descriptionZh: 现在，辛德拉已经战胜了所有的对手，是时候进行最后的考验了：防止任何游离的排球击中她的朋友们。再来一次。
descriptionEn: Now that Syndra's aced all her opponents, it's time for her final test: prevent any rogue volleyballs from hitting her friends. Again.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 夏天到了，宝贝！太阳出来啦，微风暖洋洋，海水凉爽爽。每个人都将他们的竞争与积怨留在家里，并且只带着泳衣和正能量。以后有的是时间去争斗与大吼。现在只需坐下来，享受音乐，感受快乐。
skinSets.descriptionEn: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

nameZh: 泳池派对 奥莉安娜 优雅珠光鲸
descriptionZh: 有了最新的装备，奥莉安娜终于能够完全潜进水中生物群落了。这给她带来了巨大的快乐，因为以前在海滩上玩一天后，需要连续几周擦洗盐、沙子，有时还会有一只生气的螃蟹爬出她的齿轮。
descriptionEn: With her latest outfit, Orianna is finally able to submerge completely in aquatic biomes. This brings her great joy, as a day at the beach previously required subsequent weeks of scrubbing salt, sand, and sometimes an angry crab out of her gears.
heroNameZh: 发条魔灵 奥莉安娜

nameZh: 霸天巨兽·雪崩 墨菲特
descriptionZh: M - 2机型，“霸天巨兽 墨菲特”是一座巨大的两足堡垒，能够变形成一个行星钻头——从而让它成为面对新型且强大的怪兽时的终极防御手段。它的拳套只需一击就可以在厚重的钛合金板甲上打出窟窿，击倒无数怪兽。
descriptionEn: Designated M-2, the “Mecha Malphite” unit is a massive, bipedal fortress capable of turning into a planetary drill—making it the ultimate defensive option when faced with new and powerful kaiju. A single punch from its gauntlets can blow holes through thick titanium sheeting, and such attacks have felled countless monsters.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当身形庞大的怪兽开始从海中、地上和空中发起进攻时，人类发展出了相同威力的霸天机甲单位以爆发性的徒手战斗抵御它们。
skinSets.descriptionEn: When colossal kaiju begin attacking from the sea, land, and air, humanity develops equally powerful mecha units to stop them in explosive hand-to-hand combat.

universes.descriptionZh: 耸立在城市之上，庞大的怪兽与高耸的机甲扭打在一起。谁会赢？
universes.descriptionEn: Towering above the city, gargantuan kaiju tussle with towering mechas. Who will win?

nameZh: 源计划：火 菲奥娜 惩戒
descriptionZh: 增强改造只为速度的菲奥娜，手持零度脉冲剑刃，与艾希和其他基因动力的成员并肩作战。完整长度的能量战刃是为了完美无瑕的攻击精度和最大限度的击打强度。空间受控的原子针镀层能最大程度地兼容单目标作战。
descriptionEn: Augmented for speed, Fiora uses her zero-pulse sword to fight alongside Ashe and the other members of G/NETIC. The full-length energy blade allows for flawless attack precision and maximum repel strength, while the spatially controlled atomic tip coating is most suited for single-target combat.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 源计划集团相信解开人类潜能的秘密是超越我们凡躯的关键。我们将通过技术达到飞升。聚在一起。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The PROJECT Corporation believes unlocking the secrets of humanity's potential is the key to progress beyond our mortal bodies. It is through technology that we will ascend. Together.

universes.descriptionZh: 在某个由数个全球集团所控制的未来，巨型建筑物和拥挤的街道之中，一场暗影战争在充满抗争精神且被技术增幅过的人类和全新强化过的智能生物之间打响了。胜者将改变历史的进程……而败者将被强迫演变。
universes.descriptionEn: Among the mega-structures and packed streets of a future controlled by global corporations, a shadow war rages between rebellious, augmented humans and newly empowered artificial beings. The winners will shape the course of history... and the losers will be forced to evolve.

nameZh: 灵魂莲华 薇恩 春晓
descriptionZh: 传说，一位孤独的女猎手坚信是恶魔残害了自己的族人，于是拿起武器与恶魔战斗。她不懈地追击这个怪物，一切胆敢挡路的存在都被她屠戮干净。即使身躯已然破败，她愤怒的魂魄仍在继续追猎。据说直到今天，她也仍在追逐仇敌。然而，被愤怒蒙蔽的双眼已无法看清真相——她早已在复仇的扭曲意志支配下沦为怪物。
descriptionEn: It is said the Lone Huntress took up arms against the demonkin she believed responsible for ending her bloodline. She pursued the monster, slaughtering all in her path, until her body gave out and her wrathful spirit continued the chase. To this day, she is said to still hunt—blinded to the truth that she has in turn become a monster, marred by revenge.

skinSets.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的节庆时段，当通往灵界的大门打开时，亡者会回到亲人身边，各种各样的灵体都将目光投向生者。从仁慈的明昼到偏执的夜幽——他们的故事一次又一次地上演，就像走马灯上的影像。
skinSets.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

universes.descriptionZh: 绽灵节是艾欧尼亚的一个古老的庆典，届时灵界的大门会开启，逝者们会回到他们的挚爱那里，并且各式各样的灵体们都会把目光转向生者们。从仁慈的明昼，到偏执的夜幽——它们的故事都在一遍又一遍地上演着，就像走马灯上的影子一样。
universes.descriptionEn: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

nameZh: 霸天剑魔 亚托克斯 涤罪之翼
descriptionZh: ATRX - 1机型，“霸天剑魔 亚托克斯”的开发是为了使用它有限的飞行能力来击沉巨兽。此外，ATRX - 1装载着一把热能利剑，它能转化残余的光颗粒，使之变成高热刀刃。
descriptionEn: Designated ATRX-1, the “Mecha Aatrox” unit was developed in response to 'gliding' kaiju with the capability of limited flight. In addition, ATRX-1 wields a thermal blade that can turn residual light particles into a heated cutting edge.
heroNameZh: 暗裔剑魔 亚托克斯

skinSets.descriptionZh: 当身形庞大的怪兽开始从海中、地上和空中发起进攻时，人类发展出了相同威力的霸天机甲单位以爆发性的徒手战斗抵御它们。
